Because this affair system, other than fixed rank rewards, was all nothing but a scam.
So he hugged Theia tightly. At least she was here for him to share this sad moment.
[Luke, this is not that bad.] The system again tried to cheer him up.
[After all, you are getting B rank rewards from Theia.]
"Sigh." He sighed and asked something else.
’Why didn’t you tell me about this *Lover system*?’
[You never asked.]
’So if I asked, you would tell me?’
[Feel free to try~] The system replied playfully, clearly not wanting to answer that question.
After that, the system also said that for becoming a lover, the woman must have the will to sacrifice her life for Luke without hesitation.
And should also have feelings for him.
Normally this would be tough, because the system was clearly saying that
a one-night stand wouldn’t make them a lover.
’So how did Theia, who was just summoned, become a lover?’ Luke asked confusedly. Because from her first look, it didn’t seem she would let him even touch her body.
But even after coming back to her senses earlier in the cave, she didn’t stop him.
The system also cleared this doubt.
[Your summons are deeply attached to you, especially female ones.]
[So all of them are tailor-made lovers.]
[😎] system showed proud emoji, like he was really proud of summoning those tailor made lovers for Luke.
Those words seemed kind of wrong.
Still, Luke rejected those ideas. ’Nah, I am not going to do it with others.’
After all, what happened with Theia was already a mistake, and he would take responsibility for that.
But he would not going to lose his character for some petty rewards.
[We will see about that.] The system said playfully, before becoming quiet.
Which left only silence and the sound of winds passing through his ear.

sentences.text: After that they cleaned themselves and Luke gave one magical clothes to Theia.
"It’s a nice one." She muttered with satisfaction, clearly not surprised by its effect.
’Seems like she had worn those in her world.’ Luke observed her expression while she was wearing it.
With all that done, Luke asked her a very important question.
"Theia, can you use any dream magic or your arcane magic?"
Hearing Luke’s worried words, Theia shook her head with regret.
Even after Luke had fed her those red fruits, she felt her mana veins were still damaged.
Like those fruits only healed her outer injury.
"Master, unless I get something related to Dream power, I don’t think I can use any of my abilities for a few months." She said dejectedly, clearly feeling bad that she had become a burden on Luke.

"Meow~"
The oversized lion meowed.

’Poor Theia.’ The system sighed from the side, but didn’t say anything.

"Let’s return to Blackstone Highlands." Luke said with a worried expression.

’Ok, continue.’ Luke nodded and rested his head on Theia’s shoulders.

chapters.title: Chapter 254: Theia’s Secret Jealousy
paragraphs: [So do you want to draw the random reward now?] The system said with a cheering voice, but seeing it was not having the effect it wanted, he also added.
[I would suggest you, to try it.]
[Who knows, maybe you will end up with the rewards you need right now.]
Hearing the system’s repeated claim about getting good rewards, Luke became a little suspicious.
’Is he hinting at something?’ And this thought immediately came into his mind.
’Well, we can try.’
’After all, I don’t have any hopes for this.’ With that he clicked on the icon which was glowing with green light.
[Summon Lover Theia Monthly Return.]
[Yes or No.]
After clicking on yes, it showed a loading rewards window, before finally presenting the text he wanted to see.
[Congratulations Luke! for getting B rank skill.]
[Skill Info.]
[Scarlet Dominion]
Rank: B
Type: Blood / Authority / Binding
Origin: Ancient Hemarch Civilization — Alternate Reality
Description:
A forbidden blood-binding technique developed by the ancient Hemarchs, a powerful race that once ruled a complete world in their reality.
The Hemarchs created this technique after discovering that ordinary contracts could be broken, magical restrictions could be dispelled, and even powerful mind-control techniques could be resisted.
Rather than controlling the mind, they created a binding that targeted something far deeper—
The target’s own life force.
By using a small amount of the target’s blood, the caster establishes a blood connection between themselves and the target.
The bound individual retains their free will, thoughts, emotions, personality, and independent judgment.
However, they are unable to betray the designated master without suffering the consequences of the blood contract.
The greater the betrayal, the more severe the blood backlash.
System Evaluation:
[A highly sophisticated B-Rank Blood Binding Skill. Even though it’s incomplete.]
[Recommended Usage: Subordinates, prisoners, sworn warriors, contracted servants, and dangerous individuals.]
’THIS!!!’ After reading this, Luke’s eyes became wide with shock. Because from the start he was searching for this type of skill.
After all he had a clone skill, and letting all clones sit in one place was a huge waste.
Which was even more true after finding that they could stay far without any distance limit.
So during his seven days’ stay inside the Time Chamber, he hoped to get this, but only ended up with those mana stones and other unneeded materials.
Even though he had Aurora for this type of loyalty-related thing, he couldn’t take her with him or his clone everywhere.
’I can finally start my real plan.’ He thought with an excited expression. Hell, he became so happy that he unconsciously hugged Theia tightly.
Fortunately, she didn’t ask what happened this time and was happy seeing Luke smile.
[I told you Luke.] The system also came for praise, which he gave without any restriction.
’Yes system, you are the best.’ After praising the system, he immediately started the plan.
His shadow glitched, and from that came out three clones which he had earlier dismissed.
’Go.’ He gave them a simple command, because they knew what they had to do.
Which was going to the Human Empire’s capital, and there each would make a different group. Luke smiled upon this thought.
The first clone would make an Assassin group, so he could kill his enemy without involving his main body.
While the second clone would make a Merchant group to sell those precious system-related gifts for other valuable things.
Yeah, he had earlier calculated that most of the system’s products, like Origin fruits and perfect breakthrough potions, weren’t some cheap-end goods.
Which his current territory could sell, without getting into suspicion or inviting greater threat.
So he would only sell some production-related things from his main territory, while others from the second clone.
’And finally the third clone.’ Upon this, Luke narrowed his eyes.
Because this clone would gather information about everything.
Which would help him understand this world better and even more about his wives, which he couldn’t meet currently.
’But that’s not the most important thing.’ He lowered his eyes, while remembering the system’s words.
That the Origin Titan fragments were already corrupted and it could also be a trap.
So that was why, rather than risking his main body searching for those clues, which he couldn’t even do with his current lord persona,
he would create a special information group.
’I hope this will work.’ He sighed upon that thought.
Fortunately, he got this slave-type reward, which resolved his major problems.
’The problems to recruit members for his new groups.’
Yes, after all he was planning to make the group grand and keep expanding, so he could find whatever he wanted easily.
With all that done, he calculated when they would reach back home.
"Seems like by the morning we could reach Blackstone."
Hearing Luke’s words, Theia nodded.
After all, she was the one who had brought them here, so she could clearly know the distance more clearly.
That was why they had left the cave in the night.
Morning...
1st day of Fructus month, same year.
"We are close." Luke said, after noticing the earlier breakthrough site where he had become a real titan.
Theia also observed the surroundings with melancholy. Because even for her, this was a special place.
After all, on the first day she got summoned, she witnessed Luke’s metamorphosis.
"Continue, Sunrath." He gave the order, before sitting with dignity.
Seeing Luke’s behavior, a low chuckle escaped her mouth, still she didn’t dare to comment.
Because earlier he was being so lovey-dovey and kept touching her here and there. But the moment they came near Blackstone, he became a dignified lord.
’Clearly because of the people and Lady Aurielle.’ She thought with a little jealousy.
Since she knew, that what her master did the previous day was his lust, not his love.
And there was even more possibility that he would not accept her openly.
That was why she was jealous of Aurielle, after all she could openly call Luke her husband, while she couldn’t.

chapters.title: Chapter 255: They Invaded His Territory While Luke Was Away
paragraphs: Luke from behind noticed that Theia’s body had become somewhat tense.
Which he could already guess why.
"Sigh."
Sadly for this, he could only sigh.
After all he knew that accepting Theia openly would bring too much backlash from his wives.
As for what the world would say, he didn’t care.
Even though polygamy was normal here, so they would not say anything openly, he was sure of that.
That was why, instead of reassuring her, he remained silent.
Since this was not the time.
While he was thinking this, one of his clones sent him the information of what had occurred during his absence in the territory.
’Luke, here are the details.’
He went through all the info, but the more he heard, the more angry he became.
"Bastard!" His angry voice even came out, which freaked out Theia.
"Master, what happened?" She worriedly asked, because Luke currently seemed very angry. But Luke didn’t reply to her.
He kept going through the whole information, and only after hearing the end did he breathe a sigh of relief.
After that, he observed Theia’s worried face and thought for a moment.
Even though he didn’t like telling other people much except his wife, he still narrated what happened.
"Just after we left, many peak Golden Knights appeared in the territory and demanded to meet me." He said with a calm voice, like his earlier anger was gone.
Because he knew that these peak Golden Knights were the surrounding Viscount’s forces, who were already dissatisfied with him.
So they took the advantage of this situation and annocened to everyone.
"That I was involved during the earlier essence cloud gathering and also, it was me who got the treasure."
Hearing this, Theia also narrowed her eyes. Because they were clearly targeting Luke.
Of course what they said was true, witout knowing, it was truth. After all they couldn’t get any answer during that situation.
So they just wanted to bring more attention and trouble to Blackstone.
"Sigh, Even Aurielle tried to stop them by saying that I was in the middle of a breakthrough and couldn’t meet anyone.
"But they still demanded to meet me and didn’t believe Aurielle’s words at all."
Luke clenched his fist, because he could feel Aurielle’s helplessness and uneasiness at that time.
Since she was facing more than ten peak Golden Knights.
That was why they didn’t get afraid of Aurora and openly dared to enter the territory.
’They will pay.’ With that thought, he continued.
"Fortunately, before they could enter the mansion, the managers of the Merchant, Blacksmith, and Adventurer Guilds came and stopped them."
Hearing that, Theia also felt relief, because this place was built by her master and she also didn’t like anyone daring to enter without his permission.
Luke continued with a normal voice, "Seeing them, they finally backed down."
"Not because they were afraid of their strength, but they were wary of their background."
"Which was continental level, and as a Viscount, they couldn’t face them at all."
Luke took a deep breath after that.
Because from earlier, anyone would think that everything had finally resolved peacefully.
But sadly no.
"What happened next, master?" Even Theia understood this and asked.
Luke said with a voice that contained faint killing intent.
"The next day, an early B rank being, the Platinum Knight, entered the territory."
"What!" Hearing this, even her eyes became wide. Because those beings rarely moved outside, that’s what she found from the memory of the people of this world.
And earlier, because of what happened with Luke, that was why they moved.

"Yeah, all of this happened because those peak Golden Knights, the Viscount, spread the words that they had confirmed it was me who got the treasure and that was why I was not willing to meet any of them."
Luke said the next words while surpassing his earlier killing intent.
"And the Platinum Knight was the same being who had killed the Barrus brothers’ family and father."
He also told her about his new recruit of Golden Knight.
So after finding the information, he moved first, clearly not afraid of his hero status.
"Because he was a follower of the Storm God and a friend of Count Magnus." Luke said with a calm voice.
But anyone here would freak out upon this. After all, a Platinum Knight entered his territory, and if that person reached the mansion,
then he would also be able to find the Time Chamber, a priceless treasure.
On the contrary, he continued with a normal voice, "The managers again tried to stop Severin, the Platinum Knight."
"But the person who didn’t fear my hero title, how could he worry about their background?"
"So the result was obvious. He entered the mansion without any worry."
At this time, Theia looked toward Luke’s eyes with worry, because he was too calm.
Even though she knew something must have happened, or else he wouldn’t sit here, instead immediately try to reach the mansion.
Which confirmed Luke’s next words. "But at the last moment, Jasper, the manager of the Merchant Guild’s grandpa appeared."
"An early Platinum Knight."
Hearing this, Theia breathed a sigh of relief, because no harm was done.
"So seeing another person of the same strength present, he didn’t dare to force a breakthrough and left."
After saying that, Luke looked toward the earlier lightning strike site, where no one was present.
Only emptiness, because during his breakthrough, everything was destroyed in the 100km area.
Then he told her the rest of the news.
"The next day, he came back..."
"This time, with the Marquis of the demi-human, a Diamond Knight, an A rank being."
"Followed by tens of B rank beings."
"With one objective."
"That was to see me without any denial."
Upon this, Theia’s eyes went completely wide. Because this was absurd.
A Diamond Knight was high and mighty, so without caring about his reputation, he tried to force his way into a Baron’s territory.
Could bring the person a huge backlash among his community.

chapters.title: Chapter 256: The Saintess Really Has Future Sight
paragraphs: After all, it was like an adult getting involved in a 2-year-old child’s matter. Which was crazy.
Earlier, at this information, Luke became so angry. Because he knew that unless Count Magnus came, no one else could stop an A rank being.
But after everything, he had heard about him, he had lost all hope from him.
Even though he was strong, there was no denial in this.
Sadly, he acted only once during the Demon invasion, and after that, he became completely silent.
Which he could understand, related to the King, Emperor, and politics.
And also, now he had a family, so he didn’t want to take a big action which could bring a huge reaction from anyone.
"Master." Theia’s worried voice brought Luke out of his thoughts.
He nodded at her, before telling the ending part.
"But the moment they decided to step into the mansion,"
"The Holy Church Templar Knights arrived with full force and stopped their steps."
’Templar Knights, the group of A rank beings.’ Theia immediately connected the rumors she had got from people’s memories.
In those rumors, whenever Templar Knights moved, kingdoms were overthrown, even empires became silent.
After all, no one wanted a group of A rank beings, which was called Country Destroyer, to arrive at their doorstep.
"So the Marquis, with an ugly face, had to return, and the same was with his B rank subordinates."
He also told that those knights were still guarding the territory.
’Lumina, I owe you this time.’ He thought about the Saintess of Light with a grateful expression.
Because protecting his territory was technically not coming under the church’s order. After all, they wouldn’t move unless the person touched upon their belief.
Hell, even for him, they wouldn’t move. After all, he was an talentless Hero.
Only the Saintess could command the Holy Church Knights without worrying about backlash from the church or the goddess herself.
’What was she thinking about my recent genius tag?’ He thought with an amused smile.
But the next moment, he removed those unnecessary thoughts from his mind.
"Sunrath, increase the speed." After that he gave the order.
However instead of replying, the lion simply—
"Meow~"
Crimson flames erupted around his four legs.
BOOM!
The ground shattered beneath his paws as his speed exploded.
WHOOSH!
Sunrath became a streak of fire racing across the land. Every step left cracks behind, yet before the destruction could even spread, he had already crossed hundreds of meters.
Along the way, everyone who saw the massive lion froze in fear.
After all, Sunrath never concealed his aura. The oppressive pressure of a B-Rank existence spread across the surroundings like an invisible storm, making everyone near standing turn pale.
Merchants halted their wagons.
Guards instinctively tightened their grip on their weapons.
Even knights couldn’t help but hold their breath.
"Fortunately, the Holy Church knights are here... otherwise, who knows what might have happened?" a passing merchant muttered after noticing the one figure calmly seated on the lion’s back.
Clearly, they had come to Blackstone to meet someone.
Sunrath didn’t care about their thoughts and with such terrifying speed, they quickly passed through the Ashveil trade route and arrived before Blackstone’s main gate.
But Luke had already disappeared, only Theia was seated upon Sunrath.
After all, earlier it was told that Luke was cultivating inside, so if he appeared form outside, that would create too many questions.
"Halt!" The guards at the main gate shouted toward Sunrath, with weapons in their hands.
Even though they were wary and afraid of Sunrath, since their cultivation was only of Bronze Knight,
they still did their duty, remembering that the territory still held Holy Church Knights.
Meaning no one would dare to cause trouble.
Which was kinda true.
Because the moment Sunrath entered 100km of Blackstone’s radius, they already knew about it.
Of course, they couldn’t identify Luke, since he had already appeared inside the Time Chamber using his teleportation.
While using *Null Veil of Nyx* ability, which hides his presence completely even from A rank beings.
Unless the higher beings spread their senses more actively.
Sadly for Luke, one person was able to find him, even without that.
The commander of Templar Knights.
"Greetings, Hero Luke." A middle-aged man with short white hair greeted Luke with a smile.
Clearly able to see through his ability.
Seeing he was already exposed, Luke removed the Null Veil and returned the greeting back.
"Hello, Sir-" He stopped after saying that, since he didn’t know the person’s name. Even though the person was wearing Holy Church radiant light armor.
"Solan Aeravyn." Solan introduced himself with a smile.
"Nice to meet you, Sir Solan." Luke greeted him again, and at the same time, both of them looked toward the main gate.
"Seems like I have to go." Luke said, before adding, "My pet and subordinate are outside."
Hearing those words, Solan raised his eyebrow in surprise.
Because those beings were clearly B rank, and Luke was telling that they were his pet and subordinate.
"Interesting." He didn’t think it was falsehood.
Instead he became interested in Hero Luke, the talentless hero of light.
After all, he was the one who had left the Holy Church to purge the Hidden Hand assassination organization, and also now he was here at the command of the Saintess.
For the earlier action, he knew why she was doing this.
After all, the hero of their church was touched, so the destruction was necessary.
But when she said that he had to protect Luke’s territory and also remain there until he appeared by himself,
he became confused.
At that time, he even thought, did the Holy Saintess have fallen for Hero Luke?
Or else, why would she remove one force from the demon frontline to his territory?
After all, almost all of the church’s members remain at the border of the Demon Continent all year round.
Otherwise, they would risk losing more ground.
But now seeing Luke’s territory, the strength of Silver Knights, and the subordinates, he got completely surprised.
"The Saintess really has future sight." He praised Saintess wisdom, before also moving toward the main gate.

chapters.title: Chapter 257: Another One?! How Many Women Does He Have?!
paragraphs: "Halt." The guards stopped Theia and Sunrath. Because bringing a giant beast inside the main territory was not allowed.
Theia from the above ordered Sunrath to stopped and waited for Luke. After all, he had already told them to wait for him here.
Seeing this, both Bronze Knight guards exchanged confused glances, because normally at this time.
Beings of this level often complained, while also showing clear dissatisfaction.
Since this had already happened during these 20 days.
While they were waiting, the surrounding passersby, from adventurers to merchants and citizens, also stopped to watch the show.
Considering the earlier incident, they wanted to see what would happen this time.
Still, many were discussing who this beautiful woman and her pet was. After all, present among the crowd were some knowledgeable people, who knew the names of almost every surrounding B rank beings.
"Lord is here!" Suddenly these words echoed throughout the area, which resulted in everyone’s faces turning toward the other side.
There, the commander of the Templar Knights was walking alongside a handsome man, 7 feet tall.
Which made them confused.
"Where is the lord?"
But when they focused on the man again, they came to sudden realization that this handsome man, with shoulder-length black hair and a perfect build, was their lord.
The Baron Luke.
Which maked them completely shocked.
"Lord has changed so much, and he has become even more handsome." Few young maidens, no matter from which group, utter those words from their mouths.
"Greetings, My Lord." The moment he reached the main gate, the two guards immediately saluted him.
"Meow~" And Sunrath also meowed, while moving close to Luke.
Seeing this scene, everyone became speechless.
Because for the first time, they had seen a gigantic Lion beast meowing in front of someone.
Even the Templar commander raised his brow at this.
’This Lion seems special.’ He became even more surprised after finding this discovery.
But when he tried to analyze Theia, he became confused.
’Why does she feel like a mortal? who doesn’t have any mana or Aether in them?’ And this thought came into his mind.
Though Theia didn’t notice his confused face, but instead she dismounted Sunrath and moved close to Luke.
"Master." She bowed, while saying.
"No! the womanizer got another beautiful woman!" But at that exact moment, someone from the crowd shouted with lost voice.
Upon that, Luke’s mouth twitched with absurdity.
Because this Womanizer tag now always seemed to keep rotating around him.
"Ahem!" Luke coughed to remove the awkwardness, before nodding at everyone.
’Let’s leave this place, before a few more women somehow get added to my womanizer list.’ he thought, while observing the thristy gaze of few young maidens.
Sadly, he thought this very early. Because the very next moment, a high-pitched sound came.
"Master!!!"
Followed by a cannonball that aimed directly at Luke.
Of course, thats what other people saw, and sadly Luke included among them as well.
After all, he was not in his titan form. So currently his senses only belongs to Talented Silver knight.
But Solan completely saw, who this cannonball was.
’Aurora.’
And the next moment, the cannonball—cough!—Aurora hugged Luke tightly.
"Master, I miss you so much!" She started rubbing Luke’s face against her huge melons, clearly not minding the jealous glares of the surrounding bachelors.
"So lucky."
"Those melons, haven’t they become even bigger?"
Different kinds of words escaped from the crowd mouths, but Luke didn’t have the leisure to hear them.
’Ughh! Can’t breathe!’ Luke cursed Aurora’s big melons and her tight hug.
Because it seemed he was about to die from suffocation.
So when he was about to be hugged to death by those merciless melon, a savior’s sweet voice came.
"Aurora, let Luke breathe."
Aurielle said with a normal face, like she was not surprised by Luke’s sudden appearance.
"Huff...Huff..." The moment Aurora released Luke, he exhaled air, like a dying person finally getting the freedom to breathe.
"Aurielle, my darling." Then he gave a death glare to the already timid Aurora, before moving toward the calm-faced Aurielle.
He hugged her slightly, before releasing it next moment.
After all, they were in public and he didn’t want to create more of the show for the crowd to watch, which was already created because of Aurora.
But again, he was stopped by another greeting.
"Greetings, Hero Luke."
The managers of the Blacksmith, Adventurer, Merchant, and even the old man of the Alchemist came outside this time and greeted him.
Seeing Jasper and an old man beside him, clearly his grandpa, who had earlier protected his territory from the B rank being,
he smiled and returned the greeting.
"Greetings, Sir and Madam."
"And also thanks for earlier, while I was in the middle of cultivation." He expressed his thanks, bringing a few awed glances from the spectators.
After all, who didn’t want to make connections with these guilds?
Yet despite waiting for years, they ended up without any chance to meet.
Once all the greetings were done, Luke and his company moved toward the mansion’s guest area.
Where he had to properly thank them and also talk about a few things.
Unfortunately, Solan had to go.
"Sorry, Hero Luke." He gave an apologetic smile to Luke, before telling.
"We have already stayed here for too long, and now we have to return back to the demon border."
Seeing nothing could be done, Luke gave him a grateful smile and thanked him for his earlier help.
"All of this happened because the Saintess ordered it."
"So you should thank her."
"I will." Luke nodded.
With that, Solan and his legion of Templar Knights left the Blackstone Highlands territory.
"Sigh." Seeing this, Luke sighed exhaustedly.
After all, Solan was still an A rank being. And not a normal one, but he seemed even more special than Magnus, who was also an peak A rank being.
So talking with this high-rank being was taxing for his mind.
He didn’t know if it was because they were high rank, which resulted in releasing some of their pressure unconsciously, or something else.
From the side, except Raya Tempestas, the others also looked toward the departing Templar Knights with reverence.
Because even they rarely saw a single A-rank being, but here a full legion was here.
"Let’s talk inside." Luke said to all of them, including the Alchemist Association manager.
Who seemed more behaved than his usual style.
Why wouldn’t he be?
Because the Saintess seemed to personally be interested in this hero, so this meant Luke’s value had also become high.
That was why, just after Solan and his legion entered the territory, he got a command from the main guild.
To increase the investment value and recruit Luke.
The same thing happened with the other managers as well.
But only Jasper had already succeeded in this, for which he even got praise from the main guild and other benefits.

chapters.title: Chapter 258: I Hate You, But I Also... Love You
paragraphs: After that, all of them settled on the sofas inside the guest room.
Though, only Luke and the guild managers were here, not Aurielle and the others.
"Sir Luke, I would like to invite you to collaborate with us." Chalybs Cinder, the manager of the Blacksmith Guild, said with a big smile.
Luke just nodded and looked toward the others.
Seeing his behavior, none of them took it to heart. After all, with the earlier involvement of the Saintess and Templar Knights,
Luke had the capital to be arrogant.
He also noticed this expression on their faces, but didn’t clarify that the Luke standing before them was not the same Luke.
It was Luke who had B rank strength.
And he was also meeting with them because of their earlier goodwill. Or else he wouldn’t even meet with them.
Of course, the Alchemist Guild didn’t come into that.
Seeing that the other three also wanted to make him promote their guilds, he presented his side of the deal as well.
"Sir Chalybs." He looked straight into his eyes.
"I want armor and weapons of E rank and D rank." With that, he told him the number.
║ GRAND TOTAL ║
║ Order ║ Quantity ║ Price/Set ║ Total ║
║ E-Rank (Bronze) ║ 10,000 ║ 8 Gold ║ 80,000 ║
The price he calculated roughly would be this.
And why he asked for E rank and D rank gear?
Because he didn’t have that, and for below, he still had thousands of sets.
Chalybs also calculated the price, which was roughly 500k gold coins. That was a huge amount, which could even freak out a Count’s forces.
So he lost in thought and started doing some calculations.
Seeing this, Luke shifted his attention from him to Hermes Bane, the manager of the Alchemist Guild.
"Sir Hermes." He greeted him again, at which he returned the greeting with smile.
"Here is my deal toward The Wolf’s Bane guild." With that he told him the list.
║ POTION QUANTITY ║
║ Potion ║ Rank ║ Quantity ║
But the number was double, 1m gold coins grand total.
Luke did this knowingly. First, he needed E rank and above potions.
After all, his healing spring and mana well weren’t suitable for Bronze Knights and above.
Second, he was giving a chance to him.
Considering his earlier absence when the other managers showed up to protect his territory, but he didn’t.
So if he really wanted to work with him, then he had to at least bleed this much money.
Hermes also understood this after checking the price.
Which was even hard for him, and he had to ask for help from the main guild.
Fortunately, he could patch up the relationship between them with money, which was good for him.
Because if the main guild found out that Hero Luke didn’t want to work with them due to his fault, then his punishment would not be light at all.
"I accept, Sir Luke." Both Chalybs and Hermes said at the same time.
"Good." Luke smiled, before turning his gaze toward the demi-human, a royal tiger woman, Raya Tempest.
From her face, Luke could clearly see that she didn’t care about all this stuff and was doing this because her family had given the order.
"Lady Raya." He said with a genuine smile.
Because his clone did mention that from start to end, she helped his territory during his absence.
Even though she had done it because Aurora and she had become friends, still, he was grateful for her.
"Lady Raya, my demand is very simple."
"Anyone registering as an adventurer from Blackstone or my territory will get 10% more benefit from your Adventurer guild for one year."
He also added that if the adventurer changed their alignment after this, then this benefit would be removed and they wouldn’t be able to get it back.
Hearing Luke’s words, Raya raised her eyebrow in surprise.
Because she didn’t expect Luke to ask something from her as well. Even though this money would be paid by her family and the guild,
still, she was surprised.
Though she became even more so when he presented the deal.
Which would clearly attract new adventurers to his territory, making the economy and other sectors grow.
While also placing a safekeeping method, so they wouldn’t be able to exploit the benefits.
Thinking this, she smiled before announcing her answer, "I agree.
Upon this, Luke also smiled.
After the deal was done, all four left, along with Jasper.
Who was grinning all the time, since he got on Luke’s good side earlier and now he was getting the benefit of it.
"Sigh, I want to rest." Seeing their departing figures, Luke sighed.
Because yesterday daytime, he spent all his time making love with Theia.
And right after that, they left for the territory. So from yesterday he hadn’t slept.
Even though he was now Silver Knight level, a real titan, he still held his old habit of sleep.
As he was thinking all of those, he heard a familiar voice, which immediately removed all of his sleepiness.
"Luke."
Aurielle called out slowly to him, before walking inside the guest room.
After getting close to Luke, she held his face with her soft hand and looked straight into his blue eyes.
"Where were you all this time?" She asked worriedly.
Even though earlier at the market she didn’t show any of these signs,
only she knew how much worried she had been all this time.
How many nights she had cried when she found, after waking from her sleep, that he was not beside her.
"Did you not think of me even once?" She asked again, this time tears came out from her eyes.
"I did." He wiped away those tears gently, only to had his hand slapped away.
"Liar!" She shouted, clearly angry at him.
"If you did! then why didn’t you come back!" She yelled with a face full of tears and forcefully grabbed both of his collars.
"For 20 days, you were gone!"
"But for me, it was 600 days, inside that Time Chamber!" She brought her face close to his, their noses even pressed against each other.
Still Luke remained quiet. He let Aurielle bring out her frustration, her fear, everything at him.
Since he knew he was at fault somewhere.
Even though he never calculated that he would sleep for 20 days, still he had done his breakthrough without telling her.
Which he knew was the right decision. After all, too many uncertainties were linked with his Origin skill, and even more when he got the Origin Titan fragment.
"Sorry." He only said this, before bringing both of his hand slowly around her waist and wrapping around it.
"I don’t need your SORRY!" Aurielle shouted and tried to break free from his hug, but couldn’t able to succeed.
Since she didn’t use her strength at all.
"I hate you..." She whispered those words, while burying her face in his chest.
"I am sorry." But Luke only repeated this, while keep caressing her back gently and lovingly.
"I hate you..." She again whispered those words, but this time she also wrapped her hands around Luke tightly. Clearly didn’t want to lose him again.
"But I also love you." She whispered those words very slowly, that if they were not this close, then even he wouldn’t be able to hear them.
Hearing this, a smile appeared upon his lips. "I also love you." He kissed her head, before bringing her body into an even tighter hug.
Like she was doing with him now.
Where none of them wanted to separate from each other anymore.

sentences.text: After that, all of them settled on the sofas inside the guest room.
Though, only Luke and the guild managers were here, not Aurielle and the others.
"Sir Luke, I would like to invite you to collaborate with us." Chalybs Cinder, the manager of the Blacksmith Guild, said with a big smile.
Luke just nodded and looked toward the others.
Seeing his behavior, none of them took it to heart.
After all, with the earlier involvement of the Saintess and Templar Knights,
Luke had the capital to be arrogant.
He also noticed this expression on their faces, but didn’t clarify that the Luke standing before them was not the same Luke.
It was Luke who had B rank strength.
And he was also meeting with them because of their earlier goodwill.
Or else he wouldn’t even meet with them.
Of course, the Alchemist Guild didn’t come into that.
Seeing that the other three also wanted to make him promote their guilds, he presented his side of the deal as well.
"Sir Chalybs." He looked straight into his eyes.
"I want armor and weapons of E rank and D rank." With that, he told him the number.
║ GRAND TOTAL ║
║ Order ║ Quantity ║ Price/Set ║ Total ║
║ E-Rank (Bronze) ║ 10,000 ║ 8 Gold ║ 80,000 ║
The price he calculated roughly would be this.
And why he asked for E rank and D rank gear?
Because he didn’t have that, and for below, he still had thousands of sets.
Chalybs also calculated the price, which was roughly 500k gold coins.
That was a huge amount, which could even freak out a Count’s forces.
So he lost in thought and started doing some calculations.
Seeing this, Luke shifted his attention from him to Hermes Bane, the manager of the Alchemist Guild.
"Sir Hermes." He greeted him again, at which he returned the greeting with smile.
"Here is my deal toward The Wolf’s Bane guild." With that he told him the list.
║ POTION QUANTITY ║
║ Potion ║ Rank ║ Quantity ║
But the number was double, 1m gold coins grand total.
Luke did this knowingly.
First, he needed E rank and above potions.
After all, his healing spring and mana well weren’t suitable for Bronze Knights and above.
Second, he was giving a chance to him.
Considering his earlier absence when the other managers showed up to protect his territory, but he didn’t.
So if he really wanted to work with him, then he had to at least bleed this much money.
Hermes also understood this after checking the price.
Which was even hard for him, and he had to ask for help from the main guild.
Fortunately, he could patch up the relationship between them with money, which was good for him.
Because if the main guild found out that Hero Luke didn’t want to work with them due to his fault, then his punishment would not be light at all.
"I accept, Sir Luke." Both Chalybs and Hermes said at the same time.
"Good." Luke smiled, before turning his gaze toward the demi-human, a royal tiger woman, Raya Tempest.
From her face, Luke could clearly see that she didn’t care about all this stuff and was doing this because her family had given the order.
"Lady Raya." He said with a genuine smile.
Because his clone did mention that from start to end, she helped his territory during his absence.
Even though she had done it because Aurora and she had become friends, still, he was grateful for her.
"Lady Raya, my demand is very simple."
"Anyone registering as an adventurer from Blackstone or my territory will get 10% more benefit from your Adventurer guild for one year."
He also added that if the adventurer changed their alignment after this, then this benefit would be removed and they wouldn’t be able to get it back.
Hearing Luke’s words, Raya raised her eyebrow in surprise.
Because she didn’t expect Luke to ask something from her as well.
Even though this money would be paid by her family and the guild,
still, she was surprised.
Though she became even more so when he presented the deal.
Which would clearly attract new adventurers to his territory, making the economy and other sectors grow.
While also placing a safekeeping method, so they wouldn’t be able to exploit the benefits.
Thinking this, she smiled before announcing her answer, "I agree.
Upon this, Luke also smiled.
After the deal was done, all four left, along with Jasper.
Who was grinning all the time, since he got on Luke’s good side earlier and now he was getting the benefit of it.
"Sigh, I want to rest." Seeing their departing figures, Luke sighed.
Because yesterday daytime, he spent all his time making love with Theia.
And right after that, they left for the territory.
So from yesterday he hadn’t slept.
Even though he was now Silver Knight level, a real titan, he still held his old habit of sleep.
As he was thinking all of those, he heard a familiar voice, which immediately removed all of his sleepiness.
"Luke."
Aurielle called out slowly to him, before walking inside the guest room.
After getting close to Luke, she held his face with her soft hand and looked straight into his blue eyes.
"Where were you all this time?" She asked worriedly.
Even though earlier at the market she didn’t show any of these signs,
only she knew how much worried she had been all this time.
How many nights she had cried when she found, after waking from her sleep, that he was not beside her.
"Did you not think of me even once?" She asked again, this time tears came out from her eyes.
"I did." He wiped away those tears gently, only to had his hand slapped away.
"Liar!" She shouted, clearly angry at him.
"If you did! then why didn’t you come back!" She yelled with a face full of tears and forcefully grabbed both of his collars.
"For 20 days, you were gone!"
"But for me, it was 600 days, inside that Time Chamber!" She brought her face close to his, their noses even pressed against each other.
Still Luke remained quiet.
He let Aurielle bring out her frustration, her fear, everything at him.
Since he knew he was at fault somewhere.

chapters.title: Chapter 259: Caught Peeking at Their Master
paragraphs: Rustle, rustle...
Then a low rustle, along with a few whispers, came from outside.
"But... I wanna hug Master too..." Aurora said in a childlike, pleading voice.
Still, Vaelira held her tightly.
"Ahh... Master looks so handsome now..." Elena murmured from behind the door, her voice tinged with surprise and longing.
"Yeah, Lord has really grown taller... and handsome, too." Margaret leaned against the door, peeking inside with a surprised smile.
Outside, all four had gathered the moment Aurielle came inside.
So they heard everything from the start.
Inside, Luke and Aurielle were still in a hugged position. But they could clearly hear the outside chatter.
"You brought them?" He asked, without breaking the hug.
"Your’s summons, so you know how clingy they are." Aurielle rebuked, clearly shifting blame to Luke.
This brought a short silence among them, which broke the next moment by the sound of the gate opening.
The four women continued leaning against the door, completely absorbed in watching Luke.
Unfortunately, the door wasn’t nearly as interested in cooperating.
Click.
The latch suddenly gave way.
"Eh?"
The door swung open.
"W-Wait!"
THUD!
The three of them—Elena, Aurora, and Margaret—lost their balance and fell straight into the room, landing on top of one another.
"Ouch!"
"Get off me!"
"I can’t! You’re on top of me!"
Meanwhile, Vaelira was still standing outside.
She quietly looked at the pile of three women on the floor.
"...We were never here."
Sadly, Luke was not blind.
"Really?" He asked playfully, before turning toward them.
"Master, it was all Elena’s fault." Seeing Luke’s gaze, Aurora sold Elena instantly.
Upon this, Elena gave her a betrayed glare, but still lowered her gaze.
"Master..." She whispered slowly, clearly afraid of him getting angry.
However, he just sighed and broke his hug.
"You guys." He moved close to them, before helping each of them get up.
Soon, all four women stood in a horizontal line, with lowered faces.
Aurielle came from behind with a smile on her face.
Due to having, spent a long time together, now she didn’t feel jealous toward them.
That was why she was calm, and even knowing that they were outside, she let it be.
"Master, we missed you." Aurora said, before raising her face slightly.
There, Luke was calmly looking at them. His face didn’t seem angry.
"Me too." He said smilingly, before rubbing Aurora’s head gently.
Seeing this, they became relaxed and smiles returned upon their faces.
Elena also came forward, clearly asking for a pat.
Luke obliged and gave her a gentle rubbing as well.
A few moments later, he removed his hand from their heads.
Which clearly made both of their faces fall, though they didn’t say anything.
"Let’s go inside the Time Chamber." He said, and everyone nodded.
After spending some time with all of them, Luke came to the Office building.
"That was tiring." He rubbed the bridge of his nose, clearly tired.
Since none of the women wanted to separate from him, he ended up spending the whole day together.
"With the Time Chamber, Theia could recover fast."
Luke murmured the words softly, almost to himself, before his gaze drifted toward the Mana Well.

There, bathed in the gentle azure glow of the well’s perpetual light, Theia sat cross-legged upon the smooth stone platform. Her long purple hair cascaded down her back like a waterfall of amethyst silk, catching the soft luminescence.
Her eyes were closed, her breathing slow and rhythmic—lost in deep meditation.

The Mana Well pulsed gently behind her, its liquid light swirling in continuos spirals of blue and silver. Tiny motes of pure energy drifted upward like fireflies, some brushing against her skin before dissolving into nothing. The air around her shimmered with a faint, ethereal warmth, as if the very essence of the world was embracing her.
Though her mana pathways remained damaged—each passing moment within the Time Chamber brought her closer to wholeness.
Luke watched her for a long moment, his expression unreadable. In the quiet of the chamber, with only the soft hum of the Mana Well and the gentle rhythm of her breathing, there was a strange peace.
Then he shifted his attention back to the summary report. Clearly it was not time for being romantic.
The report which contained the info of everyone’s progress and some major work.
"Let’s see." With that he opened and read about the higher rank powerhouses of Blackstone.
"Aurora and Vaelira both have reached mid-golden knight." He raised his eyebrow in surprise.
Aurora reaching mid-stage seemed understandable, after all she was already an early Gold Knight.
"But Vaelira?"
Then he remembered she was the holder of an S rank Origin skill, so her progress naturally would be faster.
"No wonder she crossed half-golden and reached mid-golden in 600 days."
After that, he checked if anyone else had reached Golden Knight. Though he wasn’t very optimistic about this.
Surprisingly, the result said something else.
"Peter Bassus and Aurielle also reached early golden knight."
"Damn, they are really something." He said with an excited voice.
Because this meant! his territory now held five genuine Golden Knights.
"Only Viscount forces could have this." He commented, but then he shook his head.
"My higher forces are even stronger than a Viscount..."
"Since I have Theia, a B rank being." He nodded after analyzing the information.
But he knew he was nowhere close to Count forces.
After all, for being a Count of the Human region, the leader or the noble should have at least one peak B rank being.
"That was why Counts were only a few in the entire human kingdom, while Marquis and Dukes were even lower." He uttered softly, before changing the page, which contained the list of lower rank units.
"10 Silver Knights, belonging to the earlier Blackstone Legion, and Osric also made some progress." He checked the number and found
that each of them had now reached the 6th stage of Silver Knight, while their earlier stage was 3rd.

"They are making progress, that’s already a big thing." He commented, because they didn’t have any Origin skill, and even that much progress was made thanks to the high Aether of the Mana Well, which was helping somewhat even at their level.
But the main thing was the Ascension series.
There was also another data added, "100 E-Rank Aether Crystal Mines had produced 100,000 Perfect E-Rank Aether Crystals, each 50 per month, so in 600 days that much produced."
Reading this, a big grin appeared upon his lips. Because those resources could help his territory tremendously.

chapters.title: Chapter 260: Luke’s First Grand Journey
paragraphs: And he didn’t have to buy any cultivation resources for E rank, Bronze Knights anymore.
Which proved, just as he read the next information.
"120 Bronze Knights | 20 Territory Guards + 100 Newly Upgraded Archers had reached peak of Bronze Knights."
Clearly, this was impossible to reach even in 600 days.
After all, they didn’t have any talent, only Ascension series.
So with the help of the dense Aether region of the Time Chamber and consuming 95,800 perfect E rank Aether crystals (valued at ~6.2 Million Gold), they were able to reach this stage.
Then he also checked how many Aether crystals each knight consumed on average at each stage.
35 Perfect E-Rank Crystals per knight (5 → 10 → 20 scaling).
"No wonder Barons have so few Bronze Knights." He murmured with a speechless expression, after checking that training 120 peak Bronze Knights took him 6.2m gold coins.
If in this we calculate gold coins for a single knight, then it would be roughly
"2,275 Gold coins."
While the average Baron’s annual income was just around 10,000 gold coins.
"I also produced them in the matter of 20 days." Luke noticed the time difference.
Fortunately, he didn’t have to buy resources for them, or else he would have gone bankrupt.
After that, he checked the data about Iron Knights and Body Temper together.
But the result made him angry.
"It can’t be helped." He leaned against his chair and looked at the ceiling.
Where now a drawing of a cute rabbit had been made.
"Clearly, Aurora would have done this." Seeing this, his earlier frustration reduced.
"No new knights, not even Body Temper or merchants came into the territory during those 20 days." He repeated the info with a knowing face.
After all, who would dare to come to a territory where B rank and A rank beings had come to the door?
"I hope the situation will be fixed now." He closed the file, since the last info was this and the number of Iron Knights.
"When I left the territory, there were around 10,100 Body Temper soldiers." | 100 (Original Territory) + 10,000 (New Recruits) |
"And they were already gone through Aurora’s oath binding."
The results?
During those 600 days of the Time Chamber, everyone had reached Peak Iron Knight stage.
Didn’t matter if they were talented or not.
"Sadly, the 10 Berserker Silver Knights and Taron, who were at the border, didn’t get this benefit."
"So their realm remains the same." He muttered with dissatisfaction, because the matter regarding the border seemed to be escalating with each passing day.
"Like someone was fanning the flames." He narrowed his eyes upon this and linked the Marquis of the demi-human with this.
But after a moment later, he shook his head to remove those thoughts.
Since he already had many things to do.
"So no time for border issues..."
"Atleast now."
After that, he gave a normal look toward the number of Iron Knights breakthrough. "6,030 Iron Knights | 30 (Guards/Maids) + 5,000 (Veterans Upgraded) + 1,000 (New Recruits) and then closed the file.
Then he separated their file, and checked another one, which contained the Windmarch soldiers report.
"They also need to rank up soon." He commented, while going through.
"Hmm... The 1,000 km long road of the South Ashveil trade route had been completed and all the units were also assigned."
Reading this, he nodded with satisfaction. Because there was another note which said
"All the previous merchants chose to build warehouses in Blackstone."
This was great news.
And another great news came, "Windmarch Reach had been fully captured."
"Great." Luke nodded, before thinking about future plans.
"Even though I am leaving for the Human Kingdom capital today,"
"I still have to make a plan for the clone."
Yes, today he would leave the territory, since only one day was left for Selene’s arrival.
And telling about this to Aurielle?
"Nah, I don’t want her to become yandere." He immediately denied that thought.
Because they had already discussed earlier that he would not go there.
Plus, the recent events had already made Aurielle very sensitive.
So if he asked her permission, he knew for sure
that she would cut off both his legs to make him stay in the territory.
After removing those ominous thoughts, he brought his attention back to the development of the territory.
"Yeah, that will do." He immediately thought about the earlier plan.
In which his clone would continue expanding the territory along with capturing the Stormhowl Mountains.
"And these new numbers of knights would be going to provide tremendous help." He added this part with deep satisfaction.
Because he was spending money on his knights, so they could come in handy for this type of timing.
Once all this planning was done, he thought about the Viscount forces.
"They dared to threaten me and my territory." He muttered with narrowed eyes.
Tap. Tap. Tap.
Then he tapped his fingers on the desk.
"What should I do with them?" He made one plan after another.
Then he checked the map of Blackstone and its surroundings.
"Oh..." After seeing that, he raised his eyebrow in surprise.
Because Windmarch Reach, the territory of the late Viscount Aldaric and now his, was connecting five other Viscount territories directly.
Then it connected to Blackstone Highlands.
"So he wanted to capture Blackstone, because his territory was already blocking the main choke points."
"But merchants could still pass through other territories and reach Blackstone to travel to the South trade route."
Upon this Luke praised the late Viscount Aldaric.
Because if he had really succeeded, then he would had a monopoly on the South trade route and could demand huge taxes from other Viscount forces or even everyone.
"Sadly, I became the lord of Blackstone." Luke smiled and brought his attention back to the closest five Viscount territories.
"Should I play economic warfare?" He thought with calculations.
In that, he could target the popular products of their territories, so merchants and other people would come to his territory to buy those.
Which would result in their economies collapsing soon.
"Or should I just directly kill them?" He also thought this, which seemed like the best idea.
But the next moment he shook his head.
"Aldaric’s territory was close to the border, so it took time for people to come when the earlier incident happened."
"But if I attack one place, then the others would become wary and may even request help from other forces."
Thinking this, he removed his earlier plan of assassination.
Sadly, he was already maintaining active clones, or else he could use them for far assassination attempts as well.
"Well, let them live for a few more days." So Luke decided that his clone, who would make the assassin group, would take care of them.
"Now it’s time for a NEW ADVENTURE." Luke muttered excitedly. After all, this journey would be his first where he would really travel far distance and see many new things.

Then he separated their file, and checked another one, which contained the Windmarch soldiers report.
"They also need to rank up soon." He commented, while going through.
"Hmm...
The 1,000 km long road of the South Ashveil trade route had been completed and all the units were also assigned."
Reading this, he nodded with satisfaction.
Because there was another note which said
"All the previous merchants chose to build warehouses in Blackstone."
This was great news.
And another great news came, "Windmarch Reach had been fully captured."
"Great." Luke nodded, before thinking about future plans.
"Even though I am leaving for the Human Kingdom capital today,"
"I still have to make a plan for the clone."
Yes, today he would leave the territory, since only one day was left for Selene’s arrival.
And telling about this to Aurielle?
"Nah, I don’t want her to become yandere." He immediately denied that thought.
Because they had already discussed earlier that he would not go there.
Plus, the recent events had already made Aurielle very sensitive.
So if he asked her permission, he knew for sure
that she would cut off both his legs to make him stay in the territory.
After removing those ominous thoughts, he brought his attention back to the development of the territory.
"Yeah, that will do." He immediately thought about the earlier plan.
In which his clone would continue expanding the territory along with capturing the Stormhowl Mountains.
"And these new numbers of knights would be going to provide tremendous help." He added this part with deep satisfaction.
Because he was spending money on his knights, so they could come in handy for this type of timing.
Once all this planning was done, he thought about the Viscount forces.
"They dared to threaten me and my territory." He muttered with narrowed eyes.
Tap.
Tap.
Tap.
Then he tapped his fingers on the desk.
"What should I do with them?" He made one plan after another.
Then he checked the map of Blackstone and its surroundings.
"Oh..." After seeing that, he raised his eyebrow in surprise.
Because Windmarch Reach, the territory of the late Viscount Aldaric and now his, was connecting five other Viscount territories directly.
Then it connected to Blackstone Highlands.
"So he wanted to capture Blackstone, because his territory was already blocking the main choke points."
"But merchants could still pass through other territories and reach Blackstone to travel to the South trade route."
Upon this Luke praised the late Viscount Aldaric.
Because if he had really succeeded, then he would had a monopoly on the South trade route and could demand huge taxes from other Viscount forces or even everyone.
"Sadly, I became the lord of Blackstone." Luke smiled and brought his attention back to the closest five Viscount territories.
"Should I play economic warfare?" He thought with calculations.
In that, he could target the popular products of their territories, so merchants and other people would come to his territory to buy those.
Which would result in their economies collapsing soon.
"Or should I just directly kill them?" He also thought this, which seemed like the best idea.
But the next moment he shook his head.
"Aldaric’s territory was close to the border, so it took time for people to come when the earlier incident happened."
"But if I attack one place, then the others would become wary and may even request help from other forces."
Thinking this, he removed his earlier plan of assassination.
Sadly, he was already maintaining active clones, or else he could use them for far assassination attempts as well.
"Well, let them live for a few more days." So Luke decided that his clone, who would make the assassin group, would take care of them.
"Now it’s time for a NEW ADVENTURE." Luke muttered excitedly.
After all, this journey would be his first where he would really travel far distance and see many new things.

But I am truly gratefull to all of you.
So here is the main thing.
This is not voulme end, but it’s still half of Voulume II.
After this, the story will be divided into different-different scenario.
Like, Luke clone, growing their group.
Each of them would going to screen time.
While the starting part is definetly belongs to Luke and Selene reunion.
Yeah, I am excited for this.
So all other things, will keep happening in background.

chapters.title: Chapter 261: The Journey to See Her
paragraphs: The city was already alive before the sun had fully climbed above the distant rooftops.

Wide stone roads stretched between rows of tall buildings, their walls decorated with banners bearing the crest of the Eldric Sunborn human kingdom. Wooden carts rolled through the streets, merchants shouted from both sides of the road, and the constant clatter of boots, hooves, and wagon wheels filled the air.
"Fresh apples! Three copper for a basket!"
"Three? You robbed a dragon recently or something? Two copper!"
"Two? Do you think these grow on trees?"
"They literally do!"
"...Get out of my stall."
Laughter erupted from a group of nearby customers.
The marketplace continued far beyond them.
A young human woman walked past while carrying a basket filled with bread, carefully avoiding a dwarf merchant who was pushing a cart overflowing with shining metal tools.
"Move aside! Move aside!"
"Hey! Watch where you’re going!"
"I am watching!"
"You’re watching the road behind you!"
"That’s why I’m telling you to move!"
The dwarf barely managed to turn his cart before crashing into a passing carriage.
"Oi!"
The carriage driver pulled on the reins.
"Easy, easy!"
The horses neighed and stopped, their hooves scraping against the stone road.
"Are you blind?" the driver shouted.
The dwarf raised both hands.
"I’m a blacksmith, not a fortune teller!"
"You almost crushed my carriage!"
"And you almost crushed my tools!"
"Your tools are worth less than my carriage!"
"Then your carriage must be made of gold!"
"Enough!"
A city guard standing nearby finally stepped between them.
"Both of you. Keep moving."
The two merchants glared at each other.
"He started it," they said at the exact same time.
The guard sighed.
"Of course."
He rubbed his forehead before pointing toward opposite ends of the street.
"Go."
The two reluctantly separated.
Yet neither stopped muttering.
"Stubborn dwarf..."
"Arrogant human..."
The scene repeated itself throughout the city.

Humans walked beside half-elves with long ears and elegant robes. Beastfolk with fox, wolf, cat, and rabbit ears moved through the crowd, some carrying goods while others browsed the merchant stalls. A pair of blue-scaled lizardmen stood beside a spice stall, arguing over the price of a strange red herb.
"Five silver."
"Four."
"Five."
"Four and I’ll take three bundles.
The merchant stared at him.
"...You’re terrible at bargaining."
The lizardman smiled.
"I have been told that before."
"Fine. Four silver."
"Excellent."
"Now leave before I change my mind."
A few steps away, a young half-elf girl stared at a stall filled with colorful gemstones.
"Mother! Look!"
Her mother immediately grabbed her hand.
"No."
"But I haven’t even asked!"
"I know that look."
"Just one!"
"No."
"Half of one?"
The mother stopped walking.
"Gemstones don’t come in halves."
"They could."
"They don’t."
The girl pouted.
Nearby, a group of adventurers sat around a wooden table outside a busy tavern.
"I told you that was a fire drake!"
"You called it a dragon."
"It was dark!"
"You also said it had six wings."
"I was under pressure!"
"You were hiding behind me."
"I was strategically positioned behind you."
Their companions burst into laughter.
A serving girl emerged from the tavern carrying several mugs.
"Here you go. Two ales, three ciders, and one glass of milk."
The largest man at the table stared at the milk.
"Who ordered that?"
A small rabbit beastfolk raised her hand.
"Me."
Everyone looked at her.
She calmly took the glass.
"I have to work tomorrow."
The large man nodded solemnly.
"Wise."
A moment later, the street erupted with another cry.
"Make way!
People immediately stepped aside.
A merchant caravan entered the main road, several large wagons pulled by thick-skinned magical beasts. Their bodies were covered in dark scales, while faint blue light glowed beneath them.
"Whoa..."
Children gathered near the roadside.
"Look at those beasts!"
"They’re bigger than horses!"
"Can we touch them?"
"No!"
"Why?"
"Because they can eat you."
The children immediately took three steps back.
The merchant riding at the front laughed.
"Don’t worry! They’re well trained!"
One of the beasts suddenly opened its mouth and let out a deep growl.
The children screamed and ran away.
The merchant blinked.
"...Mostly trained."
The city continued to move around them.
Coins changed hands.
Goods changed owners.
Rumors traveled faster than merchants.

Aether crystals glittered beneath the sunlight in one stall, while enchanted weapons hung from another. Potion sellers called out their prices, food vendors filled the street with the smell of roasted meat and freshly baked bread, and somewhere in the distance, a mage was loudly arguing with a customer about the proper price of a fireball scroll.
"That’s an intermediate spell!"
"Your sign says twenty silver!"
"That sign is from yesterday!"
"Then change the sign!"
"I will!"
"When?"
"Tomorrow!"
"That doesn’t help me today!"
The surrounding crowd laughed.
Above it all, a massive island was floating, the great HORIZON ASTRALIS ACADEMY of the human kingdom, their enchanted crystals glowing faintly even beneath the afternoon sun.
This was no quiet capital.
It was a city where humans, half-elves, dwarves, beastfolk, merchants, adventurers, mages, and many other races crossed their paths every day.
A city where swords clattered against armor, merchants fought over copper coins, children chased one another through crowded streets, and magic was as common as the smell of fresh bread.
And in the middle of all that noise and chaos...
Another ordinary day in the Sunborn City, the Capital of Eldric Sunborn kingdom had begun.
"I am here." Luke muttered while inhaling the fresh air and enjoying the scenery.
He was in his normal human form, without any disguise.
Shoulder length black hair, blue eyes that were calm as a gentle lake.
"Selene, how have you been." Thinking about her, he moved toward Horizon Academy with steady steps.
After crossing the busy roads of the capital, he reached the location from where anyone could enter Horizon Academy.
Ofcourse, they had to pay the entrance fees.
There was an oversized circle platform, glowing with thousands of runes, which he couldn’t understand at all.
"Flying is prohibited." He read the warning calmly, since he didn’t have any plan to fly there.

chapters.title: Chapter 262: One Handsome Man, One Huge Misunderstanding
paragraphs: After all, huge magic cannons along with hundreds of attacks were pointing downward and even at the same level.
So if someone was really foolish enough to ignore those warnings, then those attacks would teach them all the lessons.
"Today’s line is big."
"Didn’t you know? that the Empyrean Academy representative is coming here today."
"That’s why this huge line."
Luke listened to people’s gossip, while staying obediently in the line.
He also noticed that there was another line present. Even though it was completely empty, no one was daring to enter there.
Soon, he came to understand the reason.
Two young human girls, each wearing the uniform of Horizon Academy, hastily moved toward the other lines.
"Let’s go fast, or else we’ll be late for Professor Isaria’s class." one girl with black hair said hurriedly, at which the other girl with black hair nodded.
’Isaria? the daughter of Jasper?’ Hearing the name, Luke immediately remembered the invitation he had got from Jasper.
And also his words, "She is a professor in Horizon Academy and you could take her help."
Remembering those words, he separated from the normal people’s line and moved toward the two students.
Seeing this, a few people muttered with mockery, while others voice’s held pity.
"Another fool thinking that he is someone special."
They commented, while recalling the same scene, where a few dashing young men or women tried to impress the students of Horizon Academy, only to have their hopes shattered the next moment.
"Seems like he didn’t know..." One young woman said with pity.
"That those students are high class, nobles, or specials."
Which was one reason that they didn’t get interested in some random party.
"Still it’s a pity for his looks." She muttered with a yearning voice, because Luke was too handsome.
Luke with his enhanced senses heard every word, which twitched his mouth.
But he completely ignored them and kept moving toward the two female students.
Seeing someone coming, they became annoyed. After all, it was not the first time that someone was trying to impress them.
Though, when they turned to look at the person, they became stunned.
"So handsome." And unconsciously, those words escaped their mouths.
Noticing their stunned expression, Luke inwardly nodded with satisfaction. ’Having good looks always helps.’
Without slowing he reached them and presented his invitation card.
"Sorry, young ladies, to disturb you."
"But I got this invitation, and don’t know where to find this person." He pointed toward his hand, where Isaria’s name was clearly printed.
The girls nodded subconsciously, still not removing their gazes from him.
’Seems like their maiden hearts are weak.’ Luke commented inwardly, before trying again.
"Would the two beautiful maidens be kind enough to guide me?" Luke asked, offering them a gentle smile that made his already handsome face appear even more captivating.
’A prince!!’ Seeing this, both of their hearts skipped a beat.
"Sure!!" They said happily, before reading the name on the invitation card.
"Professor Isaria..." But when they finally read the name, their eyes became wide.
Then both of them looked toward Luke and down again toward the invitation card.
’Professor never told us that she has such a handsome boyfriend.’ And a misunderstanding was created at this moment.
"Ok, please come with us." Each of them held Luke’s each hand, before entering under the stunned gazes of the crowd and guards.
"The hell?"
"He really impressed them. And not a single one, but both of them!"
The crowd again erupted with gossip, clearly thinking that Luke was a womanizer.
Which was kinda true. Sinc he already got this title.
After staying for a few minutes on the platform, they finally reached the island.
"This is our Horizon Academy."
"The best academy in the human kingdom." They praised and told many things to Luke.
To that, He listened to their words with one ear and let them out with the other.
Because all of their talk was about Professor Isaria.
Like what she usually wears, what she actually likes to eat, and with whom she meets.
Hearing all these, he became speechless.
’Just how much free time do these girls have?’
Luke observed his surroundings for a moment, and only one word came to his mind.
"Fabulous."
"Right?" Both girls asked almost simultaneously, their eyes lighting up after seeing his stunned expression.
Even though Luke had seen the Holy Church’s main headquarters before, that place carried a distinctly religious atmosphere.
This place, however, felt almost like a city from the future.

Students flew across the floating island on small magical artifacts of various shapes and designs. Some rode on sleek metallic boards, while others sat on floating discs or strange mechanical devices that emitted faint streams of Aether.
While magical lights illuminated the pathways.
Mechanical constructs could also be seen moving throughout the academy.
Some resembled humanoid golems, while others had completely unfamiliar designs, carrying books, transporting supplies, or assisting students with their daily tasks.
"Over there." one of them pointed toward a huge palace-like building, where *Studies of Ancient Arts* was inscribed upon the wall.
"Professor Isaria is over there." So without wasting any more time, both of them dragged Luke to their classroom.
Which was their destination as well.
"You stay here." After reaching just outside the classroom, they said this to Luke.
Seeing Luke nodded, each of them entered the large classroom.
Inside, more than 100 students, a mix of male and female around the same age as them, were seated and waiting for the class to start.
While at the front, Isaria was talking with another professor.
The professor Estelle Sunborn, current princess of Sunborn Kingdom.
Both of their ages were around 25 and they were close friends.
The moment they entered inside, both of their gazes turned toward them.
"Gena and Palia, why are each of you late?" Isaria asked calmly, clearly her voice didn’t carry anger.
After all, she had a gentle personality toward her students.
Estelle also stopped talking and waited for them to finish.
Gena and Palia exchanged glances, before a smile appeared on their lips.
Because when they were being late, they didn’t help Luke not only out of goodwill.
But because they thought to use him to escape punishment.
Even though Professor Isaria was gentle, rules were rules.
Therefore they announced the reason for their lateness.
"Professor Isaria, we’re sorry! We were showing your boyfriend around, so we arrived late." Gena said innocently, but the words stunned the whole class.
Silence.
The entire classroom froze.
"BOYFRIEND?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 263: The Professor Mistook Me for Her Future Husband?!
paragraphs: The whole classroom became shocked after hearing this.
Because Isaria was the youngest professor of Horizon Academy. Plus she was also female.
So many male students, even a few male professors, often fantasized about her.
And now, hearing that she had a boyfriend broke the hearts of many pursuers.
Estelle beside her became confused by this.
Since Isaria and she were good friends and they also knew each other for some time.
However, she had never mentioned having a boyfriend to her, not even once.
’Not again.’ Meanwhile, Isaria’s face turned annoyed.
After all, she didn’t have any boyfriend at all, but she knew how the other person came here.
’Father!’ She wanted to shout out his name, clearly wanting to release her anger upon him.
Because it was not the first time he had arranged a blind date for her.
But never! ever! had the person come into the academy.
Clearly, this was crossing the line.
Despite this, she remained quiet and walked outside with somewhat angry steps.
To give this person a clear refusal and let him leave at once.
"Sir, regarding about marriage-" But the moment she saw the person, she froze in her place.
Because the person was not just a handsome or good-looking man.
But he was also dashing and had charm, which she had never seen before in her whole life.
’How can someone be so attractive?’
The smile Luke wore, combined with his blue eyes that seemed to look only at her...
And from his slightly open white shirt near the chest, those perfect collarbones added more to his charm.
Even though she wasn’t the lustful type, today she wanted to lose herself in that attraction.
At least for once.
"I am ready for marriage." So unconsciously, those words escaped her mouth.
"Hah?"
"Huh?"
"What!"
"Heh?"
Five different reactions followed those words.
The first came from Luke, whose voice was filled with bafflement.
Second, Estelle, who was peeking from inside the classroom, her speechless voice.
Third came from most of the female students, which held a shocked voice.
Fourth came from Gena and Palia, their confused voices, because they didn’t accept that the person was really her boyfriend.
And the last came from the poor male students, whose little hearts had just been broken.
[Luke, you should turn off your charming mode.]
Hearing the system’s words, he became confused. ’What’s charming mode?’
’No wait a min! There is a charming mode??’ He asked back, because he was hearing this for the first time.
[Well, Luke.]
[Since you are now a titan. A real titan.]
[So you would definitely get all its perks.]
[And one of these is the charming mode.]
Listening to the system’s words, he became somewhat enlightened and asked for confirmation. ’those perfect faces possessed by B-Rank and higher beings?’
[Yeah... But you are way more than that.] The system paused for a few moments after this.
Then added.
[After all, those beings are just imitating or trying to become perfect.]
[While you are already made perfect after your reconstruction.]
Luke nodded upon this with understanding. But one thing still didn’t fit right.
’Then why do other females only find me attractive, but not to this extent?’ He asked, because Isaria’s current expression was way more than just finding someone attractive.
[Ohh, that’s.]
[I told you, there are some special sensitive people, or those with Origin skills related to inspection or sensitivity.]
[And it seems she is one of those types.]
’Still, this didn’t answer my question regarding charming mode.’
[Well, here is a simple example.]
[If you are angry, then your persona and aura would change to anger.]
[Now the same happens here.]
[You were earlier thinking about Selene and were also excited about meeting her.]
[Which resulted in your titan body emitting a loving persona and aura that you felt for Selene.]
[And Isaria mistakenly thought that you were excited to marry her and that’s why you came here.]
’What the f*ck!’
Luke looked again at Isaria’s white eyes, which were clearly looking at him more than a stranger.
’Did she get hypnotized? Like, did she completely fall in love with me?’ He worriedly asked.
[Hah? Of course not.]
[Your titan form has not developed to that level. Or else, she would have already undressed herself and spread her legs for you.]
’You don’t have to say the last part.’ His mouth twitched at the system’s shameless behavior.
But the system continued, like it was its routine job.
[So, congratulations Luke.]
[You have got yourself a fiance.]
’Don’t kid with me.’
He completely shut down the system’s absurd talk.
’If Selene or my other wives find out about this, then I am completely dead.’
Before Luke could remove those ominous thoughts, the system’s words came again.
[Then, make another affair.]
[Like you did with Theia~]
Luke felt like he would lose more brain cells if he continued talking to this horny system.
"Sir?" Isaria called him, while also getting closer.
"Hello." He said, before making some distance.
But Isaria came close again and held his hand gently.
"So hard."
"MISS!"
Luke removed his hand with an absurd expression, while Isaria’s face turned bright red when she realized that her words contained a double meaning.
"Ahem!" She coughed to remove the awkwardness, before introducing herself.
"Even though my father has already told you my name,"
"I’m Isaria Merrick." She smiled cheerfully, clearly trying to make a good impression.
Luke nodded at her introduction, before introducing himself as well.
"Nice to meet you, Isaria."
"I’m Luke Voidheart."
Silence, an utter silence spread among everyone.
All the gossiping students’ mouths got shut, while Estelle’s mouth got opened.
As for Isaria?
She felt her heart break for a moment.
Then erupted the shocked voice of students.
"Luke Voidheart! the Hero of light!!"
"The Womanizer!!"
"The person who didn’t even left his own Saintess!"
"Our professor is his next target!!!"
[Luke, you seem popular.]
’It’s my title of Womanizer which is popular.’
The smile upon his lips twitched. Clearly he didn’t know what to say.
Should he defend himself?
By what?
No, wait a sec!
’When did the Saintess come into my harem?’
Sadly, no one answered him.
All the students held different gazes now.
Male students looked with anger, like they would clearly protect their innocent professor.
While female students looked with yearning and forbidden love.
"The romance between a handsome womanizer hero and an innocent female student."
’System, those female students’ eyes seem wrong.’ Luke got goosebumps from those stares.
