chapters.title: Chapter 264: I Just Wanted to Meet My Wife!
paragraphs: 2nd day of Fructus Month, same year.
"Sir Luke, I have heard many things about you." Estelle said smilingly. Luke nodded with a normal expression, clearly not interested in knowing, what she had heard about him.
"Hmm, this is tasty." He commented with suprised expression, after tasting.
Isaria just nodded across the table, while Estelle smiled.
After students earlier outburst, they had changed the place of their meeting.
Now, the three of them—yes, even the princess of the Eldric Sunborn Kingdom—were having a meal together.
They were inside a cafeteria-like building, which looked much like the luxury restaurants found in Luke’s world.
The three of them were eating peacefully when Estelle glanced at her friend before shifting her gaze toward Luke.
A playful smile slowly spread across her lips.
"So, Sir Luke, is he really my friend’s fiancé?"
"Khh—Cough! Cough!"
The moment Estelle finished speaking, Isaria choked on her drink.
She immediately turned toward Estelle and gave her a death glare.
Yet, Estelle merely smiled innocently as she reached over and gently patted Isaria’s back, trying to calm her down.
Meanwhile, the eyes of the surrounding onlookers widened as they stared at Luke with shock, jealousy, anger, and various other expressions.
"Isaria’s fiancé?"
"When did that happen? Why don’t I know anything about this?"
"Why didn’t she tell me about it?"
"Is she your girlfriend?!"
Soon, murmurs spread from table to table, and the once-quiet cafeteria became as noisy as a fish market.
Hearing all the commotion, Isaria’s face turned red with shame and embarrassment.
After the earlier misunderstanding, she already knew that Luke wasn’t actually her fiancé.
That was why hearing everyone talk about it again made her even more embarrassed—and furious at Estelle.
"Estelle!"
She immediately turned toward her friend and gave her another death glare.
After all, she knew very well that Estelle was thoroughly enjoying her embarrassment.
"Ah, Lady Isaria, you don’t have to mind them," Luke suddenly intervened, his voice calm and reassuring, as if those rumors were nothing more than a passing moment.
Hearing his words, Isaria looked at the culprit.
Luke was still eating his food calmly, completely unfazed by the rumors spreading around them, as though none of it had anything to do with him.
’Well, he already has plenty of rumors surrounding him.’ Recalling those, a small smile appeared on Isaria’s lips.
Estelle, who was sitting beside her, noticed the smile and became surprised.
Isaria had always been the type to remain quiet and composed. She rarely expressed her emotions openly.
Yet, a single sentence from Luke had actually made her smile.
’The title of Womanizer wasn’t wasted on him after all.’ Estelle gave Luke an praising look.
Luke noticed her strange gaze and became baffled.
At that moment, the system’s voice followed.
[Luke, that woman is definitely thinking something bad about you.]
Luke glanced at Estelle for a moment.
However, rather than asking what she was thinking, he simply ignored both her and the system.
Then, he turned his attention back to Isaria.
"I am sure that with Lady Isaria’s personality, you will definitely find the best husband."
Isaria froze mid-bite.
A faint blush immediately appeared on her cheeks.
’How can he talk so nicely?’ She complained inwardly before quickly lowering her gaze and continuing to eat.
On the other hand, Estelle was completely shocked.
’What a womanizer.’ She looked at Luke with even more admiration.
His ability to flatter women was truly something worth praising.
Of course, Luke remained completely oblivious to this and continued eating normally.
A few minutes later, after they had finally finished their meals and the surrounding glares had gradually died down, Luke finally asked the question he had wanted to ask from the beginning.
"When are the representatives from Empyrean Academy arriving?"
Hearing this, realization appeared in both Isaria’s and Estelle’s eyes.
’He’s here for his wife, Selene.’
For some reason, that thought caused an uncomfortable feeling to stir within Isaria’s heart.
It was almost as if she didn’t like the idea.
However, she knew that the man sitting in front of her was already married. And she had no right to interfere in his personal life.
Estelle glanced at Isaria with concern, clearly noticing the subtle change in her expression.
Isaria quickly acted as though nothing had happened and replied with a smile.
"The time was arranged for the afternoon, so they should be arriving soon."
With that, she stopped talking and continued eating.
Estelle paused for a moment after seeing this, then continued eating as well.
Luke noticed the sudden change in her expression, but chose not to say anything. He simply resumed his meal.
Soon, the atmosphere at the table became slightly uncomfortable.
Fortunately, the awkward silence didn’t last long.
A loud voice suddenly echoed throughout Horizon Academy.
"The representatives from Empyrean Academy have arrived!"
Hearing the announcement, everyone in the cafeteria immediately stood up, their eyes lighting up with excitement.
After all, Empyrean Academy represented connections.
If they could establish a good relationship with any of them, then it could bring numerous benefits to them.
"Let’s go!"
With that, several professors immediately rushed toward the exit, completely forgetting that they were professors and not some careless children.
"So, those almighty people have finally arrived," Estelle commented sarcastically as she lowered her fork.
This wasn’t the first time she had met them, so she knew exactly how they behaved.
The humans inside Empyrean Academy, in particular, held very little status there.
Results? Among the various races, humans were often given the least respect.
’If not for the exploration opportunities, we wouldn’t even have invited them.’
Estelle stood up with that thought, and Isaria followed shortly after.
The earlier uneasiness had completely disappeared from Isaria’s expression. She was once again the calm and composed Professor of Horizon Academy.
"Please don’t mind me if I come along as well," Luke said with a smile before following them.
Neither woman objected.
After all, their attention was about to shift toward something far more important.
Still, before leaving, Isaria glanced at Luke’s face for a moment.
Then, she silently nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 265: He Prayed It Wasn’t Luke... But It Was!
paragraphs: After stepping outside, they found themselves facing a gigantic flying magical ship nearly one kilometer long.
Two massive, wing-like structures extended from both sides of the ship, while a huge blue crystal was embedded right in its center.
’Why don’t they hide that crystal?’ Luke looked at it with confusion.
’If someone targeted that crystal during an attack, it could be destroyed, potentially jeopardizing the safety of the entire crew and all the passengers aboard.’
However, no one else seemed interested in that question.
As everyone’s gaze was fixed on the front of the flying ship.
Where, Twelve people were standing.
’Selene.’
Luke’s gaze also swept across them before immediately stopping on the woman at the very front.
She was a beautiful woman dressed in an elegant noble robe, while her long pink hair flowed gracefully in the wind.
Her mesmerizing red eyes were looking downward, towards the gathered crowd.
’She seems even more beautiful now.’
Seeing her again, a relieved smile appeared on Luke’s lips.
From the side, Isaria noticed his smile.
She then followed his gaze toward Selene—the Vampire Princess and Luke’s wife, the wife of the Hero of Light.
’You aren’t her match at all.’ And only this thought came in her mind, after noticing her beauty.
So a faint sigh escaped from her mouth.
She didn’t even understand why she was thinking such things.
After all, she had only just met Luke.
Yet somehow, those thoughts had already begun appearing in her mind.
And there was no one who could answer the question troubling her heart.
While she was lost in those thoughts, the flying ship finally reached the island.
With a deafening roar, it descended toward the ground.
THOOOOOOM!!!
The moment it landed, the powerful impact sent a gust of wind sweeping across the area.
"Ahh!"
Several nearby students were blown backward.
Because of their excitement, they hadn’t even noticed how close they were standing to the landing area.
"These fools!"
Seeing the scene, several nearby professors immediately face-palmed.
They were making a terrible first impression in front of their guests.
Once the flying ship had landed, the twelve representatives jumped down one after another, landing gracefully on the ground without showing the slightest difficulty.
The principal and vice principal immediately stepped forward to greet them, their faces filled with welcoming smiles.
"Professors, welcome to Horizon Astralis Academy!"
"Thank you for having us."
The human representative returned the greeting with a polite smile.
While the others merely gave a casual hum in acknowledgment.
As for, dragons? they didn’t even bother returning the greeting.
Meanwhile, the elves looked at the Horizon Academy members with undisguised disgust. After all, almost all of them were humans.
If not for academy protocol, they probably wouldn’t have even bothered entering such a lowly place.
Surprisingly, despite all of this, the smiles on the principal’s and vice principal’s faces never disappeared.
They continued the conversation as if nothing had happened, asking about their journey and other matters.
Meanwhile, Luke, Isaria, and Estelle remained standing at the far end.
Clearly, neither of the two women had any intention of going over to greet the representatives.
At least, not yet.
"Sir Luke, I’m surprised your wife hasn’t noticed you yet," Estelle said playfully, clearly trying to find something to relieve her boredom.
"Well, she’s busy," Luke muttered casually, without minding her words.
However, deep inside, he was equally confused.
’Why hasn’t she noticed me yet?’
Seeing Luke’s confusion, the system finally decided to clear up his doubts.
[Luke, after becoming a true Titan, your aura has changed.]
[So, of course, she wouldn’t be able to recognize you unless she specifically focused on you.]
The system paused for a moment, allowing Luke to digest the information before continuing.
[And regarding the Golden Chain bond that you and your wives shared, it was always passively emitting a connection between you.]
[That was why, even among a large crowd, you could easily sense and find each other.]
[However, after those mysterious symbols covered your chains, that passive connection disappeared as well.]
[So, unless she summons her Golden Chain or comes close enough to you, she won’t be able to recognize you.]
’What the hell? There was something like that?’
’You never mentioned this before.’
Hearing Luke’s slightly complaining thoughts, the system immediately chose to remain silent.
After all, it wasn’t some kind of babysitter.
Noticing the system’s silence, Luke understood this once again.
’Well, whatever. I’ll meet her myself.’
With that, he decided to wait for a few moments before approaching her.
"Sir Luke, are you all right?" Isaria asked gently, noticing that Luke seemed somewhat uncomfortable.
’Maybe it’s because Selene hasn’t come over to him.’ and this thought came into her mind.
"I am fine, Lady Isaria."
Luke simply smiled at her before turning his attention toward the front again.
"Okay."
Seeing, that he didn’t want to talk about this, Isaria lowered her hand and murmured softly.
Meanwhile, among the group of representatives, one vampire looked around with an irritated expression.
’Why are these bloodbags talking so much?’
Marius Duskraven was growing increasingly annoyed by the endless chatter, but he still remained silent.
After all, those two were A-Rank beings, and with his peak C-Rank cultivation, he wouldn’t dare to argue with them.
Even though his family had beings far stronger than those two, he still knew better than to cause trouble here.
So, while slowly fixing his long silver hair, he casually glanced around—
—and suddenly froze.
Then his eyes widened with shocked.
Someone was present here whom he had never wanted to see.
*The Hero.*
Luke was standing with the other two female humans, talking and laughing as though nothing had happened to him.
For a moment, he almost mistook him for someone else.
’No... it can’t be.’ His eyes narrowed, and he carefully focused on that familiar face.
Then his heart sank.
’It’s really him.’
’Luke Voidheart!’
But how did he able to, recognize him just from seeing his face?
Because of the memory crystal from the marriage ceremony.
The recording had spread among almost every noble and wealthy person, and he happened to be one of the unlucky men who possessed a copy.
A copy that contained the scene of Luke marrying five princesses.
So next moment, his expression instantly darkened.
’Damn the Hero! Why is he here?!’ And a curse immediately flashed through his mind.
After all, wasn’t the Hero supposed to be crippled or captured by the Royal Vampires already?
His fingers tightened around a strand of his silver hair.
’Selene’s family members are useless!’
The more he looked at Luke, casually talking and laughing with the others, the more irritated he became.
His jaw clenched. His eyes burned with annoyance.
Then, as if desperately trying to cling to the smallest possibility, another thought entered his mind.
’I hope he isn’t here for her.’
The moment that thought appeared, however, he knew how idiotic it was.
’Of course Luke was here for her.’
’Or why else would he be here?’
Yet he still desperately tried to convince himself otherwise.
’Maybe... it’s just a coincidence.’
Unfortunately, it seemed fate had other plans.
Arwen, a High Elf, suddenly turned his cold gaze toward Luke.
A clear trace of disgust appeared across his handsome face as he looked him up and down.
Then, without bothering to hide his disdain, he asked openly,
"Why is an outsider standing here?"

sentences.text: After stepping outside, they found themselves facing a gigantic flying magical ship nearly one kilometer long.
Two massive, wing-like structures extended from both sides of the ship, while a huge blue crystal was embedded right in its center.
’Why don’t they hide that crystal?’ Luke looked at it with confusion.
’If someone targeted that crystal during an attack, it could be destroyed, potentially jeopardizing the safety of the entire crew and all the passengers aboard.’
However, no one else seemed interested in that question.
As everyone’s gaze was fixed on the front of the flying ship.
Where, Twelve people were standing.
’Selene.’
Luke’s gaze also swept across them before immediately stopping on the woman at the very front.
She was a beautiful woman dressed in an elegant noble robe, while her long pink hair flowed gracefully in the wind.
Her mesmerizing red eyes were looking downward, towards the gathered crowd.
’She seems even more beautiful now.’
Seeing her again, a relieved smile appeared on Luke’s lips.
From the side, Isaria noticed his smile.
She then followed his gaze toward Selene—the Vampire Princess and Luke’s wife, the wife of the Hero of Light.
’You aren’t her match at all.’ And only this thought came in her mind, after noticing her beauty.
So a faint sigh escaped from her mouth.
She didn’t even understand why she was thinking such things.
After all, she had only just met Luke.
Yet somehow, those thoughts had already begun appearing in her mind.
And there was no one who could answer the question troubling her heart.
While she was lost in those thoughts, the flying ship finally reached the island.
With a deafening roar, it descended toward the ground.
THOOOOOOM!!!
The moment it landed, the powerful impact sent a gust of wind sweeping across the area.
"Ahh!"
Several nearby students were blown backward.
Because of their excitement, they hadn’t even noticed how close they were standing to the landing area.
"These fools!"
Seeing the scene, several nearby professors immediately face-palmed.
They were making a terrible first impression in front of their guests.
Once the flying ship had landed, the twelve representatives jumped down one after another, landing gracefully on the ground without showing the slightest difficulty.
The principal and vice principal immediately stepped forward to greet them, their faces filled with welcoming smiles.
"Professors, welcome to Horizon Astralis Academy!"
"Thank you for having us."
The human representative returned the greeting with a polite smile.
While the others merely gave a casual hum in acknowledgment.
As for, dragons? they didn’t even bother returning the greeting.
Meanwhile, the elves looked at the Horizon Academy members with undisguised disgust.
After all, almost all of them were humans.
If not for academy protocol, they probably wouldn’t have even bothered entering such a lowly place.
Surprisingly, despite all of this, the smiles on the principal’s and vice principal’s faces never disappeared.
They continued the conversation as if nothing had happened, asking about their journey and other matters.
Meanwhile, Luke, Isaria, and Estelle remained standing at the far end.
Clearly, neither of the two women had any intention of going over to greet the representatives.
At least, not yet.
"Sir Luke, I’m surprised your wife hasn’t noticed you yet," Estelle said playfully, clearly trying to find something to relieve her boredom.
"Well, she’s busy," Luke muttered casually, without minding her words.
However, deep inside, he was equally confused.
’Why hasn’t she noticed me yet?’
Seeing Luke’s confusion, the system finally decided to clear up his doubts.
[Luke, after becoming a true Titan, your aura has changed.]
[So, of course, she wouldn’t be able to recognize you unless she specifically focused on you.]
The system paused for a moment, allowing Luke to digest the information before continuing.
[And regarding the Golden Chain bond that you and your wives shared, it was always passively emitting a connection between you.]
[That was why, even among a large crowd, you could easily sense and find each other.]
[However, after those mysterious symbols covered your chains, that passive connection disappeared as well.]
[So, unless she summons her Golden Chain or comes close enough to you, she won’t be able to recognize you.]
’What the hell?
There was something like that?’
’You never mentioned this before.’
Hearing Luke’s slightly complaining thoughts, the system immediately chose to remain silent.
After all, it wasn’t some kind of babysitter.
Noticing the system’s silence, Luke understood this once again.
’Well, whatever.
I’ll meet her myself.’
With that, he decided to wait for a few moments before approaching her.
"Sir Luke, are you all right?" Isaria asked gently, noticing that Luke seemed somewhat uncomfortable.
’Maybe it’s because Selene hasn’t come over to him.’ and this thought came into her mind.
"I am fine, Lady Isaria."
Luke simply smiled at her before turning his attention toward the front again.
"Okay."
Seeing, that he didn’t want to talk about this, Isaria lowered her hand and murmured softly.
Meanwhile, among the group of representatives, one vampire looked around with an irritated expression.
’Why are these bloodbags talking so much?’
Marius Duskraven was growing increasingly annoyed by the endless chatter, but he still remained silent.
After all, those two were A-Rank beings, and with his peak C-Rank cultivation, he wouldn’t dare to argue with them.
Even though his family had beings far stronger than those two, he still knew better than to cause trouble here.
So, while slowly fixing his long silver hair, he casually glanced around—
—and suddenly froze.
Then his eyes widened with shocked.
Someone was present here whom he had never wanted to see.
*The Hero.*
Luke was standing with the other two female humans, talking and laughing as though nothing had happened to him.
For a moment, he almost mistook him for someone else.
’No... it can’t be.’ His eyes narrowed, and he carefully focused on that familiar face.
Then his heart sank.
’It’s really him.’
’Luke Voidheart!’
But how did he able to, recognize him just from seeing his face?
Because of the memory crystal from the marriage ceremony.
The recording had spread among almost every noble and wealthy person, and he happened to be one of the unlucky men who possessed a copy.
A copy that contained the scene of Luke marrying five princesses.
So next moment, his expression instantly darkened.
’Damn the Hero!
Why is he here?!’ And a curse immediately flashed through his mind.
After all, wasn’t the Hero supposed to be crippled or captured by the Royal Vampires already?
His fingers tightened around a strand of his silver hair.
’Selene’s family members are useless!’
The more he looked at Luke, casually talking and laughing with the others, the more irritated he became.
His jaw clenched.
His eyes burned with annoyance.
Then, as if desperately trying to cling to the smallest possibility, another thought entered his mind.
’I hope he isn’t here for her.’
The moment that thought appeared, however, he knew how idiotic it was.
’Of course Luke was here for her.’
’Or why else would he be here?’
Yet he still desperately tried to convince himself otherwise.
’Maybe... it’s just a coincidence.’
Unfortunately, it seemed fate had other plans.
Arwen, a High Elf, suddenly turned his cold gaze toward Luke.
A clear trace of disgust appeared across his handsome face as he looked him up and down.
Then, without bothering to hide his disdain, he asked openly,
"Why is an outsider standing here?"

chapters.title: Chapter 266: He Reunited With His Wife... in the Worst Way Possible!
paragraphs: A few minutes earlier...
Arwen looked around with pure disgust.
His expression only darkened further when he noticed few half-elf students among the crowd.
’These filthy humans never learn.’
He quickly looked away from them.
However, the moment he did, something caught his attention.
No—someone.
’Is he... that bastard?’
Arwen’s gaze settled on the man standing at the far end.
The man had shoulder-length black hair and blue eyes.
Arwen stared at his face for a few moments.
It looked almost identical to the face of Luke Voidheart—the Hero of Light and, more importantly, the husband of Elaria Moonleaf.
The moment that thought crossed his mind, Arwen’s expression twisted with disgust and anger.
After all, it wasn’t just Arwen who despised humans.
The entire elven race held deep hatred toward them.

So when the elves had learned that Elaria had married a human—and not just any human, but a supposedly talentless one—Arwen had felt as though the Goddess of Light herself was mocking their entire race.
Only the Royal Elves knew the truth about Elaria.
That she was a half-elf, born from an assault committed by a human.
Yet, to the rest of the elven race, Elaria was still regarded as a pure elf and a member of their royalty.
That was precisely why their hatred toward the current Hero of Light ran even deeper.
"Lirael." Arwen slowly pointed toward Luke while keeping his gaze fixed on him.
At first, Lirael was confused.
Because, Arwen’s face was filled with nothing but anger and disgust, and she had no idea what had done.
However, the moment she turned around and saw Luke, her expression changed as well.
"Is that... the talentless filth whom our princess was forced to marry?"
She asked through gritted teeth, her voice filled with suppressed anger.
Clearly, she didn’t want to make a bad impression of the elves in front of everyone. Otherwise, she would have attacked him already.
Still, she was finding it increasingly difficult to control her emotions.
"Yeah."
Arwen nodded, his own anger barely contained.
He clearly didn’t believe the recent rumors surrounding Luke.
That the supposedly talentless man had somehow become a genius.
After all, even the elves knew of several methods that could rapidly increase someone’s cultivation to the Bronze Knight realm within a few days.
However, every one of those methods came with a price.
They either drained the user’s potential or caused severe adverse effects.
’As for the claim that Luke had killed a Mid-Golden Knight?’
That was even more ridiculous.
Otherwise, the Holy Church would have brought him back already.
A mocking expression appeared on Arwen’s face.
After all, why would the Holy Church spread false information when they possessed such immense power?
But he still needed an excuse.
After all, making a scene in front of A-Rank beings wasn’t a good idea at all.
Then, he suddenly remembered something.
’This meeting is between academies, yet an outsider is standing here.’
Thinking of this, a sly grin appeared on his lips.
So, without wasting any time, he spoke loudly.
"Why is an outsider standing here?"
Arwen’s voice echoed throughout the plaza, immediately attracting everyone’s attention.
"What happened?"
"Who is the outsider?"
Murmurs quickly spread among the students and professor.
Even the principal, vice principal, and other representatives turned toward Arwen with confused expressions.
’What is he up to?’
And the same thought appeared in the minds of almost everyone present.
After all, they knew that Arwen wasn’t someone who usually spoke without a reason.
"This is bad." Seeing this, Isaria immediately felt a bad premonition.
Because earlier, before Arwen shouted, she had noticed his gaze lingering on Luke for a few moments.
Then, she remembered the long-standing history between humans and elves.
’He’s trying to pick a fight with Luke.’
Isaria thought worriedly.
In her haste, she had completely forgotten one important detail—only academy members were supposed to be present here.
After all, this wasn’t a public meeting.
Thinking this, she hurriedly grabbed Luke’s arm.
"Luke, let’s leave before he points toward you."
She tried to pull him away immediately.
Unfortunately, her plan failed the very next moment.
"Don’t think you can run anymore!"
Arwen shouted loudly while pointing directly toward Luke, clearly trying to make everyone believe that the Hero of Light was nothing more than a coward who ran away when confronted.
Instantly, everyone’s gaze turned toward Luke and Isaria.
For a moment, the entire crowd became confused.
"Who?"
Question marks practically appeared above everyone’s heads.
Only Selene, Marius, the Principal, the Vice Principal, and the other representatives sensed something unusual.
But then, Selene’s eyes suddenly widened.
"Luke?" A low whisper escaped her lips, but everyone nearby still heard it.
"Luke?"
"LUKE?! The Hero of Light?!"
The moment his identity was revealed, everyone’s eyes widened in shock.
Never in their wildest dreams had they expected to encounter a real Hero here.
Especially this particular Hero of Light, who had recently become the center of many rumors.

Meanwhile, Roderan Halveth, the principal of Horizon Academy—a man in his sixties with short red hair and orange eyes—exchanged a glance with Drevian Orlath, the vice principal, a man in his fifties with cyan-colored hair and matching cyan eyes.
Both of them immediately understood that the situation had just become far more complicated.
At the same time, the eyes of the other representatives narrowed dangerously.
Except for the humans and Selene, Luke was hardly welcome among other races.
After all, their princess had married a supposedly talentless human.
Who could possibly accept that?
For the elves, it was because of their long and bitter history with humans.
As for the dragons, they respected only strength.
And according to everything they had heard about Luke, he didn’t possess even an ounce of it.
At least, that was what they believed.
The same could be said for the Marinthians.
After all, Naira had already been announced as the future bride of the strongest winner of the Sea Champion.
So the idea of her being given to a supposedly talentless man for free didn’t sit well with them either.
As for the vampires, everyone already knew what Marius was thinking.
If he wasn’t cursing Luke, then he was probably doing it right now.
’Damn you, Luke! You can’t even hide properly!’
Marius stared at Luke with bloodshot eyes, as though Luke had deliberately exposed himself just to cause trouble.
Then there was the Beast Race.
Since Luke hadn’t married their princess, they had no particular reason to hold any hatred toward him.
Thus, they and the other representatives remained where they were, quietly waiting for the show to begin.
After all, the elves had already started something.
They might as well see it through to the end.
Especially since they were currently standing on human territory.
As all these thoughts crossed their minds, Luke calmly removed Isaria’s hands from his arm despite the worry evident in her eyes.
"It’s okay." He smiled reassuringly at her, but unknowingly, he had just made a huge mistake.
After speaking her earlier words, Selene’s mind went blank for a moment.
She no longer cared about the outsider or anything else.
All she could see was Luke—her husband.
The man to whom she had given her first time.
From whom she just separated a month ago.
And now, another woman was holding onto him.
To make matters worse, Luke was gently holding that woman’s hand while saying something that seemed to calm her down.
Of course, that wasn’t what was actually happening.
But that was how Selene saw it.
[Poor Luke...]
The system sighed sympathetically, already imagining Luke getting tied to a chair again.
No...
This time, perhaps a bed would be more appropriate.
And then Selene might try something else—something she had learned during her time at the academy.
[Hmm? Wouldn’t that be interesting?]
The system suddenly paused, and its metaphorical expression became excited.
After all, if things continued like this, Selene might become the first yandere.
[Luke, it’s your fault for not bringing a clone.]
So the system completely sold Luke out.
Not only did it suppress the thought of warning him, but it also suppressed its evil smile as it silently waited for the upcoming chaos.

chapters.title: Chapter 267: Everyone Expected Luke to Stay Silent... They Were Wrong!
paragraphs: Arwen clearly noticed their silence and immediately understood what was going on.
’Sneaky bastards.’
He gave each of them a silent glare before fixing his eyes on Luke again.
Unfortunately, before he could say anything further, another voice interrupted him.
"Sir Luke has been invited by me."
Estelle stepped forward and stood beside Luke, looking directly into Arwen’s eyes.
Hearing this, Luke became slightly surprised.
After all, these two women had been keep helping him from the beginning, something he rarely encountered.
Arwen narrowed his eyes in annoyance.
"And who might you be to invite an outsider to this meeting?"
His voice carried nothing but disgust.
He already had to deal with humans because of this Hero, which was precisely why he hated coming to foreign lands.
Estelle, however, merely smiled calmly.
"The Princess of the Eldric Sunborn Kingdom." She paused for a moment before adding,
"And I’m also the main organizer of this meeting."
Her words shocked every student present. Even a few professors looked surprised.

After all, none of them had known that this exchange had been arranged by the royal family. As they had simply assumed it was a normal academy exchange, with even Empyrean Academy coming to participate.
Hearing this, Arwen and Lirael exchanged glances.
If what Estelle had said was true, then she had every right to bring someone else with her.
After all, they weren’t here for sightseeing.
There was also an important exploration mission, which meant they could bring someone they considered useful and trustworthy.
Arwen then glanced toward Roderan Halveth, the principal of Horizon Academy.
Yet, the principal said nothing.
At least, not yet.
’Damn it.’
Seeing that no one was objecting or adding anything, Arwen realized that his earlier question was about to become nothing more than a laughingstock.
Instead of exposing Luke, he had only managed to make himself look like a fool in front of everyone.
After all, how could an academy possibly object to an outsider brought by the very person organizing the event?
This results, his frustration reaching its limit.
So, before he could stop himself, a curse escaped his mouth.
"A filth brings more filth."
Utter silence descended upon the entire plaza.
Every student’s eyes widened.
A few even covered their mouths with both hands, unable to believe what they had just heard.
Everyone knew about the bitter history between humans and elves.
However, elves rarely came to human territories.

And when they did, they usually remained quiet, keeping their disdain to themselves and badmouthing humans only among their own kind. After all, they cared deeply about maintaining their so-called superior image.
Whenever an elf or human openly insulted each other, it rarely ended peacefully.
More often than not, it resulted in a conflict.
Sometimes, those conflicts even escalated into bloodshed.
But this time, Arwen had gone far beyond a simple insult.
He had openly insulted a human in front of everyone.
Worse, he had insulted the current princess of the very kingdom whose territory he was standing on.
And he had even insulted the Hero of Light.
The atmosphere instantly became tense.
Roderan Halveth and Drevian Orlath narrowed their eyes dangerously.
Yet, neither of them moved from their positions.
After all, if they suddenly intervened in what could still be considered a dispute between lower-realm individuals, also youngester’s, the situation would only become more complicated.
Of course...
That was only as long as they didn’t cross the line.
Meanwhile, the other representatives, although they didn’t necessarily share the elves’ hatred toward humans, also chose to remain silent.
As for Selene, she was still standing there like a statue, completely lost in her own thoughts.
Her lips moved rapidly as she muttered something in an extremely low voice.
So low that no one nearby could make out what she was saying.
’Yeah... Luke is filth. Kill it.’ On the other hand, Marius was practically smiling inside.
The situation had finally escalated from mere words to something dangerously close to physical conflict.
And if Luke ended up getting injured—or even killed—then it would be the best possible outcome for him.
Estelle, meanwhile, stood frozen for a moment, her eyes wide with surprise and shock.
As for anger, she knew better than to show it.
Although the person who had just insulted her was also an Early-B Rank like herself, she knew that when it came to status, influence, strength, and wealth, she was nowhere near his level.
’So, another insult has been added to my name.’ Estelle glanced toward Roderan and Drevian, who remained standing in their positions.
Their eyes met hers.
But there was only helplessness in their gazes.
After all, they couldn’t simply use their strength to attack someone younger than themselves, atleast openly.
If they did, then they would be branded as bullies, and the matter could even escalate into a conflict between their races.
’Peer matters should be handled by peers themselves.’ That thought immediately came to Estelle’s mind, leaving her with nothing but a helpless sigh.
After all, in human territory, unless someone belonged to the Emperor’s Royal Family, there was hardly anyone who could stand on equal footing against the high-ranking nobles of other races.
And that was only when talking about nobles.
The Royals of other races were an entirely different matter.
They were even more monstrous than the human Emperor’s Royal Family.
So Estelle didn’t say anything in response.
However, her fist slowly clenched, clearly showing how much she disliked the situation.
Arwen and Lirael, meanwhile, secretly sighed in relief.
’Fortunately, this is human territory. Otherwise, this could have caused serious problems.’ This same thought crossed both their minds.
After all, the other races were powerful and also possessed Demi-God-level beings.
So they had no reason to fear Elves or other races.
Sadly for them...
And fortunately for Estelle...
Someone else was present who didn’t like that particular word at all.
"Filth?"
A calm voice suddenly echoed throughout the plaza.
Surprise immediately filled everyone’s eyes.
’Someone actually dared to reply to a High Elf?’
The same thought crossed the minds of the students, the principal, the vice principal, and even the representatives of the other races.
One after another, everyone turned toward the source of the voice.
Everyone...
Except Selene.
She was still standing there like a statue, seemingly lost in her own muttering.
No one noticed that her eyes had slowly begun to darken with every passing moment.
The crimson in them was becoming deeper.
Darker.
Closer to a terrifying shade of deep red.
Meanwhile, everyone finally found the person who had spoken.
Yet, instead of seeing some powerful expert standing forward, they were met with a familiar face.
’Him?’
’The Hero of Light?’
Luke completely removed Isaria’s hands from his arm.
Then, under the astonished gazes of everyone present, he took a step toward Arwen.
TAP.
Then another.
TAP.
Soon, the only sound echoing through the vicinity was the steady clicking of Luke’s boots against the ground.
TAP. TAP. TAP.
Finally, Luke stopped directly in front of Arwen.
He calmly looked down into the High Elf’s green eyes.
At seven feet tall with a muscular build, Luke’s presence naturally overshadowed the 6.5-foot Arwen, whose lean frame made the difference even more noticeable.
For a moment, Arwen was stunned by Luke’s audacity.
’A Bronze Knight?’
’He dares to look down at me?’
But the reactions of the surrounding people were completely different.
’So handsome!’
’I want to marry him!’
The moment they saw Luke up close, everyone’s attention was immediately drawn to his ethereal appearance. Which they had failed to notice earlier.
His handsomeness easily overshadowed even Arwen.
Arwen himself was no ordinary-looking man.
With long blonde hair, fair skin, and the naturally refined features of a High Elf, he was undoubtedly one of the most handsome men present—easily among the top tier.
But Luke?
Even with his shoulder-length black hair, his appearance somehow surpassed Arwen’s.
For a brief moment, even Lirael was stunned by the realization.
Arwen, however, didn’t notice any of this.
His eyes were already burning with anger, completely focused on the man standing before him.
"A fine specimen." Alia, an owl demi-human from the Beast Race, muttered in surprise.
She had long white hair and completely white eyes, with not even a visible pupil in them.

sentences.text: Arwen clearly noticed their silence and immediately understood what was going on.
’Sneaky bastards.’
He gave each of them a silent glare before fixing his eyes on Luke again.
Unfortunately, before he could say anything further, another voice interrupted him.
"Sir Luke has been invited by me."
Estelle stepped forward and stood beside Luke, looking directly into Arwen’s eyes.
Hearing this, Luke became slightly surprised.
After all, these two women had been keep helping him from the beginning, something he rarely encountered.
Arwen narrowed his eyes in annoyance.
"And who might you be to invite an outsider to this meeting?"
His voice carried nothing but disgust.
He already had to deal with humans because of this Hero, which was precisely why he hated coming to foreign lands.
Estelle, however, merely smiled calmly.
"The Princess of the Eldric Sunborn Kingdom." She paused for a moment before adding,
"And I’m also the main organizer of this meeting."
Her words shocked every student present.
Even a few professors looked surprised.
After all, none of them had known that this exchange had been arranged by the royal family.
As they had simply assumed it was a normal academy exchange, with even Empyrean Academy coming to participate.
Hearing this, Arwen and Lirael exchanged glances.
If what Estelle had said was true, then she had every right to bring someone else with her.
After all, they weren’t here for sightseeing.
There was also an important exploration mission, which meant they could bring someone they considered useful and trustworthy.
Arwen then glanced toward Roderan Halveth, the principal of Horizon Academy.
Yet, the principal said nothing.
At least, not yet.
’Damn it.’
Seeing that no one was objecting or adding anything, Arwen realized that his earlier question was about to become nothing more than a laughingstock.
Instead of exposing Luke, he had only managed to make himself look like a fool in front of everyone.
After all, how could an academy possibly object to an outsider brought by the very person organizing the event?
This results, his frustration reaching its limit.
So, before he could stop himself, a curse escaped his mouth.
"A filth brings more filth."
Utter silence descended upon the entire plaza.
Every student’s eyes widened.
A few even covered their mouths with both hands, unable to believe what they had just heard.
Everyone knew about the bitter history between humans and elves.
However, elves rarely came to human territories.
And when they did, they usually remained quiet, keeping their disdain to themselves and badmouthing humans only among their own kind.
After all, they cared deeply about maintaining their so-called superior image.
Whenever an elf or human openly insulted each other, it rarely ended peacefully.
More often than not, it resulted in a conflict.
Sometimes, those conflicts even escalated into bloodshed.
But this time, Arwen had gone far beyond a simple insult.
He had openly insulted a human in front of everyone.
Worse, he had insulted the current princess of the very kingdom whose territory he was standing on.
And he had even insulted the Hero of Light.
The atmosphere instantly became tense.
Roderan Halveth and Drevian Orlath narrowed their eyes dangerously.
Yet, neither of them moved from their positions.
After all, if they suddenly intervened in what could still be considered a dispute between lower-realm individuals, also youngester’s, the situation would only become more complicated.
Of course...
That was only as long as they didn’t cross the line.
Meanwhile, the other representatives, although they didn’t necessarily share the elves’ hatred toward humans, also chose to remain silent.
As for Selene, she was still standing there like a statue, completely lost in her own thoughts.
Her lips moved rapidly as she muttered something in an extremely low voice.
So low that no one nearby could make out what she was saying.
’Yeah...
Luke is filth.
Kill it.’ On the other hand, Marius was practically smiling inside.
The situation had finally escalated from mere words to something dangerously close to physical conflict.
And if Luke ended up getting injured—or even killed—then it would be the best possible outcome for him.
Estelle, meanwhile, stood frozen for a moment, her eyes wide with surprise and shock.
As for anger, she knew better than to show it.
Although the person who had just insulted her was also an Early-B Rank like herself, she knew that when it came to status, influence, strength, and wealth, she was nowhere near his level.
’So, another insult has been added to my name.’ Estelle glanced toward Roderan and Drevian, who remained standing in their positions.
Their eyes met hers.
But there was only helplessness in their gazes.
After all, they couldn’t simply use their strength to attack someone younger than themselves, atleast openly.
If they did, then they would be branded as bullies, and the matter could even escalate into a conflict between their races.
’Peer matters should be handled by peers themselves.’ That thought immediately came to Estelle’s mind, leaving her with nothing but a helpless sigh.
After all, in human territory, unless someone belonged to the Emperor’s Royal Family, there was hardly anyone who could stand on equal footing against the high-ranking nobles of other races.
And that was only when talking about nobles.
The Royals of other races were an entirely different matter.
They were even more monstrous than the human Emperor’s Royal Family.
So Estelle didn’t say anything in response.
However, her fist slowly clenched, clearly showing how much she disliked the situation.
Arwen and Lirael, meanwhile, secretly sighed in relief.
’Fortunately, this is human territory.
Otherwise, this could have caused serious problems.’ This same thought crossed both their minds.
After all, the other races were powerful and also possessed Demi-God-level beings.
So they had no reason to fear Elves or other races.
Sadly for them...
And fortunately for Estelle...
Someone else was present who didn’t like that particular word at all.
"Filth?"
A calm voice suddenly echoed throughout the plaza.
Surprise immediately filled everyone’s eyes.
’Someone actually dared to reply to a High Elf?’
The same thought crossed the minds of the students, the principal, the vice principal, and even the representatives of the other races.
One after another, everyone turned toward the source of the voice.
Everyone...
Except Selene.
She was still standing there like a statue, seemingly lost in her own muttering.
No one noticed that her eyes had slowly begun to darken with every passing moment.
The crimson in them was becoming deeper.
Darker.
Closer to a terrifying shade of deep red.
Meanwhile, everyone finally found the person who had spoken.
Yet, instead of seeing some powerful expert standing forward, they were met with a familiar face.
’Him?’
’The Hero of Light?’
Luke completely removed Isaria’s hands from his arm.
Then, under the astonished gazes of everyone present, he took a step toward Arwen.
TAP.
Then another.
TAP.
Soon, the only sound echoing through the vicinity was the steady clicking of Luke’s boots against the ground.
TAP.
TAP.
TAP.
Finally, Luke stopped directly in front of Arwen.
He calmly looked down into the High Elf’s green eyes.
At seven feet tall with a muscular build, Luke’s presence naturally overshadowed the 6.5-foot Arwen, whose lean frame made the difference even more noticeable.
For a moment, Arwen was stunned by Luke’s audacity.
’A Bronze Knight?’
’He dares to look down at me?’
But the reactions of the surrounding people were completely different.
’So handsome!’
’I want to marry him!’
The moment they saw Luke up close, everyone’s attention was immediately drawn to his ethereal appearance.
Which they had failed to notice earlier.
His handsomeness easily overshadowed even Arwen.
Arwen himself was no ordinary-looking man.
With long blonde hair, fair skin, and the naturally refined features of a High Elf, he was undoubtedly one of the most handsome men present—easily among the top tier.
But Luke?
Even with his shoulder-length black hair, his appearance somehow surpassed Arwen’s.
For a brief moment, even Lirael was stunned by the realization.
Arwen, however, didn’t notice any of this.
His eyes were already burning with anger, completely focused on the man standing before him.
"A fine specimen." Alia, an owl demi-human from the Beast Race, muttered in surprise.
She had long white hair and completely white eyes, with not even a visible pupil in them.

chapters.title: Chapter 268: “Ants Nowadays Talk So Big...” Then He Transformed!
paragraphs: Even though the Beast Race also valued strength when choosing a partner, they were still naturally attracted to beauty.
And this was even more true for the Owl Race.
They were considered beautiful themselves, so they tended to appreciate attractive individuals even more.
Meanwhile, Ivar, who was standing beside Alia, didn’t hear her words clearly.
Since the moment he had arrived, his attention had been fixed on Isaria.
Not exactly on her appearance...
But on her white eyes.
’She seems special.’ That thought immediately surfaced in his mind.
After all, Owls were renowned for their extraordinary eyesight and the various hidden abilities connected to their vision.
Because of this, very little could escape their gaze.
Half-Owls inherited some of these abilities as well.
That was why Ivar could immediately tell that there was something unusual about Isaria.
Either she had been born with an extraordinary gift...
Or her Origin Skill had made her special.
Since Ivar could sense that she was either related to the Owl Race or possessed abilities connected to them, so his interest in Isaria only grew.
’What’s the point of looks if he’s weak?’ Karon, a Shadow Dragon, remained completely unimpressed by Luke’s appearance.
Although dragons also appreciated beauty and attractive features, they firmly believed that strength came first.
As for Karon herself, she was an extraordinary beauty, with long black hair, deep black eyes and fair skin.
Nearby, Zeyr, a male Earth Dragon, had dark brown shoulder-length hair and matching dark brown eyes.
He didn’t react to Karon’s words.
Instead, his gaze remained fixed on Luke.
There was something about Luke’s actions that caught his attention.
’Pride.’
Something he didn’t see in the other humans present.

Even though Luke’s cultivation was only that of a Bronze Knight, at least according to what they had heard, Zeyr couldn’t help but feel a small sense of satisfaction seeing someone stand up after being insulted.
After all, he was an Earth Dragon himself.
And a prideful one at that.
So he would never willingly bow his head before anyone.
Fael, who had dark blue hair and matching dark blue eyes, also showed little reaction to Luke’s appearance.
After all, among the Marinthian races, beautiful appearances were common.
So, unlike many of the others, he simply looked at Luke calmly.
The same was true for Joria, a female Marinthian with light blue hair and matching light blue eyes.
Meanwhile, Kira, a female human mage with long black hair and black eyes, exchanged a worried glance with Nolan, a male human with short ashen hair and golden eyes.
Although Luke—the Hero of Light—had faced plenty of ridicule in the past simply because he was talentless human, they still cared about his reputation.
If a human Hero were beaten by someone who wasn’t even a Hero, the ridicule directed toward him would only become worse.
Which in turn, would bring more shame to human race.
"Should we intervene?" Kira asked quietly.
Deep down, however, she already knew the answer.
Even within Empyrean Academy, humans were treated with the least respect among the races.
And the two of them knew very well that even if they joined forces, they wouldn’t stand a chance against Arwen.
Meanwhile, Estelle and Isaria both looked at Luke with surprise.
But that surprise quickly turned into worry.
’He shouldn’t have stepped forward.’ Estelle could clearly see Luke’s tough persona.
Although she was secretly happy that he had stood up for her, the warmth in her heart was accompanied by concern.
After all, very few people had ever stood up for her like this.
But sadly, this was clearly a misunderstanding.
Although Estelle’s involvement had played a small part in Luke’s actions, the decision to step forward had ultimately been entirely his own.
If this had been the old Luke, he might have stopped to carefully assess the situation before acting.
But the current Luke was different.
He was a true Titan now.
And Titans didn’t merely possess intelect.
They also possessed pride.
Arwen’s word—filth—had struck directly at that pride.
The pride Luke had slowly begun developing ever since he had become a true Titan.
A Pure Titan.
Seeing that Luke could actually get hurt, Estelle finally decided to intervene.
However, just as she was about to take a step forward—
"Say it again." Luke’s calm voice echoed through the plaza.
Arwen, who had already been struggling to contain his anger, felt the last thread of his patience snap.
’How dare a mere filth speak to me while looking down at me?’
"Filth." So this time, Arwen said it openly.
But the expected reaction never came.
’Sigh... what can we expect from him?’ Seeing this, many people sighed.
Some even quietly breathed a sigh of relief.
Kira, Nolan, Isaria, and Estelle were among them.
After all, enduring a few insults was far better than watching Luke get crippled or seriously injured.
That was something their race had often suffered from in the past.
Meanwhile, Roderan and Drevian merely sighed.
They had already expected this outcome, so they weren’t particularly disappointed.
"Seems like your fine specimen really is a coward." Ivar mocked Alia, referring to her earlier judgment of Luke.
He was also secretly pleased to see Luke being insulted.
After all, if Isaria truly possessed that special ability, then her attention shouldn’t be on anyone else.
It should belong to him alone.
Alia’s expression darkened at Ivar’s mocking words, but she couldn’t find anything to say in response.
Fael, Joria, Karon, and Lirael simply sneered.
They had expected this from the beginning.
But among everyone present, Marius was the only one genuinely annoyed.
’Why aren’t they fighting?!’
As for Zeyr, he could only sigh.
He had genuinely thought highly of Luke’s pride.
As these thoughts continued to pass through everyone’s minds, most of them assumed that the matter was finally over.
Then Luke spoke again.
This time, however, it was their turn to be shocked.
"I didn’t know." A wide grin appeared on Luke’s face.
"...That ants nowadays talk so big."
Another silence descended upon the plaza.
This time, it was even quieter than before.
The moment those words fell, Arwen’s mind completely snapped.
"Bas—"
Sadly, he didn’t even get the chance to finish those words.
Since, in the very next instant—
BOOM!
Luke’s body suddenly began expanding at an astonishing speed.
His muscles grew larger, his frame rapidly towering over everyone around him.
In the blink of an eye, the seven-foot-tall Luke had transformed into a twenty-foot giant.
At the same time, his clothes automatically adjusted to his rapidly expanding body, leaving them completely intact.
Soon, a bare-chested Titan, standing twenty feet tall, appeared before everyone.
Long, dark-black hair cascaded down to his chest.
It was so dark that the surrounding area seemed to grow dimmer simply from its presence.
His eyes had also transformed completely, becoming pitch-black like an endless void.
Above his head floated a pitch-black halo, formed entirely from condensed Void Energy.
With every breath Luke took, the halo pulsed.
WHUMM...
Waves of Void Energy spread through the surroundings, causing the air itself to tremble.
His entire body was covered in mysterious black symbols.
They were so dark that, if Luke’s skin hadn’t been fair, the symbols would have been almost impossible to distinguish.
This was Luke’s Nyx Titan Form after becoming a true Titan.
And the difference was enormous.
Previously, his transformation had only increased his height by around two feet by each realm.
Now, it had increased by a full six feet.
His hair and eyes had completely transformed into something resembling the Void itself.
And those mysterious symbols had appeared across his entire body.
They were something Luke should have possessed from the moment he became a Pure Titan.
A newly born Pure Titan naturally possessed these symbols.
As for Titans of lower lineages, however, such symbols had to be earned or awakened after reaching certain stages of their existence.
Although Luke currently couldn’t utilize the true power hidden within these symbols, their existence alone represented something extraordinary.
And once he reached higher realms...
He would eventually discover just how miraculous they truly were.

chapters.title: Chapter 269: He Thought Luke Was Weak... Until Gravity Crushed Him!
paragraphs: "What the hell?!"
"What the f*ck?!"
"How can this be?!"
"IMPOSSIBLE!"
The entire plaza erupted in disbelief.
From the students and professors to Zeyr, Karon, Marius, Fael, Joria, Kira, Nolan, Ivar, Alia, Isaria, and Estelle, everyone’s faces were filled with utter shock.
Some of the students even had pure horror written across their faces.
Because immediately after Luke’s transformation, a complete set of black armor materialized over his body.
Valzareth.
But that wasn’t the most shocking part.
What happened next left everyone completely speechless.
In the very next instant, enormous masses of different elements appeared behind Luke.
They floated in spherical forms, arranged diagonally above and behind him.
Each sphere was positioned in perfect alignment.
Some were blazing red, radiating terrifying heat.
Others were smaller, yet equally ominous.
And farther along the formation were enormous boulders, suspended in the air as though gravity itself had lost its authority.
The entire formation looked like a celestial arsenal waiting to descend upon the world.
Lirael was already completely stunned.
Yet, unlike the others, she noticed something even more terrifying.
Her face paled as she muttered under her breath,
"Impossible..."
Because Luke’s current aura...
Was that of a Peak Golden Knight.
A freaking Peak Golden Knight!
Sadly, Lirael was wrong.
After being amplified by the 5× Titan Transformation and another 3× enhancement, Luke’s raw power had reached the equivalent of 500 Peak Golden Knights.
In terms of realm classification, that placed his raw strength around the Half-Platinum Knight level—a Half-B Rank existence.
So why couldn’t anyone see through his true cultivation?
Since Luke’s actual cultivation was still only around the Early Silver Knight level in terms of raw power.
The reason they couldn’t detect it was simple.
Luke had learned how to control his aura through battles and practice.
And becoming a true Titan had further enhanced his ability to manipulate it.
Earlier, when he had first transformed, an enormous amount of Aether had erupted from his body.
It had spread throughout the surroundings like an huge lake, making his true realm impossible to hide.
But now, things were completely different.
A thick pillar of Aether surrounded Luke’s body.
It was incredibly dense, compressed so tightly that it almost seemed tangible.
Lirael could only sense that enormous concentration of Aether and naturally mistook it for the aura of a Peak Golden Knight.
However, Roderan and Drevian were able to see through it.
Their eyes had already noticed the subtle flaws in Luke’s aura control.
His technique wasn’t perfect enough to completely escape the perception of two experienced experts.
’Interesting.’ Despite seeing through Luke’s disguise, both principals remained where they were.
Neither had any intention of interfering.
Instead, they continued watching the scene with interest, waiting to see how everything would unfold.
Luke noticed this from the corner of his eye and secretly breathed a sigh of relief.
After all, from the outside, it might have seemed like he was recklessly releasing his aura in front of A-Rank beings.
But seeing that neither Roderan nor Drevian showed any intention of interfering, Luke finally relaxed.
’Still not enough.’ Luke thought with annoyance.
After all, the Cosmic System he had just summoned was already perfectly aligned behind him.
He had learned this trick during his journey.
However, the gravitational force of those celestial bodies wasn’t fixed.
The problem was that Luke still couldn’t control it properly or bring out full potential of it.
That was what frustrated him.
’If I use Cosmic Lock like this, it’ll only produce around 900 Peak Golden Knight levels of gravitational force.’
’That’s not even Early B-Rank.’
He couldn’t help but feel dissatisfied.
Then, an idea suddenly crossed his mind.
The next moment, the halo floating above his head began to change.
The pitch-black Void Energy gradually disappeared, replaced by dazzling golden-white Cosmic Energy.
The moment the transformation was complete, Luke’s eyes widened slightly.
He could feel it.
Unlike Void Energy, Cosmic Energy allowed him to manipulate the gravitational force of his Cosmic System with far greater precision.
So he could finally increase the gravity without losing control over it.
Feeling this, a huge grin slowly appeared on his face.
’So that’s how it works.’
Meanwhile, Arwen had also noticed the celestial masses floating behind Luke.
And when he saw the strange grin spreading across Luke’s face...
An ominous feeling suddenly rose within his heart.
Even though Arwen found it absurd that he was facing such a situation at the hands of a Peak Golden Knight, but the next moment, his eyes widened in horror.
Every instinct within his High Elf B-Rank body screamed at him.
Run.
Run now...
Or you won’t be able to run ever again.
"Cosmic Lock." A low whisper escaped Luke’s lips.
But the result was anything but silent.
WOOOOOM!!!
An overwhelming gravitational force suddenly descended upon the area.
The ground beneath Arwen, within a radius of one meter, couldn’t withstand the immense pressure and instantly crumbled into dust.
BOOM!
Arwen’s entire body was slammed against the ground.
His limbs were pressed firmly against the earth, leaving him completely unable to move.
"WHAT?!"
"WHAT!!!"
Everyone exclaimed in disbelief. Their expressions turned pale.
’A Peak Golden Knight had just effortlessly subdued an Early B-Rank existence.’
’That was beyond absurd. It was simply madness.’
Yet Luke didn’t pay any attention to the surrounding cries of shock.
He calmly looked down into the pit where Arwen lay helplessly pinned beneath the terrifying gravity.
"What did you say earlier?"
Arwen completely ignored Luke’s taunt.
His entire focus was on escaping the terrifying gravitational force pinning him to the ground.
He tried to move his arms.
Nothing.
He tried to move his legs.
Still nothing.
Hell, he couldn’t even move his lips.
So finally, he attempted to release his aura and channel his Essence throughout his body, hoping to use his power to resist the overwhelming gravity.
But every attempt ended in failure.
’How?!’ Arwen was completely stunned by the realization.
No matter how much strength he tried to muster, his body simply refused to move.
"Yeah, filth." Luke continued calmly, clearly enjoying Arwen’s helpless state.
Seeing this, the others initially became worried.
However, once they confirmed that Arwen was still alive, they quietly breathed a sigh of relief.
After all, having a High Elf die within their territory would be disastrous.
Especially since they were humans.
And Arwen was also a representative of Empyrean Academy.
But the next moment, quiet whispers began spreading through the crowd.
"Serves him right."
"Yeah, he deserved it."
After all, High Elves—and even elves of lower status—often looked down upon humans.
So seeing a High Elf being humiliated by a human was strangely refreshing for many of them.
Estelle, Kira, Nolan, and Isaria also looked noticeably more relaxed than before.
After all, Luke’s treatment of Arwen felt like revenge on behalf of every human who had ever been looked down upon by the elves.
Lirael noticed this as well.
"How dare you!"
"Disrespecting a High Elf!"
She shouted angrily and immediately tried to release her aura and Essence.
But before she could do so—
’When?!’ Her eyes widened in horror.
Three pitch-black swords were already pressed against her body.
One rested against her neck.
Another pierced through the Essence protecting her heart.
And the third was positioned against the back of her head.
"Damn, the Hero can do this as well?!"
Several students exclaimed in shock upon seeing Lirael’s situation.
Standing around her was the same twenty-foot-tall Nyx Titan.
An exact duplicate of Luke.
’His clone.’ The students immediately remembered Luke’s ability to create clones.
And at this distance, with their weapons already touching Lirael’s body, she didn’t dare move even an inch.
After all, those swords weren’t merely touching her.
All three had already pierced through her skin and the protective layer of Essence surrounding her body.
Even though such a thing should have been impossible in her eyes, Lirael didn’t dare take the risk.
This Hero was clearly using some kind of strange technique.
"Be a nice girl and stay there." Luke said it casually from his position before bending down toward Arwen.
"If you don’t have the strength, then don’t fucking bark in front of me."
His eyes narrowed dangerously.
And a red, solar-like flame suddenly appeared in his left hand, covering only his palm.
"This time, I’m giving you a small lesson."
He slowly lowered his hand toward Arwen’s face.
"Since you belong to the race where my wife, Elaria, resides..."
The flame drew dangerously close to Arwen’s face.
Luke’s eyes became even colder.
"But there won’t be a next time."
"AAAAAAAAARGH!!!"
Arwen’s agonized scream tore through the silence.

sentences.text: "What the hell?!"
"What the f*ck?!"
"How can this be?!"
"IMPOSSIBLE!"
The entire plaza erupted in disbelief.
From the students and professors to Zeyr, Karon, Marius, Fael, Joria, Kira, Nolan, Ivar, Alia, Isaria, and Estelle, everyone’s faces were filled with utter shock.
Some of the students even had pure horror written across their faces.
Because immediately after Luke’s transformation, a complete set of black armor materialized over his body.
Valzareth.
But that wasn’t the most shocking part.
What happened next left everyone completely speechless.
In the very next instant, enormous masses of different elements appeared behind Luke.
They floated in spherical forms, arranged diagonally above and behind him.
Each sphere was positioned in perfect alignment.
Some were blazing red, radiating terrifying heat.
Others were smaller, yet equally ominous.
And farther along the formation were enormous boulders, suspended in the air as though gravity itself had lost its authority.
The entire formation looked like a celestial arsenal waiting to descend upon the world.
Lirael was already completely stunned.
Yet, unlike the others, she noticed something even more terrifying.
Her face paled as she muttered under her breath,
"Impossible..."
Because Luke’s current aura...
Was that of a Peak Golden Knight.
A freaking Peak Golden Knight!
Sadly, Lirael was wrong.
After being amplified by the 5× Titan Transformation and another 3× enhancement, Luke’s raw power had reached the equivalent of 500 Peak Golden Knights.
In terms of realm classification, that placed his raw strength around the Half-Platinum Knight level—a Half-B Rank existence.
So why couldn’t anyone see through his true cultivation?
Since Luke’s actual cultivation was still only around the Early Silver Knight level in terms of raw power.
The reason they couldn’t detect it was simple.
Luke had learned how to control his aura through battles and practice.
And becoming a true Titan had further enhanced his ability to manipulate it.
Earlier, when he had first transformed, an enormous amount of Aether had erupted from his body.
It had spread throughout the surroundings like an huge lake, making his true realm impossible to hide.
But now, things were completely different.
A thick pillar of Aether surrounded Luke’s body.
It was incredibly dense, compressed so tightly that it almost seemed tangible.
Lirael could only sense that enormous concentration of Aether and naturally mistook it for the aura of a Peak Golden Knight.
However, Roderan and Drevian were able to see through it.
Their eyes had already noticed the subtle flaws in Luke’s aura control.
His technique wasn’t perfect enough to completely escape the perception of two experienced experts.
’Interesting.’ Despite seeing through Luke’s disguise, both principals remained where they were.
Neither had any intention of interfering.
Instead, they continued watching the scene with interest, waiting to see how everything would unfold.
Luke noticed this from the corner of his eye and secretly breathed a sigh of relief.
After all, from the outside, it might have seemed like he was recklessly releasing his aura in front of A-Rank beings.
But seeing that neither Roderan nor Drevian showed any intention of interfering, Luke finally relaxed.
’Still not enough.’ Luke thought with annoyance.
After all, the Cosmic System he had just summoned was already perfectly aligned behind him.
He had learned this trick during his journey.
However, the gravitational force of those celestial bodies wasn’t fixed.
The problem was that Luke still couldn’t control it properly or bring out full potential of it.
That was what frustrated him.
’If I use Cosmic Lock like this, it’ll only produce around 900 Peak Golden Knight levels of gravitational force.’
’That’s not even Early B-Rank.’
He couldn’t help but feel dissatisfied.
Then, an idea suddenly crossed his mind.
The next moment, the halo floating above his head began to change.
The pitch-black Void Energy gradually disappeared, replaced by dazzling golden-white Cosmic Energy.
The moment the transformation was complete, Luke’s eyes widened slightly.
He could feel it.
Unlike Void Energy, Cosmic Energy allowed him to manipulate the gravitational force of his Cosmic System with far greater precision.
So he could finally increase the gravity without losing control over it.
Feeling this, a huge grin slowly appeared on his face.
’So that’s how it works.’
Meanwhile, Arwen had also noticed the celestial masses floating behind Luke.
And when he saw the strange grin spreading across Luke’s face...
An ominous feeling suddenly rose within his heart.
Even though Arwen found it absurd that he was facing such a situation at the hands of a Peak Golden Knight, but the next moment, his eyes widened in horror.
Every instinct within his High Elf B-Rank body screamed at him.
Run.
Run now...
Or you won’t be able to run ever again.
"Cosmic Lock." A low whisper escaped Luke’s lips.
But the result was anything but silent.
WOOOOOM!!!
An overwhelming gravitational force suddenly descended upon the area.
The ground beneath Arwen, within a radius of one meter, couldn’t withstand the immense pressure and instantly crumbled into dust.
BOOM!
Arwen’s entire body was slammed against the ground.
His limbs were pressed firmly against the earth, leaving him completely unable to move.
"WHAT?!"
"WHAT!!!"
Everyone exclaimed in disbelief.
Their expressions turned pale.
’A Peak Golden Knight had just effortlessly subdued an Early B-Rank existence.’
’That was beyond absurd.
It was simply madness.’
Yet Luke didn’t pay any attention to the surrounding cries of shock.
He calmly looked down into the pit where Arwen lay helplessly pinned beneath the terrifying gravity.
"What did you say earlier?"
Arwen completely ignored Luke’s taunt.
His entire focus was on escaping the terrifying gravitational force pinning him to the ground.
He tried to move his arms.
Nothing.
He tried to move his legs.
Still nothing.
Hell, he couldn’t even move his lips.
So finally, he attempted to release his aura and channel his Essence throughout his body, hoping to use his power to resist the overwhelming gravity.
But every attempt ended in failure.
’How?!’ Arwen was completely stunned by the realization.
No matter how much strength he tried to muster, his body simply refused to move.
"Yeah, filth." Luke continued calmly, clearly enjoying Arwen’s helpless state.
Seeing this, the others initially became worried.
However, once they confirmed that Arwen was still alive, they quietly breathed a sigh of relief.
After all, having a High Elf die within their territory would be disastrous.
Especially since they were humans.
And Arwen was also a representative of Empyrean Academy.
But the next moment, quiet whispers began spreading through the crowd.
"Serves him right."
"Yeah, he deserved it."
After all, High Elves—and even elves of lower status—often looked down upon humans.
So seeing a High Elf being humiliated by a human was strangely refreshing for many of them.
Estelle, Kira, Nolan, and Isaria also looked noticeably more relaxed than before.
After all, Luke’s treatment of Arwen felt like revenge on behalf of every human who had ever been looked down upon by the elves.
Lirael noticed this as well.
"How dare you!"
"Disrespecting a High Elf!"
She shouted angrily and immediately tried to release her aura and Essence.
But before she could do so—
’When?!’ Her eyes widened in horror.
Three pitch-black swords were already pressed against her body.
One rested against her neck.
Another pierced through the Essence protecting her heart.
And the third was positioned against the back of her head.
