"This time, I’m giving you a small lesson."
He slowly lowered his hand toward Arwen’s face.
"Since you belong to the race where my wife, Elaria, resides..."
The flame drew dangerously close to Arwen’s face.
Luke’s eyes became even colder.
"But there won’t be a next time."
"AAAAAAAAARGH!!!"
Arwen’s agonized scream tore through the silence.

chapters.title: Chapter 270: Everyone Wanted to See Luke Get Beaten by His Wife!
paragraphs: The moment Luke’s palm came close, the red solar flame engulfed Arwen’s entire head.
His hair and clothes were caught in the flames as well, burning continuously.
Yet the fire didn’t consume him instantly.
Instead, it burned him slowly, keeping him alive as the pain continued.
Luke knew that with the Essence possessed by B-Rank beings, their wounds would heal immediately. Thats why, all this done.
Earlier, Roderan and Drevian had remained silent because they were helpless.
This time, however, they remained silent because they simply chose to.
’These arrogant Elves need to be taught a lesson.’ Roderan silently thought this, though he kept the thought to himself.
After all, being burned, cut, or stabbed was nothing particularly unusual for beings at this level.
Lirael gritted her teeth and glared hatefully at Luke.
Noticing her gaze, Luke suddenly smiled playfully.
"Miss, I’m not interested in you."
He tilted his head slightly.
"So please, you don’t need to stare at me so intensely."
The mouths of everyone nearby twitched.
’What a womanizer.’
They had already heard the rumors about Luke flirting with every beautiful woman he encountered.
And now, they were witnessing it firsthand.
[Luke, you chose the wrong time for this.]
A system screen appeared beside Luke.
The message was accompanied by a praying emoji, as though the system itself was praying to the gods for Luke’s survival.
’Save me?’
As that thought crossed his mind, a somewhat dangerous voice—one he often heard from his wife Aurielle back home—suddenly echoed through the plaza.
"Darling~"
"I’ve been standing here waiting for you for so long~"
"But you’re busy playing with Tree Rats, and now you’re even flirting with another Tree Rat~"
Selene’s voice spread across the entire plaza.
The next moment, the sky above Horizon Academy suddenly turned deep crimson.
It was as if the entire heavens had been dyed in blood.
Even Luke’s Cosmic System was instantly covered in a layer of crimson energy.
Not a single celestial body was spared.
Even his central star had transformed into a terrifying blood-red sphere.
’Damn... I’m fucked.’
The system went silent for a moment.
Then—
[Luke, I heard that when someone gets too close, they meet each other in the next world.]
[I will be waiting for you.]
The system saw Luke silence and added other words.
[Don’t worry, Luke.]
[Atleast, your funeral will be handled professionally.]
"Darling~"
"Why are you not responding~"
[Probably.]
The moment those words echoed through the plaza, everyone got goosebumps.
Their gazes immediately turned toward Selene.
She was still standing in the same place.
Her long pink hair floated widly behind her, but her deep-red eyes were firmly locked onto Luke.
Yet, the most frightening thing wasn’t her gaze.
It was the crimson Essence covering her entire body like an aura.
The pressure it released was so suffocating that Drevian, the vice principal, immediately had to release his own Essence to shield the nearby students from it.
However, the expressions of the Empyrean Academy representatives were completely different.
Their faces had turned pale with horror.
A certain rumor immediately resurfaced in their minds.
*If you ever see Selene glowing like this with those red eyes...*
*Run.*
*Or stay quiet.*
There was a reason for that warning.
Even at Empyrean Academy, Selene had entered this state only twice.
And those incidents had earned her a terrifying title.
*The Crimson Witch.*
The first time was when someone had spoken badly about her biological mother.
The result?
That person had ended up in a coma for an entire year.
The second time was when someone had attempted to force himself upon her.
That person never recovered.
Because Selene had killed him.
Even then, Selene hadn’t received any punishment.
After all, her mentor was also a high-ranking member of Empyrean Academy.
"And now... this is the third time."
The representatives slowly looked toward Luke with pity.
’Sadly, his pride won’t be able to save him.’ Zeyr sighed at the thought, while Karon simply remained silent.
"Ahh... seems like we won’t be able to make children anymore."
Alia whispered sadly, her white eyes remains fixed on Luke.
"Well, he was lucky to survive under psycho wives." Ivar commented with a hint of praise, though the happiness in his voice was obvious. Because, Luke would finally going to removed from his way.
Fael and Joria were also secretly pleased.
After all, this meant Luke probably wouldn’t become a problem for their princess anymore.
"Sigh... A strong Hero finally appeared among our race, but now..."
Kira and Nolan exchanged pitying glances.
Neither of them dared to approach Selene and try to calm her down.
After all, judging from what they knew about the Crimson Witch, she wouldn’t be coming out of this state anytime soon.
Estelle and Isaria were also secretly frightened.
Earlier, while talking with Luke, they had completely forgotten one important fact.
*The princesses Luke had married...*
*Were all absolute psychos.*
Since, each of them had their own terrifying stories.
And now, both women couldn’t help but wonder if Selene’s anger might eventually be directed toward them as well.
As those thoughts crossed everyone’s minds, however...
There was one person who was happier than anyone else.
"Kekeke..." Marius suddenly let out a sinister laugh.
A few nearby students immediately flinched and looked at him strangely.
’Did he go crazy too?’ They exchanged speechless glances.
Marius completely ignored them.
Since a brilliant plan was already forming inside his mind.
’After Selene kills Luke, she’ll be heartbroken.’
’And when that happens, I’ll be the one to comfort her and wipe away her sadness.’
"Kekekekeke!" His evil laughter grew even wider.
To the surrounding students, it now looked like he had completely lost his mind.
If any Empyrean Academy student had been present, they probably wouldn’t have been surprised at all.
It’s normal for him.
Meanwhile, Luke had already returned to his normal form.
The Cosmic System floating outside his body also disappeared, transforming into pure energy before returning inside him.
As a result, both Arwen and Lirael were finally free.
Yet neither of them dared to move.
Arwen, in particular, had already made the safest decision possible.
He was pretending to be dead.
After all, it wasn’t only him.
Even the other representatives wouldn’t dare provoke Selene openly in her current state.
After all, Selene was stronger than every representative present.
Perhaps only the Dragons could survive a few exchanges with her.
But the real problem was that none of them were Royals.
Selene, on the other hand, was a full-fledged member of the Vampire Emperor’s Royal Family.
Unlike Aurielle, she had never been exiled.
That meant she still retained her status as a member of the Royal Family.
The others were merely high-ranking nobles.
"Selene." Luke gently called her name as he stepped closer.
Selene tilted her head slightly.
"Now you’re finally paying attention to me~"
Luke immediately got goosebumps from her dangerously sweet tone.
Still, he forced a smile onto his face.
Thankfully, his handsome appearance prevented the smile from looking too awkward.
He continued walking toward her.
Selene simply stared at him.
She didn’t even seem to notice when Luke finally stopped right in front of her.
Then Luke noticed something else.
Everyone’s eyes were fixed on them.
’They don’t have any shame?’
’This is a husband-and-wife matter.’
So the next moment, a black curtain suddenly spread outward from Luke and Selene.
WHOOSH!
The Null Veil of Nyx expanded into a spherical barrier, completely enclosing the area around them.
Within seconds, a ten-meter-wide region was completely covered in darkness.
Earlier, Luke could only use Null Veil directly on his body.
But after becoming a true Titan, his mastery over the ability had improved slightly.
Even in his normal form, he could now maintain a small area of Null Veil without much difficulty.
"Ahh, so stingy!"
A few students immediately cursed Luke for his shameless behavior.
They had desperately wanted to see what would happen next.
The same was for, Arwen, Lirael, Ivar, and Marius, as they had all been waiting for the same thing.
They wanted to see Luke get thrashed by his own wife.
But now they couldn’t, so Marius cursed him again in his mind. ’Damn you, LUKE!’

chapters.title: Chapter 271: I Tried Kissing Away My Wife’s Anger... It Didn’t Work!
paragraphs: Inside, only Luke and Selene remained.
Free from the gazes of everyone.
Free from their judgment.
"Selene." Luke called her name again, but this time, his voice carried nothing only love.
Sadly, Selene wasn’t in her right state of mind.
To her, his gentle voice sounded no different from usual.
But Luke didn’t mind.
He continued softly,
"I missed you."
Those three words finally caused a reaction.
Selene’s eyes flickered for a brief moment, the deep crimson fading slightly before returning to their darker shade.
Luke noticed the change.
A gentle smile immediately appeared on his lips.
He slowly reached out and wrapped his arms around her.
Then he pulled her into a full embrace.
Fortunately, Selene didn’t reject him.
Otherwise, it would have hurt him for sure.
When Luke finally felt her warmth and caught the familiar, rose-like fragrance coming from her body, the restless feeling that had been building inside his heart finally began to settle.
He didn’t care about her current appearance.
He didn’t care about the terrifying crimson Essence surrounding her.
To him, she wasn’t the Crimson Witch.
She wasn’t a Vampire Princess.
She wasn’t some terrifying existence capable of making an entire academy tremble.
She was simply—
His wife.
His love.
And nothing else mattered.
So Luke finally let his emotions loose.
"How have you been all this time?"
"Did you eat properly?"
"Did you take care of yourself?"
He asked one question after another while holding her in his arms.
Selene didn’t answer with words.
Instead, she answered through her actions.
Slowly, she wrapped her arms around Luke’s larger body and hugged him tightly.
Luke didn’t mind.
In fact, he quietly enjoyed the warmth of her embrace.
"You didn’t answer my earlier question, darling~"
Yet Selene was clearly hell-bent on getting an answer.
The moment her words ended, Luke suddenly felt a sharp pain in his back.
His expression twitched.
’Huh?’
Then he realized what had happened.
Selene’s nails had slightly pierced into his back, drawing blood.
Yet despite that...
Her lips, still held that dangerous smile.
Seeing Selene’s actions becoming increasingly dangerous, Luke finally decided to explain himself, hoping his words would calm her down.
"I was planning to come to you from the very beginning."
"But those Tree Rats started causing trouble."
"So, to make sure they wouldn’t create any more drama later, I simply taught them a lesson."
After finishing, Luke leaned closer and gently pressed his lips against Selene’s pinkish-red lips.
Once again, she didn’t resist.
Instead, she allowed him to kiss her.
For several moments, the two of them simply lost themselves in the warmth of the kiss, forgetting everything outside the Null Veil.
"Mmmph..."
Eventually, Luke slowly broke the kiss.
A thin silver thread briefly stretched between their lips before disappearing.
"Mmph... Hah..."
Luke exhaled softly, a loving smile appearing on his face.
"Mhmmm, you’ve become even tastier."
As he said that, Luke noticed Selene’s eye color had lightened slightly.
For the briefest moment, the deep crimson faded...
Before darkening once again.
’Damn, what’s wrong with her eyes?’
’They’re changing like disco club lights.’
Even the system became speechless after hearing that comparison.
But Luke completely ignored the horny system, which had apparently already booked his ticket to the next life.
"Darling~"
"Did you really think a kiss would be enough to hide your sin~?"
Selene clearly wasn’t going to calm down anytime soon.
But Luke wasn’t someone who gave up easily.
’If one kiss isn’t enough, then a hundred will do!’
With that determination, he leaned forward and kissed her again.
"Mmph?!"
Selene was startled by his sudden movement and the deeper kiss that followed.
For the next several minutes, the two remained wrapped in each other’s embrace, repeatedly breaking apart only briefly to catch their breath before their lips met again.
During this, Luke also kept pulling Selene closer, wanting to completely erase the distance between them.
With every kiss, his hold around her body tightened as he tried to bring her even closer.
Selene was doing the same.
Her nails were almost digging into Luke’s back, deliberately leaving painful marks.
She wanted him to feel it.
She wanted him to understand just how much she had suffered.

paragraphs: Her gaze remained on Luke’s face before slowly moving over his body.
’He had changed so much.’
’He had grown taller, while his hair and physique had also undergone significant changes.’
’And now...’
’He had become even more handsome than before.’
Of course, that didn’t matter much to her.
As she had seen even more beautiful people throughout her life.
For her, Luke is Luke.
Yet despite that, a faint sadness remained in her heart.
’He had changed so much...’
And she hadn’t been there to witness any of it.
At first, Selene had thought that bringing Luke to the academy would only make him feel inferior.
After all, every student and professor there was among the best of the best.
She was also worried that some of her enemies might even harass him.
Physically, she was confident that she could protect him.
But what about mentally?
What if the constant ridicule and harassment slowly broke him down?
And worse...
What if Luke eventually started hating her for bringing him into such an environment?
She wouldn’t be able to bear that.
That was why she had ultimately chosen to leave him behind.
And in her mind, Aurielle had been the best choice.
A weak human.
An exiled princess.
And, even less beautiful than herself.
So she had been completely confident that Luke wouldn’t fall for Aurielle before she returned and took him back.
And even if Luke somehow developed feelings for her...
She was one hundred percent certain that Aurielle wouldn’t fall for Luke, since he was declared talentless.
At least, that was what Selene had believed back then.
But everything had gone wrong after she heard that Luke and Aurielle had become far too lovey-dovey.
And Aurielle had even made Luke the Lord of her territory.
’That vixen!’
Just thinking about her made Selene’s blood boil.
She didn’t even want to think about how many times they had sex.
She couldn’t accept that thought at all.
After all...
’Luke is only mine and only belonged to me.’
’Foreever.’
Still, she had desperately tried to find another explanation.
Perhaps that vixen had only gotten close to Luke because of his status as the Hero of Light.
After all, he still had the backing of the Holy Church.
By making him the Lord of her territory, Aurielle could ensure that no one would dare attack her domain.
And Luke had always been innocent and somewhat naive.
Perhaps Aurielle had simply taken advantage of that and manipulated him.
’Yeah... that vixen definitely did it for that reason.’
As Selene convinced herself of this, the sharpness in her eyes softened slightly.
Her earlier frustration and anger toward Luke also diminished somewhat.
’My poor Luke.’
Selene gently caressed his cheek with her right hand, completely unaware that she had already smeared his blood across his cheek.
Since, her nails were still stained with his blood.
’Huh?’ Luke became confused by her sudden change in behavior.
’Whatever. At least she’s finally showing some reaction.’ So, a relieved smile appeared on his face.
Sadly, he celebrated far too early.
"In the beginning, I thought about not using that method."
Selene continued caressing his cheek, her voice surprisingly gentle.
"The method my mother taught me."
She leaned closer and gave his cheek a soft peck.
"Because if I use this method, you’ll lose your will."
Her lips slowly curled into a wide grin, revealing her fully extended white vampire fangs.
"But you’ll become mine."
"Mine only."
"MY DARLING LUKE!"
Before Luke could even process her words, Selene suddenly sank her fangs into his neck.
His eyes widened in confusion and horror.
’What?!’
’Sorry, Luke.’
Suddenly, the smile disappeared from Selene’s face.
Her expression turned sorrowful as tears began to stream down her cheeks.
’But I couldn’t bear imagining you loving other women.’
Because this method would turn Luke into a Blood Servant, but since she was doing this, he would be top quality.
Sadly, there was a terrifying price.
He would lose his own will and thoughts, becoming completely devoted to Selene.
This wasn’t the ordinary method used to create Blood Servants.
It was a special technique that Selene’s mother had personally taught her.
Her mother had never been able to receive the love she deserved from her husband and had ultimately died tragically at the hands of the royals.
She didn’t want the same fate to ever befall her daughter.
That was why she had taught Selene this technique and even told her to use it on her first night with her husband.
But Selene had never done it.
Because—
’I trusted you, Luke.’
’I believed in you.’
Her tears continued to fall as those thoughts repeated themselves in her mind.
Meanwhile, Luke could feel something happening within his body.
His limbs were gradually becoming numb as his body was slowly losing its ability to move.
Even though Selene was his life...
Even though Selene was his life, he still didn’t want her to do something irreversible. Which she might regret later.
"S-System, what the heck is g-going on?!"
Luke asked in panic as he felt his body gradually slipping beyond his control.
Something was happening to him.
The strange effect spreading through his body was making it increasingly difficult for him to maintain control over himself.
And the most confusing part was the sensation accompanying it.
A strange wave of pleasure kept washing over him, making it even harder for him to resist.
Meanwhile, Selene suddenly froze.
’Huh? Why is his blood so tasty?’ She was genuinely confused.
As a naturally born vampire, she didn’t actually need blood to survive.
Because of that, she rarely drank it.
The only people she had occasionally drunk blood from were close friend, such as Rosalyn, who was also her maid.
But Luke’s blood...
It was completely different.
The taste was beyond anything she had experienced before.
An overwhelming sensation gradually spread through her body, leaving her struggling to process it.
Even as an Early B-Rank Pure Vampire, she found the sensation difficult to endure.
Meanwhile, the system suddenly appeared with a message.
[Finally safe.]

Yet, Alia remained surprisingly calm.
She clearly wasn’t going to draw any conclusions until she saw the result with her own eyes.
Estelle and Isaria also exchanged worried glances.
Neither of them knew what had happened inside.
So they could only wait for Luke to come out.
After several moments, the black curtain finally began to disappear.
"They’re out!"
Hearing that, everyone’s attention immediately shifted toward Luke’s location.
And then...
Everyone froze.
Luke was carrying Selene in his arms like a princess.
She was peacefully asleep.
Luke, meanwhile, looked completely fine.
There wasn’t even a visible wound on his body, and his clothes were still perfectly intact.
However, Selene’s outfit had completely changed.
Seeing this, several students’ eyes immediately lit up.
Something definitely happened inside!
"I won the bet!"
"They really did it!"
A few students immediately celebrated.
Earlier, some of them had placed bets on what would happen inside the black curtain, and the scene before them seemed to confirm their predictions.
"Tch."
"You’re lucky."
Meanwhile, one vampire felt as though his entire world had shattered before his eyes.
"NOOO!" Marius screamed with all hope lost, because the current situation indicated that his Selene was no longer pure.
’My Selene...’
He looked utterly devastated.
"What happened to him?"
"Seems like he bet too much money earlier."
"Poor guy."
Seeing Marius’s broken expression, a few students reached their own conclusions and decided it was better to ignore the strange professor altogether.
’Damn it.’ Arwen and Lirael’s expressions turned ugly when they saw Luke standing there completely unharmed.
Yet neither dared say anything this time.

chapters.title: Chapter 274: Luke’s Playful Punishment Backfires!
paragraphs: They still remembered their earlier defeat and had no intention of humiliating themselves again, when there nothing to gain anything from it.
"Interesting." Zeyr and Alia muttered almost simultaneously, clearly impressed by Luke’s performance.
The remaining representatives simply stayed silent.
Meanwhile, the human representatives, Roderan, Drevian, Estelle, and Isaria were all relieved to see Luke safe and sound.
Luke noticed everyone’s gazes but didn’t pay much attention to them.
"Sorry, everyone. Selene is sleeping right now."
"So she’ll need some time to rest."
Hearing this, Roderan simply nodded.
"Of course."
Luke then carried Selene toward the academy’s resting quarters, with Estelle and Isaria guiding him along the way.
Once they had left, Drevian, the vice principal, stepped forward and addressed everyone.
"Students and professors, disperse."
He then turned toward the visiting representatives.
"Representatives, please follow us."
With that, he led them toward their designated resting area.
Roderan also left shortly after.
Before long, the plaza became completely empty.
No one truly knew what had happened behind the black curtain.
Not even the principal and vice principal.
They could have used their powerful senses to see through it, but doing so would have been inappropriate.
Using their abilities to spy on the Hero of Light and his wife could easily create an unnecessary misunderstanding.
So the mystery remained.
And soon enough...
It would become the newest topic of discussion among the nobles and wealthy families.
3rd day of Fructus month, same year.
"Mmm... ngh..." Selene slowly opened her eyes, her body still feeling weak.
"Ngh... what happened...?" She felt that her essence reserved was low, and she didn’t remember what had happened earlier.
"Horizon Academy, then that tree rat shouted something..." She massaged her head, trying to remember, but to no avail.
"Sigh." With an exhausted sigh, she looked around and found herself in a large guest room.
The room was heavily decorated with luxurious furnishings, like portraits, chandeliers, curtains—
The moment her eyes reached the curtain, she noticed sunlight coming in through the open windows.
But her gaze didn’t linger there. Instead, her eyes fixed on the figure sleeping on the chair with a book in his hand.
The sunlight shone on his face, making his sleep uncomfortable, but he didn’t wake up.
"Luke..." A barely audible whisper escaped her lips before her eyes became moist.
Then, before her mind could react, her body acted first.
"LUKE!"
"Whoosh!"
She threw herself at him and hugged him tightly.
"Thud!"
"W-what!" Luke suddenly got startled awake, but when he found Selene in his arms,
"Haaah..." He calmed down.
"I missed you, Luke." She muttered while rubbing her face against his.
"I missed you too." He gently held her face to calm her down, but her eyes remained moist.
As if tears would fall the next second.
’It seems she didn’t remember what happened earlier.’ This thought came to his mind.
Then he got up, while also carrying her back to the bed, before gently placing her back down.
Though she didn’t break the hug.
Seeing there was no helping it, he also sat beside her, so they remained locked in each other’s embrace.
For a few minutes, neither of them said anything. They simply breathed in each other’s scent and felt each other’s warmth.
Somehow, it calmed both of their minds.
Finally, after some time, Luke gently caressed her head in his arms.
Stroke... stroke...
While gently asking, "How are you feeling now?"
Hearing Luke’s question, Selene didn’t remove her head from his chest.
Instead, she just hummed in response before snuggling a little closer to him.
Feeling her warmth against him, Luke couldn’t help but smile softly.
After that, he lightly pinched her cheek, earning an annoyed glare from her.
Then he asked playfully, "My wife is a professor at Empyrean Academy, but you never told me."
And this time, he bit her cheek.
"Luke!" She pouted and bit his cheek back.
So, for a moment, both of them ended up biting each other.
[Weird animals.]
Luke ignored the system’s comment and kept biting her. Meanwhile, one of his hands had successfully reached her as* without her noticing.
[Yeah boi.]
Then he gave it a tight pinch.
’Damn, so soft.’
"Ouch!"
"Luke!"
She shouted again, but this time, she pushed him onto the bed before getting on top of him.
"You are being so naughty."
She muttered, before noticing something poking her from underneath.
Upon seeing this, Luke smiled playfully. After bringing her to bed yesterday, he had changed her magical clothes into a maid outfit.
It was a combination of white and black.
So, currently, Selene was sitting atop him in a maid dress, yet she hadn’t even noticed it.
"What are you smiling about?" she asked, finally noticing his smile—before glancing down at her clothes.
Which results, her face immediately turned deep red with embarrassment. "Luke, you pervert!"
She began beating his chest, but Luke’s grin only grew wider.
"A master should teach his disrespectful maid a lesson."
The moment Selene heard those words—
"Smack!"
"Ow!"
Luke playfully spanked her, causing a small yelp to escape her lips.
"Now, serve your master." He rubbed her butt with force, using both hands. A teasing smile remains at his lips.
But the next thing that happened was completely different from the script.
"Hoh? Master?" Selene raised a brow before swiftly pressing both his hands against the bed.
"Thump!"
Then she leaned down, bringing her face close to his, and licked his cheek.
"What was master saying?"
She asked again, before slowly moving her ass further and down.
’Damn, she is hot.’ Luke felt bliss from her sudden action. Because that juicy ass was now doing the work.
But then, she stopped.
"That’s for today." She said with a satisfied expression before playfully patting his cheek.
As if he were some child she knew exactly how to control.
Then she got up and moved toward the window.
Luke stared at her figure before glancing down to his pants, where his little brother was bonking. Clearly asking, where was the meal.

chapters.title: Chapter 275: Luke’s Second Wife Has Finally Activated Her Rewards!
paragraphs: And that same question kept repeating in Luke’s mind.
’Where is the meal!’
So, he cast a resentful gaze toward Selene’s maid skirt, where a glimpse of her fair as* could still be seen.
"Selene, how could you do this to your poor husband!" he complained resentfully before getting up and moving hungrily toward his prize.
But Selene merely gave him a sharp glare and said something that froze him in his tracks.
"Hoh? Poor husband?"
"Then what about Aurielle?"
She moved closer to the now-frozen Luke.
Then she slowly lowered her hand and gave him a teasing tap to his balls.
"Because this seems empty, my little boy." She whispered with a displeased expression.
At that moment, she finally recall why she hadn’t remembered anything earlier.
’I lost control.’
Her gaze remained fixed on Frozen Luke, who had just been caught red-handed having an affair.
’What affair? Aurielle is also my wife!’ Luke shouted in his mind after noticing Selene’s gaze, but he didn’t dare say those words out loud.
[Nice decision, Luke.] Even the system praised his decision.
"Luke."
Suddenly, Selene’s expression turned serious, as if she wanted to ask him something important.
"What did I do yesterday?" she asked while looking straight into his eyes.
Because if she really had done what her mother taught her, then Luke shouldn’t have been standing there perfectly fine and acting of his own free will.
Luke’s earlier playful expression disappeared as well. Instead, he let out a sigh.
He didn’t want to tell her about what had happened yesterday, especially the part where she had tried to mind-control him.
Because after seeing her tears, he knew that if she found out, she would only feel guilty.
’That she tried to control me... hurt me.’
His eyes softened as he looked into the eyes of the woman he loved.
’And I don’t want you to feel guilty.’
So, putting on a casual smile, he muttered,
"Nothing. Since you were tired yesterday, you fell asleep." He told her a simple lie.
One that no one would believe.
And Selene was no exception.
"Sigh." However, she sighed and pushed those thoughts aside. Because if she really had done that, then he would have been completely under her control.
Which meant she hadn’t done it. And that calm down her mind.
Then, she looked once again at his smiling face.
’Yeah, I didn’t do that.’
"Fine, then tell me what happened earlier."
Hearing her question again, this time clearly asking about everything else that had happened, he thought for a moment before recounting everything except the part about her blood-sucking.
"Those tree rats dare!"
Selene became furious after hearing what had happened earlier.
Because those elves had dared to insult her husband.
"It’s fine. I’ve already taught them a lesson." Luke said, before hugging her angry body.
Feeling Luke’s warmth and hearing his words, Selene calmed down somewhat.
But her mind was still seething.
’I should kill their families... all of them.’
She hugged Luke as well, silently making plans to deal with those two elves and their families.
After a few minutes, they finally broke the hug.
"I am taking a bath, and don’t peek."
Selene undressed and headed toward the bathroom, deliberately swaying her naked figure as she walked, fully aware of Luke’s gaze following her.
"Damn, she has learned some tricks." Luke cursed under his breath, realizing she was clearly tempting him while deliberately refusing to let him have his way.
"Hihi~"
But then he heard her playful giggle from inside the bathroom.
Clearly, she was enjoying his torment.
[Sigh, Luke. You are getting rusty.]
The system also appeared and mocked him, increasing Luke’s annoyance even further.
But then the system finally brought some good news.
[Well, there were a few notifications from yesterday and today.]
[Do you want to check them?]
Hearing those words, Luke remembered the earlier notifications. But at that time, he had been too distracted by his wife to check them, so he dismissed them and completely forgot about them.
"Do it."
The moment those words left his mouth, several system screens appeared in front of him.
[CONGRATULATIONS, LUKE! YOUR SECOND WIFE, SELENE NIGHTVEIL, HAS REACHED THE FIRST MILESTONE!]
[LOVE AND POSSESSIVENESS! (✔) — BASE MULTIPLIER: 100X]
[CONGRATULATIONS, LUKE! YOUR SECOND WIFE, SELENE NIGHTVEIL, HAS REACHED THE SECOND MILESTONE!]
[OBSESSIVE LOVE AND SCARLET REALM (D-RANK) (✔) — BASE MULTIPLIER: 1,000X]
[STACKING DAILY CHARGES AND MONTHLY CLAIM 1/10,000 ARE ALSO ENABLED FOR YOUR SECOND WIFE.]
Seeing so many notifications, Luke was stunned before a huge smile appeared on his face.
"I love you, Selene!"
The words escaped him in his happiness, and surprisingly, another voice came from the bathroom.
"Me too."
Luke immediately shut his mouth, not expecting Selene to reply to him.
Still, knowing that he could now obtain those rewards from his second wife was amazing.
[Luke, check the system note as well.]
He paused upon reading this before clicking on the system note icon.
[Please take care of your obsessive wife and make her yandere as soon as possible.]
[Because the system encourages healthy yanderes.]
Luke closed the system screen and, for a moment, chose to keep his mouth shut. Otherwise, he would probably end up cursing at the system again.
’There is no f*cking healthy yandere!!!’
But he failed to stay silent and shouted in his mind.
Which was even more true after finding out that Selene had tried to mind-control him simply because he had been with his other wife.
[Luke, you are just a child.]
[You will learn it slowly.]
The system spoke in a sage-like voice, clearly not caring about Luke’s ignorance.
’I am not a child.’
He sat down on the bed, feeling that the system was deliberately rage-baiting him.
"Phew..."
After resting for a few moments while listening to the sound of water dripping from Selene’s body, from inside the bathroom, his mind calmed down somewhat.
Then he asked the system something that could help him a lot if it was true.

’Can the charges of my other wives be used together?’ he asked, because if that were true, then he already had a 1,000x charge multiplier, which he had obtained from Aurielle during his first day of Fructus.
[No.]
"Fine."

chapters.title: Chapter 276: Selene Wants Everyone to Know He’s Hers!
paragraphs: He looked toward the window, then outside with an expression that already told him this would happen.
Then he thought about what he should do with Selene’s monthly claim.
Even though he could use the monthly claim anytime during that month, since it didn’t have to wait for the daily returns, he still had to think carefully about what he could get from it.
"Increasing my cultivation needs a new method, since there is no potion that can help me break through my current realm."
Luke analyzed all the possibilities, but in the end, he couldn’t find anything else he could obtain for himself right now.
Earlier, the system had told him that his new cultivation path would focus on increasing his bloodline purity, similar to the demi-humans.
They purified their bloodlines so they could transform into their divine beasts or something close to them.
But he didn’t need to go that far. At least, not completely.
He only needed to increase his bloodline purity so he could regain all of his Titan power without having to transform into a pure Titan.
"And Selene..."
He slowly whispered as he thought about her.
But sadly, he realized that he really didn’t know much about his own wives.
For Aurielle, he had been able to learn a few things, but when it came to his other wives, he knew almost nothing about them.
And the same was true for Selene. Even though he had told her that he loved her, he realized he barely knew her at all.
"What a waste I am."
He slumped onto the bed, feeling bad about himself. Because of that, he couldn’t even figure out what he should choose from the system, since he didn’t know what Selene might actually need.
"Then, I’ll deal with the monthly claim later."
Having no solution for now, he decided to leave it for later.
A moment later, Selene came out of the bathroom. Her entire body was still wet, her pink hair clinging to her body, while a white towel wrapped around her upper body.
She held another towel in her hands, using it to dry her hair.
Then she noticed Luke’s downcast expression and felt a slight pang of guilt.
’Does he want to have sex that badly?’ The thought crossed her mind.
She was fine with doing it with Luke, but she was here for work, which was why she had stopped him earlier.
After all, getting distracted could cause problems with the work she had to handle.
"Luke."
She gently called out to him, but instead of the lustful gaze or resentment she expected, she saw only love in his eyes.
It was as if he simply wanted to know her better.
’Know me?’
Just as she was thinking this, a sudden knock came from the door.
Knock! Knock!
Then came the voice of a female servant.
"Miss Selene."
"The principal and the others have already gathered and are waiting for you."
Hearing her words, Selene realized that it was already afternoon and that they had to proceed with the work they had come here to do.
"Okay, wait a minute."
After saying that, the towel wrapped around her body changed, transforming into a pink top and blue pants.
"Your magical clothes are amazing." She commented, because other than Luke, she couldn’t think of anyone who could have given them to her.
"Glad you like them." He calmly whispered before turning to leave.
"Huh?"
Seeing this, she became confused.
"Where are you going?"
She quickly moved closer to him before asking.
Luke stopped in his tracks before answering.
"Isn’t this your academy work?"
His voice softened as he continued, "I just don’t want my presence to cause any trouble for you."
As he spoke, he gently brushed the damp strands of pink hair away from her face.
He had also noticed how her fellow academy professors seemed far from welcoming toward him. If he went there with her, he feared his presence would only worsen the tension surrounding her.
"So, I think it would be better if I stayed away."
Selene stood there silently for a moment, completely speechless.
Then, slowly, she raised both hands and cupped Luke’s face.
Pat...
Her eyes softened as she looked directly into his.
"And do you really think I care about their mood?" Her voice carried a faint trace of amusement, but beneath it was an unmistakable warmth.
"I’ll bring my husband with me."
Her thumbs gently caressed his cheeks.
"And if they have a problem with that..."
A confident smile appeared on her lips.
"Then they can deal with it themselves."
She leaned closer, her forehead almost touching his.
"They don’t get to decide who stands beside me."
Earlier, Selene had worried that Luke might feel inferior when surrounded by his powerful peers.
She had feared that their strength, status, and arrogant attitudes might hurt his pride.
But that worry had disappeared the moment she learned what he had done.
Those early B-Rank high elves, that would have been troublesome even for some of her peers—had been defeated by Luke with astonishing ease.
Her husband was no longer someone she needed to protect from the gazes of others.
He had grown strong enough to stand beside her.
Shoulder to shoulder.
"And besides..." Selene’s smile became gentler as she stared into his eyes.
"I want my husband beside me."
Her voice softened into something almost like a whisper.
"So, why would I ever leave you behind?"
Then the outside voice also came.
"Miss, Sir Luke has also been invited."
Hearing that, a bright smile immediately bloomed across Selene’s lips.
"Then you have to come."
Seeing her expression, Luke could only sigh with a helpless smile. But a moment later, a playful glint appeared in his eyes.
Selene noticed it and tilted her head in confusion.
"Hm?"
"Smack!"
"Ouch!"
Luke suddenly gave her a firm smack on the butt, making Selene’s face flush with anger.
Yet Luke didn’t seem bothered in the slightest. Instead, he gave her a cheeky smile.
"How could I ever refuse my beautiful wife?"
"You—!"
Her cheeks immediately turned red at his shameless words. She shot him an irritated glare before finally separating from him.
Even so, she couldn’t help rubbing her sore butt as she walked away.
Luke’s smile never faded as he followed after her.
"Are you sure you’re okay with this?" Luke asked worriedly.
They had already stepped out of the room and were now walking through the academy’s long corridor.
Ahead of them, a female servant dressed in a neat maid uniform led the way.
Yet Luke couldn’t help noticing the surrounding gazes directed toward them.
Students—both male and female—filled the corridor, while several professors could also be seen passing by.
"Why wouldn’t I be?" Selene replied calmly.
Luke’s mouth twitched.
Since, everyone was staring at them.
Not simply because he was the Hero or because Selene was a vampire princess.
There was another, far more obvious reason.
Selene was clinging tightly to him, her arm locked around his as she leaned against his shoulder.
Noticing Luke’s expression, Selene smiled innocently.
"Besides, I have to do this."
"Why?"
"Otherwise, you’ll keep flirting with other women."
Luke visibly flinched.
"I don’t—"
Before he could defend himself, Selene tightened her hold around his arm.
"And I need everyone to know that you’re my husband."
She snuggled even closer against him, her expression completely satisfied.
"...Okay." Luke could only whisper the word.
And like a lamb being led to the slaughter, he allowed himself to be dragged toward the meeting room.
"Ahh, those two look so good together."
"Yeah! Even I want a husband like Hero Luke."
Soft murmurs spread among the students as several girls secretly fantasized about having a husband as handsome and affectionate as Luke.

chapters.title: Chapter 277: The Owl Princess Has Taken an Interest in Luke!
paragraphs: Everyone, thank you so much for all your donations! And a huge thanks to my Priv Readers for continuously supporting this novel. ❤️
Your support truly means a lot to me, and I am genuinely grateful to every single one of you. ❤️
After traveling for a few minutes, they finally reached the meeting room.
Two guards clad in heavy armor stood before the entrance. Seeing them approach, both guards immediately bowed before opening the gates.
The female servant also stepped aside, allowing Luke and Selene to enter first.
They nodded toward the guards before walking inside.
The room was enormous—grand enough to rival the size of a football field.
Yet despite its massive size, it didn’t feel empty.
Bookshelves, detailed maps, ancient portraits, and various mysterious artifacts had been placed throughout every corner.
’Space magic?’ That was the only thought that came to Luke’s mind.
Although the entire island of Horizon Academy was enormous, it certainly wasn’t large enough for a single room to reach this size.
Therefore, his earlier assumption seemed to have been correct.
This room had most likely been expanded using space magic.
Then, Luke shifted his gaze toward the center of the room.
There, a large round table occupied the middle, surrounded by hundreds of seats.
Roderan, Drevian, Isaria, Estelle, and the representatives of the Empyrean Academy were all present.
Among them were Zeyr, Karon, Marius, Fael, Joria, Kira, Nolan, Ivar, and Alia.
There were also a few more professors whom Luke hadn’t seen earlier.
Meanwhile, the moment everyone noticed Selene, they nodded toward her in greeting. However, seeing Luke accompanying her made several people momentarily surprised.
Yet after recalling his earlier display of strength, his status, and even Estelle’s personal invitation to the academy, they quickly found his presence here perfectly natural.
Still, not everyone was pleased.
Marius, Arwen, and Lirael’s expressions immediately turned ugly. They clearly hadn’t expected Luke to appear here.
Ivar was no different, though he managed to conceal his displeasure much better than the others.
"Welcome, Sir Luke and Miss Selene." Roderan smiled warmly as he welcomed them into the room.
Selene merely nodded in response. She was already accustomed to receiving such respect, especially when carrying out her duties at the academy.
Luke, on the other hand, returned the greeting with a polite smile.
After that, a woman approached him with a bright smile.
"Sir Luke, it’s a pleasure to meet you."
"I’m Alia."
She introduced herself with only her first name as she gently stepped closer to him.
Luke blinked.
He didn’t know her at all.
Even so, he returned her greeting with a smile—or at least tried to.
Since, before he could say anything else—
"What do you want?" Selene suddenly stepped between them.
Her tone remained calm, but the slight narrowing of her eyes made her wariness toward Alia obvious.
Not because of Alia’s strength, but because Selene had heard certain rumors about her.
Rumors that Alia had been searching for handsome and powerful men from different races.
To outsiders, the reason seemed obvious.
They assumed she simply wanted to mate, something that wasn’t particularly strange for demi-humans.
But they didn’t know the whole truth.
Selene had uncovered something far more concerning through her assassin organization.
Demi-humans—especially those possessing royal blood, whether descended from an Emperor or a King—possessed a unique ability known as Dual Cultivation.
Through this ability, the demi-human could cultivate alongside their partner and receive half of their partner’s cultivation.
However, the same benefit did not apply to the other party.
And that wasn’t even the most frightening part.
The partner who entered into such a bond would gradually become addicted to the demi-human.
Once that happened, they would essentially fall into the demi-human’s control.
Whether they were nurtured, drained of their cultivation, or completely used up would depend entirely on the demi-human.
It was an ability that only two races possessed.
Demons.
Demi-humans.
Ironically, both races even began with the same letter.
D.
Selene narrowed her eyes as she recalled this information.
Her grip around Luke’s arm tightened slightly.
"Squeeze..."
Of course, Selene still didn’t know the entire truth.
It was true that demi-humans could gain half of their partner’s cultivation progress through Dual Cultivation, but the ability came with many limitations.
And there was one particularly important detail.
A demi-human could also willingly transfer half of their own cultivation progress to a partner from another race.
However, this information was a closely guarded secret, known only among the highest-ranking nobles, Kings, and Emperors.
Even Selene’s step-sister and step-brothers were aware of it.
Selene, however, had never been told.
She had only managed to uncover part of the truth through her own investigations.
Seeing Selene’s reaction, Alia’s mouth twitched.
"Selene, you’re acting childish. You’re not usually like this."
Rather than backing away, Alia deliberately stepped closer to Luke.
Although Selene was the daughter of an Emperor, her mother also belonged to the royal bloodline of the Demi-Owl Kingdom.
Because of that, she wasn’t particularly afraid of Selene.
"Back off." Selene’s voice immediately turned cold.
"Hiss..."
Her fangs slowly emerged as she stared at Alia, leaving no doubt about the warning behind her words.
Don’t you dare come any closer to my husband.
The atmosphere around them suddenly became tense.
Seeing the scene unfold, everyone exchanged glances.
Some of those gazes even contained traces of jealousy.
After all, they were also aware of the rumors surrounding Alia.
They knew about her reputation for approaching handsome and powerful men from different races.
And now, seeing her deliberately approaching Luke—
A man who had already demonstrated astonishing strength and possessed the status of a former Hero—
several people couldn’t help but feel envious.
Of all the men here, she chose him?
Meanwhile, Selene’s grip around Luke’s arm tightened even further.
’Lucky bastard.’ Arwen cursed inwardly.
He had once tried to get close to Alia himself.
After all, she was undeniably beautiful. As, every member of the Half-Owl race was known for their striking appearance, and elves naturally appreciated beautiful things.
If Luke weren’t a human, then with his current appearance alone, every elves would probably be willing to marry him—even among the higher noble families.
Meanwhile, Zeyr simply smiled as he observed this.
He had no interest in Alia or her rumors, however.
To him, only strength and battle mattered.
The others also watched the scene unfold, each displaying a different expression.
’Why does another woman have to appear?’
Isaria felt a faint dissatisfaction upon seeing Alia’s obvious interest in Luke, though she kept her feelings to herself.
Alia, however, merely shook her head at Selene’s warning.
"Selene, Sir Luke isn’t some kind of animal you can simply put on a leash."
Her completely white eyes shifted toward Luke once more.
There was an unmistakable desire in her gaze.
"Such a fine specimen should be allowed to run wild."
Everyone fell completely silent after hearing Alia’s words.
Their expressions were practically identical—speechless.
After all, Luke was already married.
And despite being bound to Selene, his reputation as a womanizer had already begun spreading far and wide.
Now Alia was actually suggesting that Selene should set him free?
’Then would there be any women left for us?’
Several of the men silently looked toward Luke’s handsome face.
For the first time, they were genuinely grateful that the man was already married.
Otherwise, they might not have had any chance at all.
Meanwhile, Selene’s expression became colder.
"Alia."
She stared directly into Alia’s completely white eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 278: The Meeting Has Become Luke’s Harem Gathering!
paragraphs: "Don’t even think about my husband."
Her grip around Luke’s arm tightened.
"Otherwise, you’ll regret it."
Alia simply smiled.
She calmly met Selene’s crimson gaze without showing the slightest trace of fear.
Although direct combat wasn’t her specialty, she wasn’t helpless.
As a member of the Demi-Owl royal bloodline, she possessed several powerful and secret techniques.
She simply rarely fought.
Because of that, many people had mistakenly assumed that she was weak.
Now, however, the atmosphere between the two women gradually became tense.
Neither looked away.
Crackle...
Zap...
It almost seemed as though invisible sparks was flashing between their gazes.
Luke stood between them with an expression that clearly said he had absolutely no idea what to do.
Still, he wisely chose to remain silent.
Just as it seemed the two women were about to start fighting—
"Ahem."
Roderan finally stepped in.
"Ladies and gentlemen, we should begin our discussion." Roderan’s calm voice immediately brought the two women back to their senses.
Neither Selene nor Alia dared to openly disrespect an A-Rank powerhouse, especially when he was speaking so calmly.
Still, before taking her seat, Selene gave Alia one final warning glare.
Alia, however, simply responded with a sweet smile toward Luke.
Luke kept his expression completely neutral.
’...Don’t get involved.’
Soon, everyone took their seats around the large round table.
But—
"Why are almost all the women sitting around him?" Nolan couldn’t help but sigh.
The other men exchanged similarly speechless glances.
Because apart from Lirael, who was sitting beside Arwen, and Joria, who was seated beside Fael, nearly every woman had somehow ended up beside Luke.
On Luke’s right sat Selene.
Beside her was Karon, followed by Zeyr.
And on Luke’s left—
Alia was sitting directly beside him.
She wore a bright smile as she looked at him.
Worse yet, several sharp-eyed people noticed that she was slowly extending her hand across the table toward Luke’s side.
It was painfully obvious what she wanted.
She was silently inviting him to hold her hand.
Luke noticed it from the corner of his eye.
His mouth twitched.
’Absolutely not.’
Meanwhile, beside Alia sat Isaria, followed by Estelle, Ivar, Kira, and Nolan.
Ivar had originally intended to sit beside Isaria.
However, Isaria had noticed his earlier gaze toward her, and it had made her somewhat uncomfortable.
So, before the meeting began, she had quietly asked Estelle to switch seats with her.
As a result—
Ivar ended up sitting farther away from Isaria.
And now, as everyone looked around the table, they couldn’t help feeling that something had gone terribly wrong.
’Why does it feel like Luke has gathered an entire harem around him?’ And this thought came into everyone’s mind.
Meanwhile, Luke silently stared ahead.
He had absolutely no idea how the seating arrangement had turned into this.
Then, Luke glanced around once.
So that’s how everyone is arranged.
With that, thought simple example of arrangement, if the round table were viewed like a clock, then he and the others were seated around the 6 o’clock position.
The Marinthians occupied the 9 o’clock position, while Arwen and Lirael sat at 3 o’clock.
At the 12 o’clock position sat the principal and vice principal, with the remaining professors seated beside them on both sides, evenly distributed around the table.
Then, before he could pay much attention to other thing—
"Luke, why did you let her sit beside you?"
Pinch!
Selene suddenly pinched his waist, her expression filled with displeasure.
At the same time—
Rub... rub...
Alia gently rubbed his other waist, seemingly completely unconcerned by Selene’s hostility.
Luke’s expression twitched.
He honestly didn’t know whether he should be happy because Alia’s gentle rubbing was rather ticklish...
Or be worried because Selene was steadily increasing the strength of her pinch.
Pinch... pinch...
’This is going to hurt.’ Roderan and Drevian exchanged a helpless glance.
Neither of them said anything.
After a brief moment, they silently decided to start the meeting and pretend they hadn’t noticed the poor man being attacked from both sides.
"I hope all of you are aware of what we’re going to do next."
Drevian’s calm voice echoed throughout the room as he scanned everyone around the table.
Most people’s expressions remained unchanged, clearly already aware of the matter being discussed.
However—
His gaze eventually landed on Luke.
The confused expression on Luke’s face made it obvious that he had absolutely no idea what they were talking about.
Drevian paused.
Then he began explaining.
"Our kingdom was established by Eldric Sunborn, the first King of this kingdom and the ancestor of Estelle Sunborn."
He briefly glanced toward Estelle before continuing.
"However, not everyone knows that he wasn’t particularly this much strong from the beginning."
Drevian paused, allowing his words to settle before continuing in a grave voice.
"He discovered something here. Something that granted him the strength he needed to rise to power and eventually establish this very kingdom."
He was revealing this information because it was something they had already disclosed to the Empyrean Academy several months ago, back when they had requested the academy’s assistance.
"Ruins belonging to the Twilight Era."
The moment those words left Drevian’s mouth, Luke’s expression changed.
The atmosphere around the table also grew noticeably heavier.
Although everyone else already knew this information, merely hearing the words Twilight Era was enough to send a chill down their spines.
After all, that era had existed more than one million years ago.
Yet the age of the ruins wasn’t even the most terrifying part.
The Twilight Era was also known by another name.
Drevian’s voice became solemn.
"The Era of the Fall of Gods."
Silence descended over the room.
A strange sense of dread seemed to creep into everyone’s hearts.
Gods.
Those high and mighty beings who stood above countless races.
Immortal beings who never aged and whose lifespans stretched beyond imagination.
They had died during that era.
And not merely one or two.
Hundreds of gods had perished.
Even after more than a million years, no one knew exactly what had happened.
Infinite theories had been proposed.
Some claimed it had been a war.
Others believed the gods had fought among themselves.
Some even believed that something far more terrifying had descended upon their world.
But none of those theories had ever been proven.
Whatever had happened during the Twilight Era remained one of the greatest mysteries in history.
And whenever its name was spoken—
Even the strongest beings couldn’t help but feel a chill run down their spines.
Drevian took a deep breath, giving everyone a moment to compose themselves after his words.
The tense atmosphere gradually settled.
Luke also calmed down as he began recalling the different eras he had learned about.
The current era was known as the Dusk Era.
It had already lasted for more than 50,000 years and was also called the Age of Rebirth—the era in which heroes began to rise once again.
Before the Dusk Era came the Shadow Era.
An age when darkness had completely enveloped Valtharion.
The sun itself no longer rose during those times, forcing every races to hide deep underground just to survive.
That era had occurred more than 100,000 years ago and was known as the Age of Darkness.

sentences.text: "Don’t even think about my husband."
Her grip around Luke’s arm tightened.
"Otherwise, you’ll regret it."
Alia simply smiled.
She calmly met Selene’s crimson gaze without showing the slightest trace of fear.
Although direct combat wasn’t her specialty, she wasn’t helpless.
As a member of the Demi-Owl royal bloodline, she possessed several powerful and secret techniques.
She simply rarely fought.
Because of that, many people had mistakenly assumed that she was weak.
Now, however, the atmosphere between the two women gradually became tense.
Neither looked away.
Crackle...
Zap...
It almost seemed as though invisible sparks was flashing between their gazes.
Luke stood between them with an expression that clearly said he had absolutely no idea what to do.
Still, he wisely chose to remain silent.
Just as it seemed the two women were about to start fighting—
"Ahem."
Roderan finally stepped in.
"Ladies and gentlemen, we should begin our discussion." Roderan’s calm voice immediately brought the two women back to their senses.
Neither Selene nor Alia dared to openly disrespect an A-Rank powerhouse, especially when he was speaking so calmly.
Still, before taking her seat, Selene gave Alia one final warning glare.
Alia, however, simply responded with a sweet smile toward Luke.
Luke kept his expression completely neutral.
’...Don’t get involved.’
Soon, everyone took their seats around the large round table.
But—
"Why are almost all the women sitting around him?" Nolan couldn’t help but sigh.
The other men exchanged similarly speechless glances.
Because apart from Lirael, who was sitting beside Arwen, and Joria, who was seated beside Fael, nearly every woman had somehow ended up beside Luke.
On Luke’s right sat Selene.
Beside her was Karon, followed by Zeyr.
And on Luke’s left—
Alia was sitting directly beside him.
She wore a bright smile as she looked at him.
Worse yet, several sharp-eyed people noticed that she was slowly extending her hand across the table toward Luke’s side.
It was painfully obvious what she wanted.
She was silently inviting him to hold her hand.
Luke noticed it from the corner of his eye.
His mouth twitched.
’Absolutely not.’
Meanwhile, beside Alia sat Isaria, followed by Estelle, Ivar, Kira, and Nolan.
Ivar had originally intended to sit beside Isaria.
However, Isaria had noticed his earlier gaze toward her, and it had made her somewhat uncomfortable.
So, before the meeting began, she had quietly asked Estelle to switch seats with her.
As a result—
Ivar ended up sitting farther away from Isaria.
And now, as everyone looked around the table, they couldn’t help feeling that something had gone terribly wrong.
’Why does it feel like Luke has gathered an entire harem around him?’ And this thought came into everyone’s mind.
Meanwhile, Luke silently stared ahead.
He had absolutely no idea how the seating arrangement had turned into this.
Then, Luke glanced around once.
So that’s how everyone is arranged.
With that, thought simple example of arrangement, if the round table were viewed like a clock, then he and the others were seated around the 6 o’clock position.
The Marinthians occupied the 9 o’clock position, while Arwen and Lirael sat at 3 o’clock.
At the 12 o’clock position sat the principal and vice principal, with the remaining professors seated beside them on both sides, evenly distributed around the table.
Then, before he could pay much attention to other thing—
"Luke, why did you let her sit beside you?"
Pinch!
Selene suddenly pinched his waist, her expression filled with displeasure.
At the same time—
Rub... rub...
Alia gently rubbed his other waist, seemingly completely unconcerned by Selene’s hostility.
Luke’s expression twitched.
He honestly didn’t know whether he should be happy because Alia’s gentle rubbing was rather ticklish...
Or be worried because Selene was steadily increasing the strength of her pinch.
Pinch... pinch...
’This is going to hurt.’ Roderan and Drevian exchanged a helpless glance.
Neither of them said anything.
After a brief moment, they silently decided to start the meeting and pretend they hadn’t noticed the poor man being attacked from both sides.
"I hope all of you are aware of what we’re going to do next."
Drevian’s calm voice echoed throughout the room as he scanned everyone around the table.
Most people’s expressions remained unchanged, clearly already aware of the matter being discussed.
However—
His gaze eventually landed on Luke.
The confused expression on Luke’s face made it obvious that he had absolutely no idea what they were talking about.
Drevian paused.
Then he began explaining.
"Our kingdom was established by Eldric Sunborn, the first King of this kingdom and the ancestor of Estelle Sunborn."
He briefly glanced toward Estelle before continuing.
"However, not everyone knows that he wasn’t particularly this much strong from the beginning."
Drevian paused, allowing his words to settle before continuing in a grave voice.
"He discovered something here.
Something that granted him the strength he needed to rise to power and eventually establish this very kingdom."
He was revealing this information because it was something they had already disclosed to the Empyrean Academy several months ago, back when they had requested the academy’s assistance.
"Ruins belonging to the Twilight Era."
The moment those words left Drevian’s mouth, Luke’s expression changed.
The atmosphere around the table also grew noticeably heavier.
Although everyone else already knew this information, merely hearing the words Twilight Era was enough to send a chill down their spines.
After all, that era had existed more than one million years ago.
Yet the age of the ruins wasn’t even the most terrifying part.
The Twilight Era was also known by another name.
Drevian’s voice became solemn.
"The Era of the Fall of Gods."
Silence descended over the room.
A strange sense of dread seemed to creep into everyone’s hearts.
Gods.
Those high and mighty beings who stood above countless races.
Immortal beings who never aged and whose lifespans stretched beyond imagination.
They had died during that era.
And not merely one or two.
Hundreds of gods had perished.
Even after more than a million years, no one knew exactly what had happened.
Infinite theories had been proposed.
Some claimed it had been a war.
Others believed the gods had fought among themselves.
Some even believed that something far more terrifying had descended upon their world.
But none of those theories had ever been proven.
Whatever had happened during the Twilight Era remained one of the greatest mysteries in history.
And whenever its name was spoken—
Even the strongest beings couldn’t help but feel a chill run down their spines.
Drevian took a deep breath, giving everyone a moment to compose themselves after his words.
The tense atmosphere gradually settled.
Luke also calmed down as he began recalling the different eras he had learned about.
The current era was known as the Dusk Era.
It had already lasted for more than 50,000 years and was also called the Age of Rebirth—the era in which heroes began to rise once again.
Before the Dusk Era came the Shadow Era.
An age when darkness had completely enveloped Valtharion.
The sun itself no longer rose during those times, forcing every races to hide deep underground just to survive.
That era had occurred more than 100,000 years ago and was known as the Age of Darkness.

chapters.title: Chapter 279: The Secret Power of the Beast Royals!
paragraphs: Luke’s eyes narrowed slightly.
Now, he finally understood where that darkness might have come from.
Or at least, he understood it to some extent.
The answer likely went all the way back to the Twilight Era.
If the gods had truly fought during that ancient period, then the scale of their battles must have been beyond imagination.
Their clashes could have nearly destroyed Valtharion itself—tearing apart the atmosphere, devastating the land, and leaving nothing behind but catastrophic remnants.
’Perhaps that was why it had taken more than a million years for Valtharion to recover.’
’One million years...’
Luke couldn’t help but feel a little stunned by the sheer scale of it.
And as for what had existed before the Twilight Era—
He had no idea.
Still, there was one logical possibility.
If the Twilight Era was known as the Era of the Fall of Gods, then perhaps the era before it had been the complete opposite.
An age when the gods stood at the peak of their glory. Where they freely walked across Valtharion.
Luke’s thoughts continued for a moment before he shook his head.
Thinking about things I don’t know won’t help me right now.
He pushed those thoughts aside and returned his attention to Drevian.
Drevian continued.
"And the late King Eldric discovered something within those ruins. Something that ultimately became the foundation of his success."
He paused before letting out a quiet sigh.
"For generations, the kingdom continued attempting to explore those ruins. In fact, that was one of the primary reasons this academy was established in the first place."
His gaze swept across the room.
"So that we could study the ruins and uncover their mysteries as quickly as possible."
His voice gradually became heavier.
"But sadly, despite all these years..."
He shook his head.
"We haven’t made any meaningful progress."
The ruins had eventually attracted the attention of other nations and powerful nobles.
Even the Human Emperor had learned of their existence.
However, rather than allowing the matter to become a direct conflict between kingdoms, they decided to involve the Empyrean Academy.
That decision also prevented the Human Emperor from directly interfering in the matter.
Although the human kingdoms belonged to the same Empire, the Empire didn’t possess absolute authority over them.
The human kingdoms maintained their own governments and were largely free to make their own decisions.
The Empire itself had primarily been formed to unite humanity under a single banner when dealing with the outside races.
It also served as a united force in the event of an external invasion.
Beyond that, the individual kingdoms were free to govern themselves as they wished—unless they voluntarily sought the Empire’s assistance in managing their affairs.
And this kingdom had never done so.
Roderan finally spoke.
"And today, all of you will be participating in the new expedition to explore the ruins."
Hearing this, everyone nodded.
That was precisely why they had gathered here.
Any treasures, resources, or discoveries made within the ruins would be divided among the participating parties, with the academy receiving its agreed-upon share as well.
"And I’m certain that, with so many different talents gathered together this time, we’ll achieve far better results."
Roderan smiled as he looked around the table.
After all, the representatives selected by the academy were particularly suited for ruin exploration.
Most of them also possessed considerable experience dealing with ancient ruins.
"So, prepare yourselves."
Roderan stood up from his seat.
"In a few hours, all of you will enter the ruins."
With those final words, Roderan and Drevian left the meeting room.
After they left, the room immediately grew lively as everyone began discussing among themselves.
Meanwhile, Alia leaned closer to Luke, deliberately shortening the distance between them.
Selene’s expression darkened.
Her jealousy was becoming increasingly obvious, but Alia didn’t seem to care in the slightest.
Instead, she smiled playfully at Luke.
"Dear Luke, stay with me during the exploration."
Her smile widened as she added,
"I’ll protect you."
With that, Alia finally backed away.
After all, Selene’s eyes were practically popping out of their sockets from anger.
The moment Alia moved away, Selene turned her furious gaze toward Luke.
Luke could only stare back at her with an innocent expression.
’What did I do?’
Unfortunately, his silent question did nothing to appease her.
"Hmph!"
Selene turned her head away and settled back into her chair, clearly refusing to entertain any explanation.
Luke could only helplessly watch her.
Meanwhile, on Luke’s left, Ivar leaned slightly forward across the table and turned his attention toward Isaria.
A charming smile appeared on his face.
"Lady Isaria, it’s a pleasure to meet you."
Isaria, who had been watching Luke from the corner of her eye, was caught off guard by the sudden voice.
She quickly turned toward Ivar.
Although she wasn’t particularly interested in the conversation, ignoring his greeting would have been considered disrespectful.
So, she gave him a polite smile and replied,
"Likewise, Sir Ivar."
Hearing her response, Ivar’s smile widened.
However, before he could continue the conversation, Estelle suddenly stepped between them.
"Sorry, Sir Ivar, but Isaria and I still have a few things to check."
Without giving him a chance to respond, she reached over and took Isaria’s hand.
"Come on."
Isaria blinked in surprise, but she allowed herself to be pulled away.
The two women soon left the room together.
Ivar’s smile disappeared.
Instead, his eyes narrowed as he watched them leave.
’Is she an idiot?’
’It was obvious.’
Not only to him, but even to Isaria and Estelle, that he had deliberately approached Isaria.
He was a prince of the Owl Kingdom and a representative of the Emperyan Academy.
Someone of his status was hardly approaching her merely for a casual conversation.
Yet Estelle had openly pulled Isaria away without even giving him an opportunity to continue.
For a moment, irritation flashed across Ivar’s face.
Then—
His narrowed eyes slowly relaxed. While a smile returned to his lips.
But this time, there was nothing charming about it.
It was Sinister.
There was a secret known only among the highest bloodlines of the Beast Empire—a secret carefully concealed from the other races.
Their royal blood possessed a terrifying ability.
That, they could seize and reproduce fragments of another individual’s innate talents and special abilities.
Even an Origin Skill could potentially be affected, although doing so was far more difficult.
Normally, they would it over the course, slowly.
But there were exceptions.
If they willed, they could do it forecefully, resulting shorten duration.
The thought crossed Ivar’s mind.
Making his smile widened.
Since, this was the not the first time, he had used it before.
And now—
His gaze shifted toward the direction Isaria had disappeared.
’I tried to be gentle, but it’s you who chose to refuse.’
Ivar slowly raised a hand, covering his lips as the corners of his mouth curled upward.
The smile kept widening.
And widening.
Until the charming expression he had worn moments ago was completely gone, replaced by a sinister grin.
After all, if his assumption was correct, then taking Isaria’s ability—or even a portion of her Origin Skill—would make his own innate ability tremendously stronger.
The thought alone made his blood stir with anticipation.
His gaze then shifted toward Alia.
She was still sitting beside Luke, and was acting lovey-dovey with Luke.
’I will taste you as well.’
