chapters.title: Chapter 288: The Fourth Titan Is Finally Here!
paragraphs: Inside the thick sphere made from Cosmic materials, complete silence filled the space.
Luke’s body, which had been resting against the smooth surface, suddenly began to rise.
His body slowly floated upward until his back was several feet away from the ground.
Only the System continued its work.
A faint vibration passed through Luke’s body.
Then another.
His muscles suddenly tightened as an unfamiliar force began flowing through every part of his body.
The change started from his chest.
A small point of green light appeared beneath his skin.
It slowly expanded.
Luke’s breathing stopped for a moment.
Then—
*Thump.*
A deep pulse echoed through the sphere.
The green light spread farther, crawling through his chest before flowing into his limbs.
[Body reconstruction in progress.]
[Foreign Origin characteristics detected.]
[Beginning physical adaptation.]
Luke’s skin began to change.
The normal color of his body gradually faded, replaced by a deep, dark-grey tone.
His muscles became denser, while his shoulders broadened and his arms thickened.
Even while unconscious, his body was being reshaped into something that no longer belonged entirely to his previous form.
Yet the transformation did not stop there.
*Thump.*
Another pulse came from his chest.
The green light suddenly intensified.
A spherical core began taking shape within him, glowing with a strange necrotic-green flame.
[Titan physical structure established.]
[Sevaroth’s sealed characteristics integrating.]
[Compatibility: Increasing.]
Luke’s body continued to rise.
His height slowly increased.
Ten feet.
Twelve.
Fifteen.
Then—
Twenty feet.
His body finally stopped growing.
He now floated in the center of the cosmic sphere, while his 20 feet tall muscular frame suspended motionlessly in the air.
But the transformation was still incomplete.
A strange sensation suddenly spread behind his head.
Then the space rippled, from which a large circular structure began forming behind him.
A halo.
A gigantic metallic ring slowly took shape behind his head, divided into four distinct sections.
Dark blue.
White-gold.
Gold.
Dark crimson.
Each section carried a different presence.
The four colors represented the Seals Sevaroth had mastered, and now Luke would use them with his current realm.
[Four Sealing Paths detected.]
[Manifesting Sealing Relics.]
The halo slowly rotated.
Then—
Four points along its circumference opened.
Then chains emerged from each one.
Unlike ordinary chains, these were huge physical restraints, each carrying the distinct color of one of Sevaroth’s four Seals.
They emerged from the back of the rainbow halo and slowly descended behind Luke.
The four chains traveled downward along his back before finally piercing through his flesh.
And simply passed through his body as though his flesh offered no resistance.
The chains continued deeper until they reached the green sphere forming within his chest.
Then—
The chains emerged from the front of Luke’s chest.
Only a few segments of each chain could be seen, with their links protruding from four different points around the green sphere before disappearing directly into its surface.
[Sealing configuration established.]
[Four Seals successfully integrated.]
[Physical vessel adapting to Sevaroth’s sealed state.]
The green sphere pulsed once.
The four visible chain segments responded simultaneously, their metal links tightening slightly around the core.
Luke’s face remained completely unchanged.
There was no helmet, as the original Sevaroth had.
However, his current Crypt Titan form didn’t have any of those mysterious symbols, as other pure titans had.
[Titan Form stabilization in progress.]
[Sevaroth’s Origin synchronization: 81%...]
[MERGE COMPLETE.]
[Congratulations, Luke.]
[You have successfully merged with Sevaroth, the Crypt Titan.]
[New Titan Form acquired.]
[Fourth Titan has officially become part of your’s.]
Inside the sphere, the twenty-foot-tall Luke remained suspended in complete silence.
His eyes were still closed.
The rainbow halo behind his head slowly rotated.
The four chains remained hidden behind his body, with only a few links emerging from four directions around the green sphere in his chest.
For the first time...
Sevaroth had found a new vessel.
And Luke had gained his fourth Titan.
"HAAAH—!"

Luke suddenly opened his eyes and sucked in a deep breath, inhaling as much air as he could as though he had just surfaced from the deepest part of the ocean. His chest rose and fell rapidly while he tried to calm himself, but the feeling from that dream still lingered vividly in his mind.

It had felt as though he had been trapped inside something that was never meant for a living being. There was no air to breathe, no sensation from his body, nothing to eat, and not even the ability to see. There was only his consciousness, left alone in that suffocating darkness for what felt like an eternity, with a single point of green light as the only thing he could see.
He had stared at that tiny light for who knew how long, clinging to it as his only hope that perhaps, one day, he would finally escape.
"I will be free." Then, the words slipped from his lips without him even realizing it.
Only after saying them did Luke finally understand that the transformation was complete.
He was now in his Crypt Titan form.
"Huff." Taking another deep breath, Luke slowly brought his breathing under control and looked around the dark surroundings.
"I am back." A wave of relief passed through him.

With a thought, the cosmic sphere surrounding his body dispersed, revealing him completely within the ancient maze. Yet instead of immediately examining his surroundings, Luke’s attention was drawn toward his own transformed body, especially the strange chains wrapped around it and the green sphere embedded within his chest.
"What is this?" He muttered curiously, waiting for an explanation.
But the System remained silent.

After waiting for a moment and receiving no response, Luke gave up and shifted his attention toward the chains instead. His gaze followed them across his body before eventually moving upward, finally settling on the strange rainbow-colored halo.
At present, the halo was glowing with four distinct colors, each one representing one of his four unlocked seals.
"Interesting."

Luke reached out and touched the halo, only to discover that the chains surrounding it were completely beyond his ability to break. Nothing he possessed could damage them. The only existence capable of breaking those chains was the Cosmos itself.
"Well, the Cosmos of this world wouldn’t do that."
His Forbidden Titans had originally come from another universe—a fact Luke already knew, since their entire universe had been destroyed.
Even so, he had never expected the Cosmos of this world to lend him a hand, let alone help his Titans.
Valtharion itself had shown no intention of doing so either.

chapters.title: Chapter 289: Sevaroth’s Masterpiece REVEALED: The Armor That Turns Seals Into Keys!
paragraphs: "Whatever." Luke shook his head, pushing those thoughts aside before something else caught his attention.
The Crypt Titan’s halo was much larger than the halos of his other Titans.

Nyx and Caelith, for example, possessed fixed-sized halos. No matter what form they took or how large their bodies became, their halos always remained roughly the size of their heads, floating behind them without changing at all.
The Crypt Titan’s halo was completely different.
It reminded Luke of the oversized halos often seen behind characters in eastern comics, except this one was actually proportional to his body.
Its current diameter was around four feet, both from top to bottom and from side to side—roughly one-fifth of the Crypt Titan’s entire body.
It floated several inches behind his head, extending low enough to cover part of his neck while remaining noticeably farther from his head than the halos of his other Titans.
"Even that is good." Luke didn’t see any reason to complain about it.
Taking it as another positive difference, he moved on and summoned the armor belonging to the Crypt Titan.
Unlike his other armors, the Crypt Titan’s armor didn’t appear around his body.

Instead, the void behind Luke suddenly began to ripple, and a crimson coffin slowly emerged from within it. It was roughly ten feet long and three feet wide, its entire surface covered in flickering red flames that gave the strange coffin an almost ominous presence.
Yet the moment it completely emerged from the void, the flames abruptly disappeared.

Before Luke could even react, eight small spider-like legs unfolded from beneath the coffin. They were pitch black, and with surprising speed, they pierced directly into Luke’s Crypt Titan body before pulling the coffin tightly against his back.
The sight was bizarre enough on its own.
If someone were to see Luke now, they would find a towering Crypt Titan with a crimson coffin fastened to his back, complete with two eyes and a huge mouth.
But somehow, the strangest part wasn’t the coffin itself.
It was giggling.
"Hehehe..."
The moment Kiki attached himself to Luke, a familiar sensation spread through his body.
Luke had felt this same connection when he first bonded with Nullex and Elythos.
It wasn’t simply the feeling of obtaining a new Titan or gaining another piece of armor.
It felt much deeper than that.
As though he had always been this Titan, and the armor had always been his companion—someone who had remained beside him for eons.
The feeling was so natural that Luke didn’t even have to think about what to say.
"Kiki, I am not carrying you." The words slipped out instinctively.
Luke himself paused. ’Why had he said that?’
Kiki, however, clearly understood.
His two eyes drooped, and his mouth curled downward as his entire expression became pitiful.
Then, with the saddest look imaginable, he detached himself from Luke’s back.

The eight black spider legs touched the ground one after another, lowering the coffin until it rested close to the floor. His back remained tilted downward while his face stayed raised, making the entire coffin look like a strange spider crawling through the maze.
"You should learn how to behave." Luke said it again without even thinking.
But as soon as the words left his mouth, he frowned.
’That was strange.’
He had no idea why he was saying such things to Kiki, yet somehow, neither the words nor his attitude toward the coffin felt unfamiliar.
"Weird feeling."
Rather than dwell on it, Luke decided to leave the matter alone and opened Kiki’s information.
Meanwhile, Kiki had already lost interest in Luke.
The little coffin began wandering through the dark pathway on his eight spider legs, aimlessly crawling from one place to another in search of something—anything—that might relieve his boredom.
[Coffin of Infinite Keys]
Type: Forbidden Titan Armament
Creator: Sevaroth, the Firstborn Crypt Titan
[Origin]
Sevaroth once sought to create a single Forbidden Key capable of unlocking the Cosmic Seal imprisoning his true existence.
He failed.
Instead, his countless experiments gave birth to a far more extraordinary creation—the Coffin of Infinite Keys.
Sevaroth abandoned the original name and chose this one himself, for every seal it removes can become another key stored within the coffin.
[Absolute Unsealing]
Classification: Seal Removal
Description:
A forbidden masterpiece created by Sevaroth after countless ages of studying the Cosmic Seal imprisoning his true existence.
Although it could not remove the seal placed upon Sevaroth by the Cosmos, the armor achieved something extraordinary—the ability to forcibly separate a seal from whatever it restrains.
It can remove almost any known seal, provided the user can satisfy the price demanded by the armor.
The required cost varies according to the seal and may demand energy, life force, souls, resources, planets, stars, or something even greater.
[Seal Extraction]
• Removes the selected seal from its target.
• Extracted seals are preserved inside the coffin.
• Each extracted seal can be used once.
• Used seals are permanently consumed.
• No known limit exists for stored seals.
[Seal Storage]
Every removed seal is preserved as a complete sealed imprint.
The user may release any stored seal whenever desired.
[Storage Capacity: Unknown]
[Special Property]
The coffin does not destroy the seals it removes.
It turns them into keys.
"Another attempt, and it was also a failure."
Luke stared at Sevaroth’s information for a few more seconds before finally letting out a sigh.

The more he learned about this Titan, the harder it became not to feel sorry for him. Every path Sevaroth had tried to walk seemed to end the same way—blocked, sealed, or turned against him. Even after everything had been taken from him, he had continued searching for another way forward, only to encounter yet another failure.
Luke was beginning to wonder just how many times someone could be pushed down before finally giving up.
But before that thought could settle—
"Kid, I don’t need your pity."
The unfamiliar voice came so suddenly that Luke’s expression froze.
His head snapped toward the direction of the voice, and after finding its source, his eyes widened in genuine surprise.
A moment later, that surprise turned into a smile.
"Welcome, Sevaroth."
There was no mistaking the figure floating before him.
Like Luke’s other Titans, Sevaroth had currently taken on his fairy form, shrinking down to a miniature size. Yet the change in scale had done little to make his appearance less intimidating.

The iron-grey helmet completely concealed his head, its surface covered with spikes while several thick bars formed a mask across the front. Not even a glimpse of his face could be seen behind them. Dark rings remained locked around his wrists and ankles, with chains extending from each one and converging toward the strange green sphere embedded in his chest.
Sevaroth was studying Luke as well.
One of his brows rose slightly upon noticing Luke’s current form.

sentences.text: "Whatever." Luke shook his head, pushing those thoughts aside before something else caught his attention.
The Crypt Titan’s halo was much larger than the halos of his other Titans.
Nyx and Caelith, for example, possessed fixed-sized halos.
No matter what form they took or how large their bodies became, their halos always remained roughly the size of their heads, floating behind them without changing at all.
The Crypt Titan’s halo was completely different.
It reminded Luke of the oversized halos often seen behind characters in eastern comics, except this one was actually proportional to his body.
Its current diameter was around four feet, both from top to bottom and from side to side—roughly one-fifth of the Crypt Titan’s entire body.
It floated several inches behind his head, extending low enough to cover part of his neck while remaining noticeably farther from his head than the halos of his other Titans.
"Even that is good." Luke didn’t see any reason to complain about it.
Taking it as another positive difference, he moved on and summoned the armor belonging to the Crypt Titan.
Unlike his other armors, the Crypt Titan’s armor didn’t appear around his body.
Instead, the void behind Luke suddenly began to ripple, and a crimson coffin slowly emerged from within it.
It was roughly ten feet long and three feet wide, its entire surface covered in flickering red flames that gave the strange coffin an almost ominous presence.
Yet the moment it completely emerged from the void, the flames abruptly disappeared.
Before Luke could even react, eight small spider-like legs unfolded from beneath the coffin.
They were pitch black, and with surprising speed, they pierced directly into Luke’s Crypt Titan body before pulling the coffin tightly against his back.
The sight was bizarre enough on its own.
If someone were to see Luke now, they would find a towering Crypt Titan with a crimson coffin fastened to his back, complete with two eyes and a huge mouth.
But somehow, the strangest part wasn’t the coffin itself.
It was giggling.
"Hehehe..."
The moment Kiki attached himself to Luke, a familiar sensation spread through his body.
Luke had felt this same connection when he first bonded with Nullex and Elythos.
It wasn’t simply the feeling of obtaining a new Titan or gaining another piece of armor.
It felt much deeper than that.
As though he had always been this Titan, and the armor had always been his companion—someone who had remained beside him for eons.
The feeling was so natural that Luke didn’t even have to think about what to say.
"Kiki, I am not carrying you." The words slipped out instinctively.
Luke himself paused. ’Why had he said that?’
Kiki, however, clearly understood.
His two eyes drooped, and his mouth curled downward as his entire expression became pitiful.
Then, with the saddest look imaginable, he detached himself from Luke’s back.
The eight black spider legs touched the ground one after another, lowering the coffin until it rested close to the floor.
His back remained tilted downward while his face stayed raised, making the entire coffin look like a strange spider crawling through the maze.
"You should learn how to behave." Luke said it again without even thinking.
But as soon as the words left his mouth, he frowned.
’That was strange.’
He had no idea why he was saying such things to Kiki, yet somehow, neither the words nor his attitude toward the coffin felt unfamiliar.
"Weird feeling."
Rather than dwell on it, Luke decided to leave the matter alone and opened Kiki’s information.
Meanwhile, Kiki had already lost interest in Luke.
The little coffin began wandering through the dark pathway on his eight spider legs, aimlessly crawling from one place to another in search of something—anything—that might relieve his boredom.
[Coffin of Infinite Keys]
Type: Forbidden Titan Armament
Creator: Sevaroth, the Firstborn Crypt Titan
[Origin]
Sevaroth once sought to create a single Forbidden Key capable of unlocking the Cosmic Seal imprisoning his true existence.
He failed.
Instead, his countless experiments gave birth to a far more extraordinary creation—the Coffin of Infinite Keys.
Sevaroth abandoned the original name and chose this one himself, for every seal it removes can become another key stored within the coffin.
[Absolute Unsealing]
Classification: Seal Removal
Description:
A forbidden masterpiece created by Sevaroth after countless ages of studying the Cosmic Seal imprisoning his true existence.
Although it could not remove the seal placed upon Sevaroth by the Cosmos, the armor achieved something extraordinary—the ability to forcibly separate a seal from whatever it restrains.
It can remove almost any known seal, provided the user can satisfy the price demanded by the armor.
The required cost varies according to the seal and may demand energy, life force, souls, resources, planets, stars, or something even greater.
[Seal Extraction]
• Removes the selected seal from its target.
• Extracted seals are preserved inside the coffin.
• Each extracted seal can be used once.
• Used seals are permanently consumed.
• No known limit exists for stored seals.
[Seal Storage]
Every removed seal is preserved as a complete sealed imprint.
The user may release any stored seal whenever desired.
[Storage Capacity: Unknown]
[Special Property]
The coffin does not destroy the seals it removes.
It turns them into keys.

chapters.title: Chapter 290: Isaria Never Expected Ivar to Know Her Secret
paragraphs: Apparently, even he found it unexpected. Still, he didn’t ask about it.
His attention shifted almost immediately, and the first thing he asked was something far more important to him.
"What happened to my siblings?"
Luke’s expression became a little more serious at the question.
He had expected Sevaroth to ask eventually.
After a quiet sigh, Luke began explaining everything that had happened since Sevaroth’s siblings had first appeared in his world.
"Valtharion." Sevaroth nodded with interest, clearly intrigued by the unfamiliar name.
The mention of gods had caught his attention as well. Their universe had never possessed beings like that, so the existence of gods in this new world was naturally something worth knowing about.
Meanwhile, Luke continued explaining, "And I have no idea when they will awaken."
Unfortunately, there was little Sevaroth could do about that as well.
He had only just regained consciousness, and without any of his original power, even helping Luke search for his siblings was beyond what he could accomplish right now.
"Well, then we can wait for them."
So, Sevaroth chose to take the situation far more easily than Luke expected. Without making a fuss about it, he settled himself comfortably on Luke’s shoulder.
"Don’t mind me. Do whatever you want."
With that, he simply relaxed.
Luke nodded at his words and returned to his original form.
Kiki, however, remained with him instead of being unsummoned.
The strange crimson coffin happily moved along with Luke, apparently having no intention of separating from him now.
"Ugh."
Isaria clutched her head, her brows knitting together as the lingering effects of the earlier teleportation sent another wave of pain through her skull.
"I thought it would be a normal teleportation."
She complained quietly before slowly pushing herself to her feet and taking a careful look around. The dark pathway stretched in both directions, yet nothing seemed to be moving nearby.
"No danger."

After confirming that the area was safe, she walked over to the nearest wall and leaned against it. From her storage ring, she brought out a calming potion, uncorked it, and gulped down the contents in one go.
The soothing effect spread through her body almost immediately, greatly easing the headache that had been bothering her.
"Finally, feels better."
Isaria let out a relieved breath before turning her thoughts toward what she should do next.
"I should find Luke first."
Just thinking about him made her expression soften.
Now that they had been randomly separated from everyone else, the possibility that she and Luke might end up alone together in this enormous maze brought a faint, shy smile to her lips.
She quickly composed herself and activated the first ability of her S-Rank Origin Skill.
"Heaven-Seeking Path."
The moment the ability activated, her eyes took on an owl-like appearance, while a golden path suddenly appeared before her.
The path stretched through the darkness before splitting into two separate routes.
One led toward Estelle.
The other led toward Luke.
Isaria’s attention immediately settled on the latter.
She didn’t even consider following Estelle’s path, because the information provided by her ability clearly showed that Estelle was much farther away.
Luke was closer.
And that was all the reason Isaria needed to choose his path.

Isaria lowered her gaze toward the dark floor of the maze, where a golden trail stretched ahead of her. Small imprints resembling owl feathers appeared along its surface, guiding her deeper into the ruins and toward Luke.
"Let’s move." With that, she began following the path.

The ability continued guiding her with every step. Whenever danger awaited her beyond the next turn—whether it was a lurking monster or a hidden trap—the owl-feather imprints leading toward that direction would suddenly turn red.
At the same time, another golden route would emerge, showing her a safer way forward.

Relying on this guidance, Isaria smoothly avoided the monsters wandering through the maze as well as the traps concealed within its ancient pathways. One dark passage after another disappeared behind her as she continued deeper into the ruins, completely unaware that someone else was following her.
A hidden observer remained close behind.
"Isaria..." Ivar muttered her name, an unmistakable excitement showing on his face.
He had never imagined that even fate itself would seemingly favor him.
The moment he had been teleported into the maze, his first action had been to use his ability to locate the mark he had secretly placed on Isaria.
To his surprise, she was only three pathways away.
It hadn’t taken him long to close the distance.
After several minutes of moving through the maze, Ivar finally located her position.
Yet he didn’t immediately approach.
Instead, he remained hidden and carefully observed the surrounding area, making sure there were no unexpected dangers.
More importantly, he was waiting for the right moment.
He wanted Isaria to reach a dead end or some other confined section of the maze before revealing himself.
However, the next thing he heard immediately sent a surge of anger through Ivar.
"Soon, Luke and I will be alone."
Isaria’s shy voice drifted through the dark pathway as she continued following the golden trail, completely unaware of the figure hiding nearby.
Ivar’s expression darkened.
’Seems like I can’t wait anymore.’
He muttered the words with a resigned, can’t be helped expression before abandoning his patience and charging straight toward her.
The moment he moved, a small phantom of an owl suddenly manifested behind Isaria.
Its body glowed bright red.
"Danger."
The warning made her pupils dilate. Without wasting a moment, Isaria turned and tried to escape, but—
"It’s too late, Isaria!"
Ivar’s voice came from behind her.

Under her panicked gaze, his B-Rank cultivation erupted, and his figure instantly crossed the distance between them. Before Isaria could even react, he appeared directly in front of her and wrapped his arms tightly around her body.
"Leave me!"
Fear and anger mixed in Isaria’s voice as she struggled against his forceful embrace, desperately trying to break free from his grip.
Ivar didn’t care.

At this point, his mind was consumed by excitement. The moment he got this close to her, her scent reached him, and with her Heaven-Seeking Path still active, every instinct within him screamed that he had finally found the person he had been searching for.
’She’s the one.’
The one who could make his bloodline even purer.
The one who could push his innate ability beyond A-Rank and allow it to reach S-Rank.
The possibility alone made his eyes burn with greed.
"You are mine, Isaria."
His voice carried an almost feverish excitement as he tightened his hold.
"A monarch’s bloodline is mine."
The moment Ivar’s frantic words reached her ears, Isaria’s pupils shrank to pinpoints, especially after hearing the words Monarch bloodline.
She had never revealed the true name of her Origin Skill to anyone.
Not to the people at the academy.
Not even to her own family.
After all, it was an S-Rank Origin Skill, a level so rare that only royal bloodlines—and particularly the children of Emperors—were known to possess such abilities.
Yet Ivar had recognized it after knowing her for only a few days.
’How?’
The realization sent a wave of panic through Isaria, and she immediately began struggling with everything she had.
"Leave me, Sir Ivar!"

chapters.title: Chapter 291: The S-Rank Ability That Saved Isaria
paragraphs: Her fists struck him repeatedly as she desperately tried to tear herself from his grasp.
"What you’re doing is wrong!"
But her resistance made no difference.

Ivar calmly endured every blow, barely moving as though the attacks of an Early Golden Knight were nothing more than the desperate struggle of a child, even kissing her punches to show how futile her attacks were.
Then, with a sudden burst of strength—
Thud!
Isaria’s body was forced against the ground.
Before she could recover, Ivar pinned both of her hands above her head with a single hand, completely overpowering her.
"What is wrong?"
A sinister smile spread across his face as he lowered himself toward her, forcing her to stare into his eyes through the tears gathering in hers.
"You were thinking about Luke earlier, weren’t you?"
The words immediately made Isaria’s expression stiffen.
Ivar’s smile widened.
His free hand moved toward the front of her armor.
Isaria’s eyes widened as she realized what he intended.
Rip!
The sound of tearing armor echoed through the dark passage.
"NO." She screamed with horror, because now only her inner garment remained, covering her upper part.
However, Ivar continued, "If you are so hungry for lust, then why go toward Luke?"
His smile widened, "I can also do that, and I am sure you will be fully satisfied after I make you a proper woman."
He said sinisterly, before caressing her exposed stomach, then slowly bringing his hand toward her upper bra, with only one intention—that he would satisfy his lust today.
’No, please no.’ Isaria felt panic and horror, as she saw his hand getting close to her private parts.
Then, the earlier golden path, which had become completely red, suddenly turned pure golden and even many golden feathers appeared.
Showing that she had to take this path, which would save her 100%.
’I have to escape.’ Seeing this, she thought about which ability could protect her.
Then she remembered one ability which could help her escape.
{Silent Monarch Wings}
Description:
Manifests a pair of gigantic spectral owl wings, granting powerful aerial movement while suppressing the sounds and magical disturbances normally produced by flight.
Effects:
• Greatly increases aerial speed and acceleration.
• Allows rapid changes in direction.
• Suppresses the sound of movement.
• Minimizes magical fluctuations during flight.
• Enables silent aerial reconnaissance.
• Makes pursuit and escape considerably more difficult to detect.
However, she knew that unless she distracted Ivar, she wouldn’t be able to move even a bit.
For that, she chose her ultimate ability.
[ ULTIMATE ]
Thousand Eyes of the Monarch
Description:
Isaria manifests thousands of spectral owl eyes throughout a designated area. Each eye functions as an independent observation point and remains connected to her perception.
She can freely switch between them or observe multiple locations simultaneously.
Effects:
• Creates thousands of independent observation points.
• Allows simultaneous observation from multiple directions.
• Monitors underground areas when visibility permits.
• Tracks multiple targets simultaneously.
• Greatly expands effective reconnaissance range.
• Allows instantaneous switching between observation points.
• Provides extensive three-dimensional awareness of the designated area.
So without wasting any time, she first used her ultimate ability, as Ivar had already unhooked her bra.
’S rank Origin skill’
’Thousand Eyes of the Monarch’

The next instant, before Ivar could take behold of Isaria’s beautiful breasts, thousands of gigantic owl eyes suddenly materialized throughout the surroundings—covering the ground, floating in mid-air, and appearing across the walls.
It was as though every surface and object in the passage had suddenly grown an eye.
All of them turned toward Ivar at once, their golden pupils glowing eerily in the darkness.
Ivar’s expression changed immediately.
He froze in place, instinctively scanning his surroundings as the sheer number of eyes made it seem as though he had walked straight into an ambush.
Seeing him stunned, Isaria didn’t waste the opportunity.
’Silent Monarch Wings.’
In an instant, two spectral owl wings emerged behind her back.
The wings were silver-white and translucent, each stretching five feet long and forming a total wingspan of ten feet.
"Hah!"
Isaria poured her strength into the sudden movement and forcefully pushed Ivar away.
Caught completely off guard, Ivar stumbled backward, still trying to comprehend the sudden transformation and clearly never expecting Isaria to seize the opportunity to fight back.
Ivar immediately turned toward her.
But Isaria was already gone.
She flipped backward before spreading her silver-white wings and shooting through the dark pathway at terrifying speed.
"DAMN IT!"
"ISARIA!
His furious roar echoed through the maze.
The sound made Isaria’s already frightened body flinch, but she didn’t dare slow down.
She kept beating her wings, weaving through the maze at high speed while narrowly avoiding the towering walls and sharp turns.
A few monsters were hiding along the pathways as well.
Normally, they couldn’t detect her from a distance, but whenever she came too close, their bodies would suddenly tense before they lunged at her.
Isaria narrowly slipped past each one, refusing to let even a single obstacle slow her down.
"You can’t run from me!"
Ivar’s furious voice followed from behind.
At the same time, he activated the A-Rank innate skill belonging to his Gravewing Owl bloodline.
{Wing of the Forsaken}
{Description: Creates a massive dark wing beside Ivar that can independently block incoming attacks or sweep through enemies with tremendous force.}
The moment the ability activated, two gigantic dark-colored wings covered in owl feathers manifested behind Ivar.
Each wing stretched ten feet in length, giving him a total wingspan of twenty feet.
Swish!
A powerful flap sent a violent gust through the pathway as Ivar’s body rose from the ground.
His wings beat again, propelling him forward as he took to the air and began chasing Isaria through the maze.

Unfortunately for Ivar, the darkness element infused into his feathers offered little advantage inside these ruins. Darkness normally granted excellent stealth, but the beasts and monsters that inhabited this place had survived in darkness for countless years. Their senses had long since adapted to it, making it impossible for Ivar to conceal himself simply through the darkness element.
And unlike some specialized techniques, his wings possessed no additional ability capable of hiding his presence.
"Damn it."
Ivar cursed as another monster suddenly intercepted him from the side.
His dark wings swept through the creature in a blur, cleanly cutting apart the Early C-Rank spider beast before he continued forward without slowing down.
Anything weaker than that wasn’t worth his attention.

Whenever lower-ranked creatures appeared in his path, Ivar simply flew straight through them. The tremendous wind pressure produced by his wings was enough to tear their bodies apart before they could even get close.
The occasional Early B-Rank monster was more troublesome.
When one of them blocked his path, Ivar immediately condensed darkness into several sharp spears and launched them forward, piercing through the monster and clearing the route.
He didn’t even bother checking whether they were dead before continuing the chase.
His attention remained fixed on Isaria.
Meanwhile, Isaria was already burning through her Aether continuously.

She had pushed herself to her absolute limit, desperately maintaining her maximum speed as her silver-white wings carried her through the maze. Her S-Rank Origin Skill and the special enhancement provided by her own ability had already brought her speed to an impressive level.
Yet even that wasn’t enough.
She was gradually running out of distance.
The difference in their cultivation was simply too great.
Ivar was already at B-Rank.
She was only at the Early Golden Knight level.

• Creates thousands of independent observation points.
• Allows simultaneous observation from multiple directions.
• Monitors underground areas when visibility permits.
• Tracks multiple targets simultaneously.
• Greatly expands effective reconnaissance range.
• Allows instantaneous switching between observation points.
• Provides extensive three-dimensional awareness of the designated area.
So without wasting any time, she first used her ultimate ability, as Ivar had already unhooked her bra.
’S rank Origin skill’
’Thousand Eyes of the Monarch’

The next instant, before Ivar could take behold of Isaria’s beautiful breasts, thousands of gigantic owl eyes suddenly materialized throughout the surroundings—covering the ground, floating in mid-air, and appearing across the walls.
It was as though every surface and object in the passage had suddenly grown an eye.
All of them turned toward Ivar at once, their golden pupils glowing eerily in the darkness.
Ivar’s expression changed immediately.
He froze in place, instinctively scanning his surroundings as the sheer number of eyes made it seem as though he had walked straight into an ambush.
Seeing him stunned, Isaria didn’t waste the opportunity.
’Silent Monarch Wings.’
In an instant, two spectral owl wings emerged behind her back.
The wings were silver-white and translucent, each stretching five feet long and forming a total wingspan of ten feet.
"Hah!"
Isaria poured her strength into the sudden movement and forcefully pushed Ivar away.
Caught completely off guard, Ivar stumbled backward, still trying to comprehend the sudden transformation and clearly never expecting Isaria to seize the opportunity to fight back.
Ivar immediately turned toward her.
But Isaria was already gone.
She flipped backward before spreading her silver-white wings and shooting through the dark pathway at terrifying speed.
"DAMN IT!"
"ISARIA!
His furious roar echoed through the maze.
The sound made Isaria’s already frightened body flinch, but she didn’t dare slow down.
She kept beating her wings, weaving through the maze at high speed while narrowly avoiding the towering walls and sharp turns.
A few monsters were hiding along the pathways as well.
Normally, they couldn’t detect her from a distance, but whenever she came too close, their bodies would suddenly tense before they lunged at her.
Isaria narrowly slipped past each one, refusing to let even a single obstacle slow her down.
"You can’t run from me!"
Ivar’s furious voice followed from behind.
At the same time, he activated the A-Rank innate skill belonging to his Gravewing Owl bloodline.
{Wing of the Forsaken}
{Description: Creates a massive dark wing beside Ivar that can independently block incoming attacks or sweep through enemies with tremendous force.}
The moment the ability activated, two gigantic dark-colored wings covered in owl feathers manifested behind Ivar.
Each wing stretched ten feet in length, giving him a total wingspan of twenty feet.
Swish!
A powerful flap sent a violent gust through the pathway as Ivar’s body rose from the ground.
His wings beat again, propelling him forward as he took to the air and began chasing Isaria through the maze.
Unfortunately for Ivar, the darkness element infused into his feathers offered little advantage inside these ruins.
Darkness normally granted excellent stealth, but the beasts and monsters that inhabited this place had survived in darkness for countless years.
Their senses had long since adapted to it, making it impossible for Ivar to conceal himself simply through the darkness element.
And unlike some specialized techniques, his wings possessed no additional ability capable of hiding his presence.
"Damn it."
Ivar cursed as another monster suddenly intercepted him from the side.
His dark wings swept through the creature in a blur, cleanly cutting apart the Early C-Rank spider beast before he continued forward without slowing down.
Anything weaker than that wasn’t worth his attention.
Whenever lower-ranked creatures appeared in his path, Ivar simply flew straight through them.
The tremendous wind pressure produced by his wings was enough to tear their bodies apart before they could even get close.
The occasional Early B-Rank monster was more troublesome.
When one of them blocked his path, Ivar immediately condensed darkness into several sharp spears and launched them forward, piercing through the monster and clearing the route.
He didn’t even bother checking whether they were dead before continuing the chase.
His attention remained fixed on Isaria.
Meanwhile, Isaria was already burning through her Aether continuously.
She had pushed herself to her absolute limit, desperately maintaining her maximum speed as her silver-white wings carried her through the maze.
Her S-Rank Origin Skill and the special enhancement provided by her own ability had already brought her speed to an impressive level.
Yet even that wasn’t enough.
She was gradually running out of distance.
The difference in their cultivation was simply too great.
Ivar was already at B-Rank.
She was only at the Early Golden Knight level.

chapters.title: Chapter 292: Ivar Chased Isaria... Then She Found Luke
paragraphs: No matter how much she pushed herself, the gap between them continued to close.
"Isaria, you’re making this difficult for yourself!"
Ivar’s voice echoed through the maze behind her.
"I was going to be gentle with you, but this time, I’ll show you what hell really is!"
His voice carried a vicious edge.
The next moment, Ivar began burning through his essence.
A violent surge of power erupted from his body as his speed suddenly increased, nearly doubling compared to before.
And that was exactly why he had hesitated to act earlier.
He hadn’t wanted Isaria to escape and force him into a prolonged chase. Every additional moment spent pursuing her would only delay what he actually wanted to accomplish.
There was another reason Ivar couldn’t afford to let Isaria escape for too long.
He could only obtain the full benefit if she remained a virgin.
That was why learning about Luke had pushed him to act sooner than he originally intended.
’I will capture her and f*ck her to death.’
Ivar gritted his teeth as he continued the pursuit, his eyes fixed on the silver-white wings disappearing farther ahead.
’He’s getting closer.’
Isaria’s heart tightened when she sensed Ivar rapidly closing the distance.
She was already exhausting her Aether at an alarming rate, yet the distance between them continued to shrink.
Then, just as panic threatened to overwhelm her, a familiar golden owl phantom appeared near the junction ahead.
Isaria’s eyes immediately locked onto it.
The golden phantom was clearly signaling that the things on the other side of that junction was it, which could protect her.
There was no time to hesitate.
’Please...’
Isaria poured the last of her strength into her wings and burned through her remaining Aether, forcing her body forward at maximum speed.
Behind her, Ivar was already almost within reach.
Yet the moment he noticed another junction approaching, an uneasy sensation began spreading through his chest.
Something was wrong.
’I have to stop her.’
Ivar immediately raised one hand.
Darkness gathered around his palm before forming into a massive prison.
"Dark Prison!"
The black prison shot forward, attempting to seal Isaria’s path.
But Isaria reacted instantly.
Like an experienced bird changing direction in mid-flight, her body suddenly twisted sideways, her silver-white wings adjusting with the movement.
The prison swept past her.
She had avoided it.
Finally.
Relief flooded through Isaria as she crossed the junction.
And the instant she saw what awaited her on the other side, the tension that had gripped her entire body finally began to disappear.
She was safe.
Because, standing ahead of her, was a young man she had never seen anyone more handsome than.
His shoulder-length black hair rested naturally around his face, while his blue eyes were lowered toward the ground, focused on a strange walking coffin with a face.
Luke was currently kicking it around like an annoyed dog that refused to behave.
"LUKE!"
The moment she saw him, Isaria shouted his name without hesitation.
Luke had never once left her mind since their first meeting.
Hearing her voice, he immediately looked up and turned toward her.
But Isaria didn’t stop.
She forced herself to slow down, yet there was still too much momentum behind her. Her body collided with Luke’s-
Thud!
Instead of pulling away, she immediately threw her arms around him and hugged him as tightly as she could.
"Luke... Luke... Luke... I missed you!"
Her voice trembled as tears finally escaped the eyes that had been desperately holding them back.
"I was afraid... please, save me."
She buried her face against his chest, clinging to him as though letting go would mean losing the only person who could keep her safe.
"Please... don’t separate from me."
Her arms tightened even further around his body as her tears soaked into his clothes.
Isaria had already begun falling for Luke from the moment they first met.
But what had just happened with Ivar had driven that feeling to its deepest point.
When he had tried to force himself upon her, the fear had been overwhelming.
She had been terrified that he would defile her, terrified that everything she had protected would be taken away from her-and that afterward, she wouldn’t even have the courage to face Luke again.
She had even feared that Ivar, after defiling her, would kill her afterward, leaving her unable to ever see the people she cared about again-not her family, and not even Luke.
That fear had broken through all the restraint she had maintained until now.
So the moment she finally saw Luke, everything she had been holding back came pouring out.
There were words she had wanted to tell him for a long time, but Selene’s presence had made her swallow them back.
This time, she couldn’t.
"Luke, I love you."
"I love you so much."
Her voice trembled between her sobs as she clung to him, making it painfully clear that she had no intention of letting go anytime soon.
Luke was left completely stunned by the sudden confession.
He hadn’t expected this at all.
Nearby, Kiki tilted his coffin-shaped body to the side, his two eyes staring at the pair in obvious confusion, as if silently asking,
’What is going on?’
Meanwhile, Sevaroth, floating above them, watched the scene unfold with a faint smile.
A glint of interest appeared beneath his helmet.
"Interesting."
Earlier, a few minutes ago-
"Hmm, this new move is pretty good."
Luke watched with interest as ten one-foot-long sword blades, each formed entirely from fire element, materialized above a lone Early C-Rank spider beast before shooting downward.
Puchi!

The blades pierced through its body in rapid succession. In the same instant, flames erupted from the wounds and quickly spread across its entire body, leaving the monster burning helplessly before its corpse was completely engulfed.
Luke nodded in satisfaction.
"Hmm, even the intensity is good."

After entering the maze, he had been using the Elemental Barrage abilities of Paragon’s Judgment on whatever random mobs he happened to encounter along the way. With every battle, he was testing the newly unlocked techniques and getting a better understanding of what they could do.
While Luke was busy examining the results of his latest attack, Kiki had apparently found something far more interesting.

The little coffin had reduced itself to only six feet in size after Luke returned to his normal form, and its huge mouth suddenly opened before gulping down an Early D-Rank spider monster in one bite.
Luke’s satisfied expression immediately changed.
"Kiki, I told you not to eat."
He walked over and kicked the coffin.
Thud!
The delighted expression on Kiki’s face instantly vanished, replaced by a look of pure grievance.
Its two eyes drooped, while its huge mouth opened and a small, childish voice came from inside.
"Kiki... Kiki..."
Because of that habit, Sevaroth had given the coffin the pet name Kiki.
Luke, however, wasn’t buying that innocent expression.
"Those are money. But once you eat them, nothing remains."
That was exactly what bothered him.
When he had first read the description of the Coffin of Infinite Keys, Luke had assumed its ability would only work on beings or objects that had already been sealed in some way.
Apparently, that assumption had been completely wrong.
Sevaroth, who was floating nearby, seemed to understand his confusion.
"Well, a seal is simply another form of restriction."
"Even a curse can be considered one."
As he explained, Kiki had already started crawling toward the corpse of the C-Rank spider, clearly intending to eat that one too.
Luke noticed immediately.
Thud!
Another kick sent the coffin away from the corpse.
Sevaroth continued as though nothing had happened.
"And in every universe, all beings are born with restrictions."
His gaze briefly shifted toward Kiki before returning to Luke.
"Except pure Titans and those pure beings created by the Universe itself to serve as guardians."
Then he pointed toward the information Luke had said earlier.
"So, when you said that beings with Origin Skills could cultivate faster and achieve greater progress than those without them, that was also a form of restriction.
He paused briefly before finishing his explanation.
"A restriction imposed by Valtharion itself."

Sevaroth also clarified that he was mainly referring to the restrictions present at the higher levels. There were many other restrictions as well, including those placed upon low-level beings, along with many more that Luke hadn’t even considered yet.

"So, when those bodies-dead or alive-enter Kiki, their restrictions are removed. But since you didn’t give him any kind of price, such as energy or life force, he simply dissolved whatever remained of those bodies."
Luke frowned slightly as he tried to piece the explanation together.
"So, if I provide the proper price and some other being enters Kiki’s coffin, would that being come out as a perfect existence?"
Sevaroth gave him a smile before shaking his head.
"No. With the amount of power Kiki has unlocked right now, he can’t remove every restriction from a being."
"Then what exactly was he removing?"
"The restriction imposed upon the body."
Sevaroth continued while Luke listened carefully.
"The body contains the soul, and once that particular restriction is removed, Kiki consumes the soul while using the body itself as the price."
Luke stared at him for a few seconds, his expression becoming increasingly complicated.
"So complicated." He rubbed his forehead and decided that he was better off not thinking about it any further for now.
At least, he had understood one important thing: he couldn’t casually let anyone enter Kiki’s coffin. And if someone did enter, he had to make sure the proper price was provided.
With that matter temporarily settled, Luke looked around.
"Where is the C-Rank beast’s body?"
He searched the ground in confusion before finally turning toward Kiki.
A few spider legs could still be seen poking out from the coffin’s open mouth.
Luke stared at them.
Kiki seemed to realize what was happening.
Gulp.
The remaining legs disappeared into the coffin in a single swallow.
"Kiki." The little coffin let out a satisfied burp, clearly pleased with its meal.
Then, without any shame at all, it crawled over to Luke’s legs and began rubbing its coffin-shaped head against him, moving back and forth as if patiently waiting for its master’s pating.
Luke looked down at it.
"Are you a dog?" He lightly kicked Kiki away.
"Kiki!"
The little coffin immediately cried out in grievance, its two eyes drooping as though Luke had just committed some unforgivable injustice by refusing to give him enough affection.
Luke’s mouth twitched.
"Is he always like this?" He turned toward Sevaroth.
The Crypt Titan gave a reluctant nod, a trace of annoyance appearing in his voice as he answered.

Even he hadn’t expected the consciousness of the armor he had created to develop such a strange personality. When Kiki had first come into existence, the little coffin had always enjoyed staying close to him, constantly seeking his attention whenever Sevaroth created something new.

Now that Sevaroth’s body and bloodline had merged with Luke, Kiki naturally regarded Luke as his master as well. His current strength might be far below what Sevaroth had once possessed, but that didn’t seem to matter to the little coffin at all.
"So now you have to put up with him."
Sevaroth said it almost like he was happily passing the responsibility to someone else.
He then floated away, glancing around the maze in search of something remotely interesting. Wandering through the same dark pathways over and over again had already become boring.
It seemed the maze had finally heard his silent complaint.
"Luke!"
A loud voice suddenly echoed through the darkness.
Before Luke could even react, a young and beautiful woman rushed toward him and threw herself into his arms, hugging him tightly as though he were the person she had been desperately searching for.
Sevaroth turned toward the scene.
"Interesting."
For the first time since entering the maze, something had finally happened that wasn’t another identical dark pathway.
And then the young woman said something that made Sevaroth’s mood improve even further.
At least this was something new.
Current time.
"What happened?" Luke asked worriedly as he looked at Isaria.
Only then did he notice the state of her clothing.
Her upper armor was gone, the front of her clothes had been torn, and her bra had been left open.
Luke’s expression immediately stiffened.
Whatever had happened before she found him was clearly far more serious than he had initially realized.
Still, he didn’t ask her about it yet.
Instead, he tightened his arms around her and gently caressed her back, allowing her to remain against his chest while he tried to calm her trembling body.
For now, he simply wanted her to feel safe.
Unfortunately, it seemed even this small moment of peace between them wasn’t going to last.

chapters.title: Chapter 293: Luke Finally Learns the True Bloodline Hierarchy
paragraphs: Step. Step. Step.
Footsteps echoed through the dark pathway from the opposite direction.
A moment later, a young man’s voice followed.
"The Goddess of Luck is surely blessing me today."
Ivar finally appeared, still surrounded by his black owl feathers.
His gaze immediately settled on Luke and Isaria.
She was still held tightly in Luke’s arms, clinging to him as though she had no intention of letting go anytime soon.
The sight instantly reignited the anger buried within Ivar.
His expression darkened for a brief moment, but he quickly suppressed it.
"First, she sent me straight to Isaria, allowing me to accomplish my goal, and now-"
He deliberately paused as his gaze shifted toward Luke.
Luke was still focused entirely on Isaria, gently caressing her as he tried to calm her trembling body. He hadn’t even bothered to look in Ivar’s direction.
’Bastard.’ Ivar’s hand slowly clenched into a fist.
Still, he forced himself to remain calm before continuing.
"And now, she has even brought me to you, so I can finally remove the obstacles that keep getting in the way of my goal."
His smile widened.
"So, I really am lucky today."
At last, Luke reacted.
His mouth twitched slightly.
The tiny reaction immediately lifted Ivar’s mood, making him think that his words had finally caught Luke’s attention.
What he didn’t know was that Luke’s reaction had nothing to do with him.
It was because of the System.
[Luke, there’s another competitor for your Goddess of Luck.]
[Go teach him a lesson! (ง •̀_•́)ง]
Luke’s mouth twitched when he saw the System’s messages.
It had become far too overprotective whenever women were involved.
And now, apparently, it had already started counting even the Goddess of Luck as another member of his harem.
’I can already feel where this is going.’
’Whatever.’
Luke ignored the System’s teasing and brought out a black coat.
"Lucky? Or... unlucky?"
He still didn’t turn toward Ivar as he spoke.
Instead, Luke gently wrapped the coat around Isaria, covering her trembling body before wiping away the tears still lingering on her cheeks.
Then he gave her a reassuring smile.
That small gesture finally allowed the fear in Isaria’s eyes to settle.
Only after making sure she was calm did Luke turn his attention toward Ivar.
The confusion caused by Luke’s earlier words was still visible on the man’s face, but Luke had no interest in explaining anything.
His expression had already turned completely cold.
The warmth from moments ago had vanished without a trace.
Now, in Luke’s eyes, Ivar was nothing more than a corpse waiting to die.
"If you had told me all of this outside..."
Luke spoke calmly as he took a single step forward.
Step.
His gaze never left Ivar.
"And you had also harmed my friend..."
Step.
"Then I would have simply beaten you until you couldn’t recover properly for months."
Luke took another step forward.
Step.
Ivar listened in silence, his eyes narrowing slightly.

The confidence behind Luke’s words was almost unbelievable. An Early B-Rank stood before him, yet Luke spoke as though he wasn’t even worth considering a threat, despite being only a D-Rank Knight himself.
It wasn’t merely confidence.
To Ivar, it sounded like pure arrogance.
"But here..." Luke’s voice remained calm.
A faint smile slowly curved across his lips as he tilted his head slightly to the left.
"...I can kill you, and no one will ever find out who did it."
His smile remained, but the warmth in his eyes had disappeared completely.
"That means you’re unlucky."
"Heh."
A mocking laugh escaped Ivar the instant Luke finished.
He stared straight into those blue eyes with his own completely white ones, clearly finding Luke’s words amusing.
"Seems like after taking down that High Elf by surprise, you’ve become quite full of yourself, Hero of Light."
His tone carried open ridicule, as though Luke’s threat had done nothing more than entertain him.
The next instant-
"Hah!"
Ivar let out a sharp shout as his body began to transform, shifting into the half-owl, half-human form that was a signature trait of the demi-human race.

His human features vanished beneath black feathers as his face took on the appearance of an owl, leaving behind a sharp beak and those eerie, completely white eyes. His hands underwent an even greater change, transforming into black feathered wings with elongated, razor-sharp talons at their ends.
His legs followed, reshaping themselves as his feet became those of an owl, with long, curved talons extending from each toe.
The transformation gave him an entirely different appearance-less like a human with the features of an owl and more like a night-predator that had merely borrowed a human’s shape.
"I possess a royal bloodline-a bloodline of King tier!"
As his voice echoed through the pathway, a violent force suddenly erupted from his body.
BOOM!
A powerful shockwave swept outward, scattering the dust and debris left behind by Luke’s earlier battles and sending the remnants flying in every direction.
Luke was only hundreds meters away.
The expanding force reached him almost instantly, yet-
Nothing happened.
Luke remained exactly where he was, his body completely unmoved by the shockwave.
Ivar’s expression stiffened.
’Huh?’ For a moment, even he couldn’t understand what had just happened.
He had released the power of his King-tier royal bloodline, yet Luke hadn’t even taken a step back.
Unfortunately for Ivar, there was only one person in the entire passage who knew exactly why that was-
Luke.
Meanwhile, Ivar’s declaration lingered in Luke’s mind.
’A King-tier...’
’A King bloodline.’

His thoughts naturally drifted toward Aurielle, Selene, and the others. They had all told him that they were children of Emperors, and he already knew that such royal bloodlines could greatly enhance one’s strength and potential.
But now, hearing Ivar proudly declare his own bloodline as King-tier gave Luke a much clearer understanding of the hierarchy.
After Diamond Knight, the A-Rank realm, comes the King-tier... an S-Rank existence.
His gaze sharpened as he continued piecing together what he knew.
And after S-Rank comes SS-Rank... Saint.
Luke paused at that thought.
A Saint was an existence only one step below a Demigod, which belonged to the SSS-Rank.
’No wonder.’
The difference between realms might only be a single step on paper, but the difference between a King-tier bloodline and a Saint-tier bloodline could be unimaginably vast.
It was like taking an ordinary chicken and turning it into a dragon.
Then another thought crossed Luke’s mind.
’But my bloodline is even above the Demigod level.’ Upon this, a satisfied smile slowly spread across his face.
The expression immediately caught both Ivar and Isaria off guard.
Ivar couldn’t help wondering whether Luke had finally realized the difference between their strengths.
Perhaps he had finally understood that he was standing before an Early B-Rank with a King-tier royal bloodline.
Though, judging by that smile, Ivar wasn’t entirely sure.
Isaria’s confusion was even greater.
She had just heard Ivar reveal his King-tier bloodline, yet Luke hadn’t shown the slightest trace of fear.
Instead, he looked almost pleased.
’What exactly was he thinking?’
Before either of them could figure it out, Luke finally opened his mouth.

chapters.title: Chapter 294: The Battle Between Two Early B-Rank Beings Begins!
paragraphs: "Well, that’s good." Luke looked straight into Ivar’s white eyes, the corners of his lips slowly curling upward.
"I’ll make you the test subject for my new power."
As soon as those words fell, his body began to change.

His human figure rapidly expanded, transforming into the towering form of Caelith, the Cosmic Heart Titan. Brilliant golden light radiated from his twenty-foot body, while long strands of starlight-purple hair flowed behind him. A small halo formed behind his head, made entirely from condensed cosmic energy rather than floating above him as it had before.
But Luke wasn’t finished yet.
The fourth ability of the Faceless Titan activated.
’Titan Fusion.’
In an instant, the power of the Cosmic Heart Titan began merging with that of the Void Titan, Nyx.
The transformation was far more dramatic this time.

Luke’s twenty-foot golden body stretched upward until it reached forty feet, while his previously powerful build changed into a perfectly proportioned, lean physique. His skin turned light purple, and even his face was altered by the fusion, taking on a somewhat feminine beauty with the cold, deadly features of an assassin.
Luke immediately followed with his true Titan bloodline.
The fused power of his four bloodlines surged through his body, suppressing the changes he didn’t want.
The light-purple color gradually faded, replaced by his original fair skin.
Even his altered facial features shifted back into the familiar face of Luke.
Only now, that familiar appearance had been magnified to the scale of a forty-foot Titan.
Luke looked over his new form and nodded with satisfaction.
"This feels good."
He finally didn’t have to worry about what strange appearance Titan Fusion might produce.
No matter how much the fusion altered his body, he could now use his true Titan bloodline to suppress those changes and return himself to the appearance he wanted.
It wasn’t because his Titan bloodline was superior to the titan form, state.
The real difference was that Luke could finally give those bloodlines a direction.

Earlier, even after entering his Titan form, the bloodlines would act according to their own instincts rather than truly listening to him. He could use their power, but he couldn’t completely control how they expressed themselves.
Now, however, they were beginning to listen.
Not perfectly, but enough for Luke to guide their changes instead of simply accepting whatever form they produced.
After all, those four bloodlines belonged to him.
Other than himself, there was no one else in his bodoy, who could truly control them.
Meanwhile, both Ivar and Isaria stared at Luke in shock, but Ivar was clearly the more shaken of the two.

Everything he had previously learned about the Hero of Light had described a completely different person. There had been no mention of a transformation like this, nor of an appearance that could change so drastically.
Worse, Ivar couldn’t shake the feeling that something else had just happened.
’A fusion...?’
He couldn’t be certain.
Yet whatever had occurred was enough to send an unpleasant premonition through his heart.
His gaze slowly climbed toward Luke’s head, and what he saw there made his expression stiffen.
There were now two halos rotating behind Luke.

The inner one was small and pitch-black, while the outer halo was slightly larger and radiated brilliant cosmic light. Both took the form of rings, revolving steadily behind his head, with the black ring positioned inside the cosmic one.
That sight alone made Luke seem completely different.
He no longer looked like a mere mortal.
’But a god...’
The thought made Ivar’s heart pound.
An ancient memory surfaced in his mind.
According to the myths, only Gods possessed halos.
Not even Demigods were allowed to have them.
But why?
Because a halo wasn’t merely a symbol of divinity.
It represented absolute mastery.
Mastery over one’s elements, one’s laws, one’s authority-in fact, mastery over everything connected to one’s own path.
That was what made a halo so terrifying.
And now, Luke had two.
The next moment, however, Ivar forced those thoughts out of his mind.
Luke couldn’t possibly be a god.
That was simply impossible.
"Yeah... it’s impossible."
He muttered the words quietly, almost as though he were trying to convince himself rather than anyone else.
Meanwhile, Luke had already begun calculating his current strength.
’Mhmm... it’s the same as before. The strength of both Titans is added together.’

His ordinary Titan transformation gave him a 5x multiplier to all his stats. Now, with two Titans fused together, each possessing that same enhancement, their respective strengths were being added on top of one another.
In simple terms, his previous Titan transformation had raised his strength to the equivalent of 500 Peak C-Rank beings.
And to reach the Early B-Rank level, he needed the equivalent of 1,000 Peak C-Rank beings.
’So now I have two sets of 500 Peak C-Rank strength...’
That’s a total of 1,000.
Luke’s eyes brightened slightly.
’Which means my raw strength, without even using armor, has reached Early B-Rank.’
He slowly tightened his fist.
BOOM!
A small shockwave burst outward from his hand.
Luke glanced at it before shaking his head.
’Nah.’
It’s not just ordinary Early B-Rank strength.
His attacks could reach an even higher level.
With the foundation he had built, Luke could already unleash attacks powerful enough to reach the Mid-B-Rank level.
’Not bad.’
After finishing his calculations, Luke finally shifted his attention back to Ivar.
The playful look that had remained on his face was gone.
"Kiki, protect her."
After saying that, Luke took a single step forward.
And in the same instant, Voidfang materialized in his right hand.
Because, Paragon’s Judgement was too weak for this battle and it would break with just one clash.
"This much power is enough for you, so come."
Luke raised Voidfang and pointed its blade straight at Ivar, his voice calm and confident.
A good distance behind him, Isaria and Kiki had already moved away from the battlefield. Neither of them wanted to be caught in the aftermath of the clash, and both watched the two men confrontation.
"I don’t know how you increased your strength to Early B-Rank when you only able to make Peak C-Rank before."
Ivar slowly drew his sword.
Clang!
The metallic ring echoed through the pathway as his gaze remained fixed on Luke.
"But it doesn’t matter."
The moment those words fell, Ivar’s Early B-Rank aura erupted from his body without restraint.
BOOM!

A violent shockwave blasted outward as though an huge cannon had been fired. Dust and debris left behind from Luke earlier battle were swept away, while the force was strong enough to shatter boulders and destroy ordinary houses.
Yet the maze didn’t even tremble.
The massive walls remained untouched, and not even the ground beneath their feet showed a single crack.
But neither of them paid any attention to that.
Ivar’s grip tightened around his sword as darkness began gathering around his body.
"Grave Spearfall."
He raised one hand.
Instantly, the darkness above him churned violently before thousands of ten-foot-long spears began materializing in mid-air.
In only a few breaths, the entire space above Luke was filled with darkness spears, their razor-sharp tips all pointing toward him.
"Die!"
Ivar finally brought his hand down.
WHOOSH!
Every spear descended simultaneously.
The attack moved with such terrifying speed that a Peak C-Rank being would see nothing more than hundreds of blurred streaks flashing across the air.
Only a B-Rank existence could properly perceive their trajectories.
But seeing them was one thing.
Surviving their combined destructive power was another.

chapters.title: Chapter 295: Nyx, The Void Titan, Fourth Ability Is Finally Here! [POWER STONE BONUS - ]
paragraphs: Thank you, everyone, for helping us reach this goal!
Once again, thank you all so much for the incredible support. ❤️

Fortunately, the pathway where they were fighting was enormous, stretching nearly a kilometer wide. Above them, the ceiling remained impossibly high, sealed by the same dark material as the surrounding walls. Its actual height was difficult to judge, as it vanished into the darkness overhead, while a barrier remain there, to prevent anyone going up.
"Nice trick."
Luke didn’t even bother moving from where he stood.
The darkness spears were already descending toward him, yet his posture remained completely relaxed, as though the attack raining down from above wasn’t worth taking seriously.
Ivar’s lips curled into a sneer.
’Arrogant’
Finally, the first darkness spear reached Luke.
Its sharp tip came within a hair’s breadth of his body.
Then, something strange happened.
The spear’s terrifying speed suddenly slowed to an extreme degree, as though the space around Luke had become an invisible swamp that dragged everything entering it to a crawl.
Luke merely shifted one step to the side.
The spear passed harmlessly beside his left hand before crashing into the ground.
BOOM!
Darkness erupted from the impact like a bomb had detonated, yet the floor remained completely undamaged.
However, Neither Ivar nor Isaria paid much attention to the explosion.
Their eyes were fixed entirely on Luke.
Another spear descended.
Again, the instant it approached him, its speed dropped to an almost imperceptible level.
Luke moved.
Then another spear came.
He moved again.
A slight sidestep when one passed toward his chest, a subtle turn when another aimed for his neck, and merely tilting his head was enough to avoid the one that came for his head.
Every movement was minimal and precise.
To an ordinary observer, it would have looked as though Luke was standing still while the spears somehow kept missing him.
But Ivar and Isaria could see what was actually happening.
Their owl vision allowed them to perceive the phenomenon clearly, while anyone without sufficiently powerful eyes would have struggled to notice it at all.
The closer the darkness spears came to Luke, the more dramatically their speed was reduced.
And Luke simply used that moment to evade them.
One after another, thousands of spears missed their target and crashed into the ground.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
Explosions of darkness continued to erupt throughout the enormous pathway, filling the air with destructive force.
Yet when the final spear struck the ground, the result remained the same.
Luke was still standing there.
His clothes were untouched.
His body hadn’t moved more than necessary.
And there wasn’t even a scratch on him.
"IMPOSSIBLE!"
Ivar’s pupils shrank as disbelief overwhelmed his entire expression.

What he had just witnessed went beyond anything he could explain. The thousands of darkness spears had been fast enough to overwhelm a Peak C-Rank being, yet the moment they approached Luke, their speed had slowed to the point where he could simply step aside and avoid them.
It was as though the very flow of time around Luke had been altered.
’But the Time element is forbidden!’
Ivar’s heart began pounding harder as that realization surfaced.
Time was one of the few powers that Valtharion itself had never permitted its inhabitants to control. Not mortals, not Kings, not even Gods.
Only Valtharion itself possessed the right to manipulate it.
’Then how is he doing this?’
No matter how many times Ivar replayed what he had seen, he couldn’t come up with an answer.
Something that should have been impossible had just happened directly in front of him.
Meanwhile, Luke watched the disbelief spread across Ivar’s face and nodded in satisfaction.
His expression carried a hint of pride.
After all, the reason he had been able to evade those attacks so effortlessly wasn’t because his speed had suddenly become faster.
He had simply used the fourth ability of Nyx, the Void Titan.
The same ability, he used to remain safe, under earlier Ivar shockwave released.
[Nyx - The Void Titan]
[Fourth Ability: Void Horizon]
- Creates a thin layer of distorted Void Space around the body
- Expands the distance between attack and user
- Incoming attacks lose energy and momentum the farther they travel
- Distance is determined by Void Energy consumption
[Current Maximum Distance: Based on energy output]
[Cost: Variable (scales with distance)]
[Duration: Continuous]
"The Void does not block. It simply makes the journey... infinite."
The reason was actually quite simple.
Whenever one of those darkness spears came within range of Luke, its tip entered the distorted layer of void space surrounding his body.
Using only ten percent of his energy, Luke could stretch the distance within that layer to an entire kilometer.

So although the spears had originally been moving with terrifying speed, they suddenly had another kilometer to cross before reaching him. During that time, their power gradually weakened from the distance, while the extra travel time gave Luke enough of an opening to evade them.
Even though the difference existed only within fractions of a second, that tiny window was already enough for Luke to move.
’Finally, Nyx’s defensive ability has also unlocked.’
A genuine smile of satisfaction spread across Luke’s face.
Nyx already possessed cloning, stealth, and offensive abilities, leaving defense as the only missing piece.
Now, that weakness had finally been filled.
And Luke couldn’t help but be pleased with what he had received.
So, his satisfied gaze shifted toward Ivar.
The expression on the latter’s face had become increasingly ugly.
He had already thrown one attack after another at Luke, yet none of them had worked.
Now, he couldn’t even figure out how he was supposed to attack him.
Seeing his helpless expression, Luke’s lips curled upward.

He had actually retreated.
’From an D-Rank Knight?’
The realization was humiliating enough to make his eyes burn with anger.
’I can’t accept this!’
Ivar clenched his teeth before glaring at Luke.
"Don’t underestimate me!"
His furious shout echoed through the pathway.

The attack he trusted most.
The attack that, in his mind, was powerful enough to kill Luke.
"Gravewing: Dead Star."
Ivar uttered the name of his ultimate innate ability.
A tiny black star immediately appeared above his palm.

It pulsed slowly with every breath he took, and each pulse caused the surrounding light to dim further. The darkness wasn’t merely spreading; the Dead Star was actively devouring everything around it-light, energy, and even the faint traces of power lingering in the air.
Ivar stared at Luke with eyes filled with anger.
"I shouldn’t normally use this ability."
His voice carried a trace of seriousness.
"It requires other lifeforms to feed it before it can unleash its full power."
Yet the restraint in his voice soon disappeared.
A sadistic smile crept across his face, showing that he no longer cared about what happened next.
"But there is another way to make this Dead Star grow instantly."
Luke raised a brow.
Rather than becoming wary, he looked genuinely curious.
He wasn’t in any hurry to kill Ivar. His Titan instincts hadn’t reacted at all, which meant whatever Ivar was about to unleash shouldn’t be enough to threaten him.

"You called yourself the Hero of Light."
The moment those words left his mouth, his body underwent a drastic change.

His youthful face suddenly sank and withered, as though hundreds of years had been forced upon him in an instant. The healthy skin covering his body dried up as well, losing its vitality as his life force rapidly drained away.
’So he’s using his own life force.’ Luke immediately understood.

The Dead Star in his palm suddenly began to swell.
What had previously been no larger than a tennis ball expanded at an astonishing rate, growing larger and larger within moments.
Soon, the tiny black star had reached a diameter of nearly one meter.

Once again, thank you all so much for the incredible support. ❤️
Fortunately, the pathway where they were fighting was enormous, stretching nearly a kilometer wide.
Above them, the ceiling remained impossibly high, sealed by the same dark material as the surrounding walls.
Its actual height was difficult to judge, as it vanished into the darkness overhead, while a barrier remain there, to prevent anyone going up.
"Nice trick."
Luke didn’t even bother moving from where he stood.
The darkness spears were already descending toward him, yet his posture remained completely relaxed, as though the attack raining down from above wasn’t worth taking seriously.
Ivar’s lips curled into a sneer.

Its sharp tip came within a hair’s breadth of his body.
Then, something strange happened.

Luke merely shifted one step to the side.
The spear passed harmlessly beside his left hand before crashing into the ground.
BOOM!
Darkness erupted from the impact like a bomb had detonated, yet the floor remained completely undamaged.
However, Neither Ivar nor Isaria paid much attention to the explosion.
Their eyes were fixed entirely on Luke.
Another spear descended.
Again, the instant it approached him, its speed dropped to an almost imperceptible level.
Luke moved.
Then another spear came.
He moved again.
A slight sidestep when one passed toward his chest, a subtle turn when another aimed for his neck, and merely tilting his head was enough to avoid the one that came for his head.
Every movement was minimal and precise.
To an ordinary observer, it would have looked as though Luke was standing still while the spears somehow kept missing him.
But Ivar and Isaria could see what was actually happening.
Their owl vision allowed them to perceive the phenomenon clearly, while anyone without sufficiently powerful eyes would have struggled to notice it at all.
The closer the darkness spears came to Luke, the more dramatically their speed was reduced.
And Luke simply used that moment to evade them.
One after another, thousands of spears missed their target and crashed into the ground.
BOOM!

Explosions of darkness continued to erupt throughout the enormous pathway, filling the air with destructive force.

Luke was still standing there.
His clothes were untouched.
His body hadn’t moved more than necessary.
And there wasn’t even a scratch on him.
"IMPOSSIBLE!"
Ivar’s pupils shrank as disbelief overwhelmed his entire expression.
What he had just witnessed went beyond anything he could explain.

The thousands of darkness spears had been fast enough to overwhelm a Peak C-Rank being, yet the moment they approached Luke, their speed had slowed to the point where he could simply step aside and avoid them.
It was as though the very flow of time around Luke had been altered.

Ivar’s heart began pounding harder as that realization surfaced.
Time was one of the few powers that Valtharion itself had never permitted its inhabitants to control.
Not mortals, not Kings, not even Gods.
Only Valtharion itself possessed the right to manipulate it.

Something that should have been impossible had just happened directly in front of him.

He had simply used the fourth ability of Nyx, the Void Titan.

- Expands the distance between attack and user
- Incoming attacks lose energy and momentum the farther they travel
- Distance is determined by Void Energy consumption

A genuine smile of satisfaction spread across Luke’s face.
